examples.ar: احتفظ بمصباح يدوي في الشقة لا في السيارة.

examples.en: There may be no light on the stairs, so take a torch.
examples.ar: قد لا يكون هناك ضوء على الدرج، فخذ مصباحاً يدوياً.

examples.en: Keep spare batteries with the torch.
examples.ar: احتفظ ببطاريات احتياطية مع المصباح اليدوي.

examples.en: There is a spare key at the caretaker’s door.
examples.ar: هناك مفتاح احتياطي عند باب الحارس.

examples.en: I'm the host, so I'm sending the invitations myself.
examples.ar: أنا المضيفة، لذا أرسل الدعوات بنفسي.

examples.en: What's the occasion?
We have an hour to set up the room.
Four of them can only attend after four o'clock.
examples.ar: أربعة منهم لا يستطيعون الحضور إلا بعد الرابعة.

examples.en: I'll remind her about the parking.
She'll be disappointed if you don't come at all.
examples.ar: ستشعر بخيبة أمل إن لم تأتِ أصلاً.

examples.en: The kitchen is included. However, the big oven is broken.
examples.ar: المطبخ مشمول، غير أن الفرن الكبير معطّل.

examples.en: Contact Faiza on the number below.
examples.ar: تواصل مع فائزة على الرقم أدناه.

lexicon.meaning: a covered wire that carries power or a signal between two machines

examples.en: Plug the cable in at the side and wait two minutes.
examples.ar: صِل الكابل من الجانب وانتظر دقيقتين.

lexicon.meaning: the part inside a device that stores the power it runs on

examples.en: The battery was flat, not the screen.

lexicon.meaning: a place on a phone or a computer where files are kept together

examples.en: The form stays in your downloads folder.
examples.ar: تبقى الاستمارة في مجلد التنزيلات لديكَ.

lexicon.meaning: not connected to a network, so it can neither send nor receive

examples.en: If a printer goes offline, it has lost the network.
examples.ar: إذا صارت الطابعة غير متصلة فهذا يعني أنها فقدت الشبكة.

lexicon.meaning: to put a file from your own device into a place online

examples.en: Somebody is uploading photographs into the class folder.
examples.ar: هناك من يرفع صوراً إلى مجلد الصف.

lexicon.meaning: to make a second version of something and leave the first one as it is

examples.en: Copy the link and send that instead.
examples.ar: انسخ الرابط وأرسله بدلاً من ذلك.

lexicon.meaning: a picture of what a screen is showing, taken by the device itself

examples.en: Shall I send you a screenshot of the message?
examples.ar: هل أرسل لكَ صورة للشاشة تُظهر الرسالة؟

lexicon.meaning: to put an app or a program onto a device so that it can be used

examples.en: Please do not install the app again before Thursday.
examples.ar: أرجو ألا تثبّت التطبيق من جديد قبل الخميس.

lexicon.meaning: to let another person have or see something that is yours

examples.en: Never share your password with anyone.
examples.ar: لا تشارك كلمة مرورك مع أحد أبداً.

chunks.text: How often should I take it?
How long have you had it?
What error message do you see?
Would you like to join us?
There is a change of plan.
switch it off and on again

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.en: Do you still go to the gym before work?
dialogue.ar: هل ما زلت تذهب إلى النادي قبل العمل؟

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.en: Every morning except Friday. I finish at seven and walk there.
dialogue.ar: كل صباح ما عدا الجمعة. أنتهي في السابعة وأمشي إلى هناك.

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.en: That's early! I never get up before eight.
dialogue.ar: هذا مبكر! أنا لا أستيقظ قبل الثامنة أبداً.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.en: You work late, though. What time do you start?
dialogue.ar: لكنكِ تعملين حتى وقت متأخر. متى تبدئين؟

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.en: Ten, usually. I teach until six, so the evenings are gone.
dialogue.ar: في العاشرة عادةً. أُدرّس حتى السادسة، فتضيع الأمسيات.

activities.prompt: What are Layla and Omar comparing?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي يقارنه عمر وليلى؟
options: Their daily routines
Their new jobs
Their weekend plans
activities.answer: Their daily routines
activities.audioTranscript: Do you still go to the gym before work? Every morning except Friday. I finish at seven and walk there. That's early! I never get up before eight. You work late, though. What time do you start? Ten, usually. I teach until six, so the evenings are gone.

activities.prompt: Choose the correct verb form for Layla's weekday routine.
activities.promptAr: اختر صيغة الفعل الصحيحة لروتين ليلى في أيام العمل.
activities.text: Layla ___ at ten and teaches until six.
options: starts
start
is starting
activities.answer: starts

activities.prompt: Match the two halves of each sentence about a regular week.
activities.promptAr: طابق نصفَي كل جملة تصف أسبوعاً معتاداً.
pairs: Nadia works on weekdays,
so she rests on Friday.
Sami finishes at six,
and then he cooks dinner.
Hala normally takes the bus,
because she has no car.

activities.prompt: What is different about Hala's Saturday?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي يختلف في يوم السبت عند هالة؟
options: She travels to see her family
She opens the pharmacy later
She works until four
activities.answer: She travels to see her family
activities.audioTranscript: Hala normally opens the pharmacy at eight and stays until four. She takes the bus on weekdays because the traffic is bad. On Saturday she drives to her mother's house in Kirkuk and spends the afternoon there with her sisters.

activities.prompt: Talk about your regular week. Say how often you do something, what you do, and when you do it.
activities.promptAr: تحدّث عن أسبوعك المعتاد. اذكر كم مرة تفعل شيئاً ما، وما الذي تفعله، ومتى تفعله.

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.en: Omar! It's good to see you. How are things?
dialogue.ar: عمر! سعيدة برؤيتك. كيف الأحوال؟

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.en: Busy, actually. I'm working at the new clinic this month.
dialogue.ar: مشغول فعلاً. أعمل هذا الشهر في العيادة الجديدة.

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.en: The one near the station? I thought you worked at the hospital.
dialogue.ar: التي بجانب المحطة؟ كنت أظنّك تعمل في المستشفى.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.en: I do, normally. But they need extra people right now.
dialogue.ar: أعمل فيه عادةً، لكنهم يحتاجون موظفين إضافيين هذه الأيام.

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.en: How often do you go?
dialogue.ar: كم مرة تذهب؟

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.en: Three days a week. It's tiring, but I'm learning a lot.
dialogue.ar: ثلاثة أيام في الأسبوع. متعب، لكنني أتعلّم الكثير.

activities.prompt: Why is Omar working at the clinic this month?
activities.promptAr: لماذا يعمل عمر في العيادة هذا الشهر؟
options: He changed jobs
They need extra people
He is studying there
activities.answer: They need extra people
activities.audioTranscript: Omar! It's good to see you. How are things? Busy, actually. I'm working at the new clinic this month. The one near the station? I thought you worked at the hospital. I do, normally. But they need extra people right now. How often do you go? Three days a week. It's tiring, but I'm learning a lot.

activities.prompt: One habit, one temporary change. Choose the form that fits.
activities.promptAr: عادة واحدة وتغيير مؤقت واحد. اختر الصيغة المناسبة.
activities.text: Yusuf usually cooks at home, but this week he ___ in his sister's restaurant.
options: is helping
helps
helped
activities.answer: is helping

activities.prompt: Read the message. What is true only this month?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الرسالة. ما الأمر الصحيح هذا الشهر فقط؟
activities.sourceText: Hi Dana. I am currently sharing a flat with my cousin in Amman, because my own building is closed for repairs. I still teach at the same school, and I still take the same bus. Everything else is normal.
options: Where she lives
Where she works
How she travels
activities.answer: Where she lives

activities.prompt: Why is Karim working in the shop?
activities.promptAr: لماذا يعمل كريم في المتجر؟
options: His car is in the garage
He has left the taxi job
His brother is ill
activities.answer: His car is in the garage
activities.audioTranscript: Karim normally drives a taxi in Mosul six days a week. At the moment his car is in the garage, so he is working in his brother's shop instead. It is only a temporary job, and he hopes to be back on the road next week.

activities.prompt: Reply to your friend. Say what is different in your life at the moment, then ask her one question about her news.
activities.promptAr: ردّ على صديقتك. قل ما الذي يختلف في حياتك في الوقت الحالي، ثم اسألها سؤالاً واحداً عن خبرها.
partnerTurns: Hi! How are things with you these days?
I'm staying at my sister's flat this month, because some workers are painting my kitchen.
It's fine, but I get up an hour earlier now. Ask me anything you like.

dialogue.speaker: Tariq
dialogue.en: Rania? I don't usually see you here on Tuesdays.
dialogue.ar: رانية؟ لا أراكِ هنا عادةً أيام الثلاثاء.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.en: I'm doing the photography course now. What about you?
dialogue.ar: أتابع دورة التصوير هذه الأيام. وماذا عنكَ أنت؟

dialogue.speaker: Tariq
dialogue.en: A Spanish class. How often do you come?
dialogue.ar: درس إسبانية. وكم مرة تأتين؟

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.en: Every Tuesday. And how long is your class?
dialogue.ar: كل ثلاثاء. وكم تستغرق حصتكَ؟

dialogue.speaker: Tariq
dialogue.en: Ninety minutes. It's hard, but recently I feel more confident.
dialogue.ar: تسعون دقيقة. إنه صعب، لكنني مؤخراً أشعر بثقة أكبر.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.en: Tell me more. What do you do in the lesson?
dialogue.ar: أخبرني بالمزيد. ماذا تفعلون في الحصة؟

activities.prompt: What are Tariq and Rania finding out about each other?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي يكتشفه طارق ورانية عن بعضهما؟
options: Which evening classes they take
Which company they work for
How they get to the centre
activities.answer: Which evening classes they take
activities.audioTranscript: Rania? I don't usually see you here on Tuesdays. I'm doing the photography course now. What about you? A Spanish class. How often do you come? Every Tuesday. And how long is your class? Ninety minutes. It's hard, but recently I feel more confident. Tell me more. What do you do in the lesson?

activities.prompt: The answer is 'Twice a week'. Choose the question that asks for it.
activities.promptAr: الإجابة هي «مرتين في الأسبوع». اختر السؤال الذي يطلبها.
activities.text: ___ do you go to the class? Twice a week.
options: How often
How long
How many
activities.answer: How often

activities.prompt: Put this follow-up question in the correct order.
activities.promptAr: رتّب سؤال المتابعة هذا بالترتيب الصحيح.

activities.prompt: How often does Maysoon teach the bread class?
activities.promptAr: كم مرة تُدرّس ميسون درس الخبز؟
options: Twice a month
Every morning
Three times a week
activities.answer: Twice a month
activities.audioTranscript: Maysoon runs a small bakery in Erbil. She opens at six every morning and closes at two in the afternoon. Twice a month she also teaches a bread class, and each class lasts three hours. Her students come from all over the city. Students often ask follow-up questions after class, and she answers every detail patiently.

activities.prompt: Talk about something you are learning at the moment. Answer the two follow-up questions before your friend asks them: how often you do it, and how long it takes. Then add one more detail.
activities.promptAr: تحدّث عن شيء تتعلمه في الوقت الحالي. أجب عن سؤالَي المتابعة قبل أن يسألهما صديقك: كم مرة تفعل ذلك، وكم يستغرق من وقت. ثم أضف تفصيلاً آخر.

dialogue.speaker: Zaid
dialogue.en: Hiba, do you come here every Saturday?
dialogue.ar: هبة، هل تأتين إلى هنا كل سبت؟

dialogue.speaker: Hiba
dialogue.en: I do, yes. I really enjoy sorting the books.
dialogue.ar: نعم، آتي. أستمتع حقاً بترتيب الكتب.

dialogue.speaker: Samir
dialogue.en: Does your sister volunteer here too?
dialogue.ar: وهل تتطوّع أختكِ هنا أيضاً؟

dialogue.speaker: Hiba
dialogue.en: She doesn't. She's more interested in the music group.
dialogue.ar: لا، لا تتطوّع. هي مهتمة أكثر بمجموعة الموسيقى.

dialogue.speaker: Zaid
dialogue.en: That sounds interesting. Tell me more about it.
dialogue.ar: يبدو ذلك ممتعاً. أخبريني بالمزيد عنها.

dialogue.speaker: Hiba
dialogue.en: They meet on Sundays, and anyone can join.
dialogue.ar: يجتمعون أيام الأحد، ويمكن لأي شخص أن ينضم.

activities.prompt: What are the three volunteers talking about?
activities.promptAr: عمَّ يتحدث المتطوعون الثلاثة؟
options: What each of them does here
A problem with the library
Their holiday next month
activities.answer: What each of them does here
activities.audioTranscript: Hiba, do you come here every Saturday? I do, yes. I really enjoy sorting the books. Does your sister volunteer here too? She doesn't. She's more interested in the music group. That sounds interesting. Tell me more about it. They meet on Sundays, and anyone can join.

activities.prompt: Choose the word that starts this question correctly.
activities.promptAr: اختر الكلمة التي يبدأ بها هذا السؤال بشكل صحيح.
activities.text: ___ your brother work at the library on Saturdays?
options: Does
Do
Is
activities.answer: Does

activities.prompt: Listen to the questions and the short answers. What does Nabil do when he is not at the museum?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى الأسئلة والإجابات القصيرة. ماذا يعمل نبيل حين لا يكون في المتحف؟
options: He teaches at a school
He works at a hospital
He stays at home with his wife
activities.answer: He teaches at a school
activities.audioTranscript: Do you work at the museum every day, Nabil? Only three days a week. I teach at the school on the others. That sounds interesting. Does your wife work there too? She doesn't, no. She is a nurse, and she really enjoys it.

activities.prompt: Read the notice. What does it say about new members?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الإعلان. ماذا يقول عن الأعضاء الجدد؟
activities.sourceText: Saturday Book Group. We meet every week at ten, in the small room behind the library desk. New members are always welcome. You do not need to read the whole book. Come and listen if you prefer. Tea is free.
options: They can come without reading the book
They must finish the book first
They pay a small fee for tea
activities.answer: They can come without reading the book

activities.prompt: A friend writes: I am volunteering at the library on Saturdays now. Write a reply. Show that you are interested, ask two questions with do, does or are, and say one thing you enjoy doing at the moment.
activities.promptAr: يكتب لك صديق: «أتطوّع في المكتبة أيام السبت الآن». اكتب رداً تُظهر فيه اهتمامك، واسأل سؤالين باستخدام do أو does أو are، واذكر شيئاً واحداً تستمتع بفعله في الوقت الحالي.

dialogue.speaker: Ghada
dialogue.en: Here are two profiles, Bashar. Which partner suits you?
dialogue.ar: أمامكَ ملفان شخصيان يا بشار. أي شريك يناسبكَ؟

dialogue.speaker: Bashar
dialogue.en: Tell me about them. What do they do?
dialogue.ar: حدّثيني عنهما. ماذا يعملان؟

dialogue.speaker: Ghada
dialogue.en: Idris teaches maths, but this term he's studying in Amman.
dialogue.ar: إدريس يُدرّس الرياضيات، لكنه هذا الفصل يدرس في عمّان.

dialogue.speaker: Bashar
dialogue.en: And the other one?
dialogue.ar: وماذا عن الآخر؟

dialogue.speaker: Ghada
dialogue.en: Wafaa works nights at a hotel and is learning Turkish.
dialogue.ar: وفاء تعمل ليلاً في فندق، وتتعلّم التركية.

dialogue.speaker: Bashar
dialogue.en: Idris, I think. We have a similar background.
dialogue.ar: إدريس، على ما أظن. خلفيتنا متشابهة.

activities.prompt: What is Ghada helping Bashar to do?
activities.promptAr: بماذا تساعد غادة بشاراً؟
options: Choose a language partner
Find a new job
Book a room at a hotel
activities.answer: Choose a language partner
activities.audioTranscript: Here are two profiles, Bashar. Which partner suits you? Tell me about them. What do they do? Idris teaches maths, but this term he's studying in Amman. And the other one? Wafaa works nights at a hotel and is learning Turkish. Idris, I think. We have a similar background.

activities.prompt: One fact is permanent, one is only this year. Choose the form that fits.
activities.promptAr: معلومة دائمة وأخرى خاصة بهذا العام فقط. اختر الصيغة المناسبة.
activities.text: Wafaa works at a hotel, and this year she ___ Turkish.
options: is learning
learns
learn
activities.answer: is learning

activities.prompt: Read the two profiles. What do Idris and Wafaa have in common?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الملفين الشخصيين. ما القاسم المشترك بين إدريس ووفاء؟
activities.sourceText: Idris teaches maths at a school in Basra. This term he is studying for an exam in Amman. Wafaa works nights at a hotel in Amman, and she is learning Turkish online. Both of them run every morning before work.
options: They both run in the morning
They both work at night
They both teach at a school
activities.answer: They both run in the morning

activities.prompt: Which fact is true only this month?
activities.promptAr: أي معلومة صحيحة هذا الشهر فقط؟
options: Rasha drives Mona to work
Rasha works in a bank
They both leave at seven
activities.answer: Rasha drives Mona to work
activities.audioTranscript: My two neighbours have similar lives. Rasha works in a bank and Mona works in a school, but both of them leave the house at seven. This month Rasha is driving Mona to work, because Mona's car is at the garage.

activities.prompt: Talk to your new language partner. Say one thing you both do and one thing that is different for you at the moment, then ask her a question.
activities.promptAr: تحدّث إلى شريكتك الجديدة في اللغة. اذكر شيئاً تفعلانه كلاكما وشيئاً مختلفاً عندك في الوقت الحالي، ثم اسألها سؤالاً.
partnerTurns: Hello! So we are partners this month. I work in a hospital, and I study English every evening.
Really? I usually study alone, but these days I am practising with my sister.
We have that in common, then. Now ask me something about my week.

readingText.title: Rana's Update
readingText.text: Hi Ahmed! Here is my news. I normally work in a small library in Basra, and I walk there every morning because it is close to my flat. But this month my situation is a little different. The library is closed for repairs, so I am working from home and answering emails all day. I miss the quiet rooms, but I like the extra sleep. It is only a temporary change, and we open again in May.
readingText.textAr: أهلاً أحمد! إليكَ أخباري. أعمل عادةً في مكتبة صغيرة في البصرة، وأمشي إليها كل صباح لأنها قريبة من شقتي. لكن وضعي هذا الشهر مختلف قليلاً: المكتبة مغلقة للترميم، فصرتُ أعمل من البيت وأردّ على الرسائل طوال النهار. تنقصني القاعات الهادئة، لكن ساعة النوم الإضافية تعجبني. إنه تغيير مؤقت فقط، وسنفتح أبوابنا من جديد في أيار.

activities.prompt: Read Rana's message once. What is she telling her old classmate?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ رسالة رنا مرة واحدة. ما الذي تخبر به زميلها القديم؟
options: That her work has changed for a short time
That she has moved to another city
That she has left her job at the library
activities.answer: That her work has changed for a short time

activities.prompt: Listen to Basim's voice message. Why is he going to the hospital this month?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة باسم الصوتية. لماذا يذهب إلى المستشفى هذا الشهر؟
options: His mother cannot drive after an operation
He is tired and needs a doctor
He drives the school bus to the hospital
activities.answer: His mother cannot drive after an operation
activities.audioTranscript: Hello, it's Basim. I usually drive the school bus in the mornings, and I am free every afternoon. This month I am also taking my mother to the hospital twice a week, because she cannot drive after her operation. I am tired, but she is getting better.

activities.prompt: Before you write anything, say your update aloud, the way Rana wrote hers. Give one thing you usually do, one thing that is different right now, and the reason.
activities.promptAr: قبل أن تكتب شيئاً، قل تحديثك بصوت عالٍ كما كتبت رنا تحديثها. اذكر شيئاً تفعله عادةً، وشيئاً مختلفاً في الوقت الحالي، والسبب.

activities.prompt: Suhad sent you this message, and your friend Dina never saw it. Tell Dina what Suhad usually does, what is new this term and why, and how Dina can join.
activities.promptAr: أرسلت لكَ سُهاد هذه الرسالة، ولم ترَها صديقتكَ دينا. أخبر دينا بما تفعله سُهاد عادةً، وما الجديد هذا الفصل ولماذا، وكيف تستطيع دينا الانضمام.
activities.sourceCard: Message from Suhad: I still teach Arabic at the centre on Mondays and Wednesdays. This term I am also giving a free online class on Saturday mornings, because many of my old students have moved abroad. Anyone can join; just send me your email.

activities.prompt: Now write your own life update to an old classmate. Say what you usually do, what is different at the moment, and why. Join your ideas with and, but and because.
activities.promptAr: اكتب الآن تحديثاً عن حياتك إلى زميل دراسة قديم. اذكر ما تفعله عادةً، وما المختلف في الوقت الحالي، والسبب. اربط أفكارك بـ and وbut وbecause.

lessons.title: Mission: A Two-Minute Life Update
lessons.titleAr: المهمة: تحديث عن الحياة في دقيقتين
lessons.scenario: You meet a former classmate online. Exchange updates, ask follow-up questions and relay one useful detail to another friend.

activities.prompt: Read your old classmate's profile. Why does Maha start work earlier at the moment?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الملف الشخصي لزميلتك القديمة. لماذا تبدأ مها عملها مبكراً في الوقت الحالي؟
options: She is taking an evening course
She has a new job at a hotel
The agency opens at seven now
activities.answer: She is taking an evening course
activities.sourceText: Maha Saleh, Baghdad. We were in the same class at school! I work at a travel agency near the river, and I normally start at nine. At the moment I start at seven and finish at three, because I am taking an evening course in hotel management.

activities.prompt: Listen to Maha's voice message. What does she say about the course?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة مها الصوتية. ماذا تقول عن الدورة؟
options: It is going well, but it makes her tired
It is too difficult, so she wants to stop
It is easy, and she has plenty of free time
activities.answer: It is going well, but it makes her tired
activities.audioTranscript: Hi again, it's Maha. The course is going really well. We have classes on Monday and Thursday evenings, and each one lasts two hours. I am always tired on Friday, but the teacher is excellent and I am learning a lot. Anyway, tell me about your week.

activities.prompt: You are talking to Maha online. Reply to her news, say what your week is like at the moment, and ask her at least two follow-up questions.
activities.promptAr: أنتَ تتحدث إلى مها عبر الإنترنت. ردّ على خبرها، وقل كيف يبدو أسبوعك في الوقت الحالي، واسألها سؤالَي متابعة على الأقل.
partnerTurns: I can't believe it's you! I'm still in Baghdad. How are things with you these days?
Me? I'm fine, but busy. I'm staying with my brother's family this year, because my flat is too far from the agency.
It's only until the summer. Now tell me about your week, and ask me whatever you want to know.

activities.prompt: Give Maha your own update, one to two minutes long. Say what you usually do, one thing that is different at the moment, why it is different, and how you feel about it.
activities.promptAr: قدّم لمها تحديثك أنتَ، في دقيقة إلى دقيقتين. اذكر ما تفعله عادةً، وشيئاً واحداً مختلفاً في الوقت الحالي، وسبب اختلافه، وكيف تشعر حياله.

activities.prompt: Maha sent you this message, and your friend Firas works at a hotel. Tell him what the trip is, who can go, what is included, and what he must do before Friday.
activities.promptAr: أرسلت لكَ مها هذه الرسالة، وصديقكَ فراس يعمل في فندق. أخبره ما هي الرحلة، ومن يستطيع الذهاب، وما الذي تشمله، وما عليه فعله قبل الجمعة.
activities.sourceCard: Message from Maha: My agency has two free places on a weekend English trip to Babylon in April. It is for people who work in tourism. The bus and the room are included, but not the food. Send me a name before Friday and I can add it to the list.

activities.prompt: Write your message back to Maha. Say what you usually do and what is different at the moment, give the reason, and ask her two questions about her course. Join your ideas with and, but and because.
activities.promptAr: اكتب رسالتك الجوابية إلى مها. اذكر ما تفعله عادةً وما المختلف في الوقت الحالي، وبيّن السبب، واسألها سؤالين عن دورتها. اربط أفكارك بـ and وbut وbecause.

dialogue.speaker: Basil
dialogue.en: Where were you on Thursday, Hind? Your desk was empty all day.
dialogue.ar: أين كنتِ يوم الخميس يا هند؟ كان مكتبكِ فارغاً طوال اليوم.

dialogue.speaker: Hind
dialogue.en: I was at my cousin's wedding in Kerbala.
dialogue.ar: كنتُ في عرس ابنة خالتي في كربلاء.

dialogue.speaker: Basil
dialogue.en: A wedding! How was it?
dialogue.ar: عرس! كيف كان؟

dialogue.speaker: Hind
dialogue.en: Wonderful, but the hall was very crowded. There were three hundred guests.
dialogue.ar: كان رائعاً، لكن القاعة كانت مزدحمة جداً. كان هناك ثلاثمئة مدعوّ.

dialogue.speaker: Basil
dialogue.en: And the food?
dialogue.ar: وماذا عن الطعام؟

dialogue.speaker: Hind
dialogue.en: Excellent. It was a memorable evening. Yesterday I was still exhausted.
dialogue.ar: ممتاز. كانت أمسية لا تُنسى. وأمس كنتُ ما زلتُ منهكة.

activities.prompt: What is Basil asking Hind about?
activities.promptAr: عمَّ يسأل باسل هند؟
options: Why she was not at work
Which city she works in
How she travels to Kerbala
activities.answer: Why she was not at work
activities.audioTranscript: Where were you on Thursday, Hind? Your desk was empty all day. I was at my cousin's wedding in Kerbala. A wedding! How was it? Wonderful, but the hall was very crowded. There were three hundred guests. And the food? Excellent. It was a memorable evening. Yesterday I was still exhausted.

activities.prompt: Choose the past form of be that matches the subject of the second clause.
activities.promptAr: اختر صيغة الماضي من الفعل be التي تناسب فاعل الجملة الثانية.
activities.text: The streets were quiet, but the wedding hall ___ full.
options: was
were
is
activities.answer: was

activities.prompt: Read the hall's notice. What was different about the old hall?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ إعلان القاعة. ما الذي كان مختلفاً في القاعة القديمة؟
activities.sourceText: Notice from Al Zahraa Hall: Last year our hall was small and the car park was full every weekend. There were only two entrances. The new building is ready now, and the doors open at six.
options: It was smaller and had fewer entrances
It opened later in the evening
It had no car park at all
activities.answer: It was smaller and had fewer entrances

activities.prompt: How did the farm house compare with the speaker's memory of it?
activities.promptAr: كيف بدا بيت المزرعة مقارنةً بما تتذكره المتحدثة؟
options: It was smaller than she remembered
It was exactly as she remembered
It was new and much bigger
activities.answer: It was smaller than she remembered
activities.audioTranscript: My grandparents were farmers near Hilla. Last weekend I was there for the first time in ten years. The house was smaller than I remembered, and the garden was full of lemon trees. It was a memorable afternoon.

activities.prompt: Think of a day last month when you were not at home. Say where you were, who was with you, and what the place was like.
activities.promptAr: فكّر في يوم من الشهر الماضي لم تكن فيه في البيت. قل أين كنتَ، ومن كان معك، وكيف كان المكان.

dialogue.speaker: Fadi
dialogue.en: You packed the whole flat in one day?
dialogue.ar: حزمتِ أغراض الشقة كلها في يوم واحد؟

dialogue.speaker: Dalia
dialogue.en: Two days ago, yes. My brothers helped me all afternoon.
dialogue.ar: نعم، منذ يومين. ساعدني إخوتي طوال بعد الظهر.

dialogue.speaker: Fadi
dialogue.en: And the van?
dialogue.ar: وماذا عن الشاحنة؟

dialogue.speaker: Dalia
dialogue.en: It stopped twice on the road. We waited an hour outside Hilla.
dialogue.ar: توقفت مرتين على الطريق. انتظرنا ساعة خارج الحلة.

dialogue.speaker: Fadi
dialogue.en: That sounds slow.
dialogue.ar: يبدو ذلك بطيئاً.

dialogue.speaker: Dalia
dialogue.en: It was. We decided to eat there and travel at night.
dialogue.ar: كان كذلك. قررنا أن نأكل هناك وأن نسافر ليلاً.

activities.prompt: What are Dalia and Fadi talking about?
activities.promptAr: عمَّ يتحدث فادي وداليا؟
options: Her move to a new flat
A holiday near Hilla
A problem at the office
activities.answer: Her move to a new flat
activities.audioTranscript: You packed the whole flat in one day? Two days ago, yes. My brothers helped me all afternoon. And the van? It stopped twice on the road. We waited an hour outside Hilla. That sounds slow. It was. We decided to eat there and travel at night.

activities.prompt: Put the three past verbs in order. Notice that only the -ed on waited adds a whole syllable.
activities.promptAr: رتّب الأفعال الماضية الثلاثة. لاحظ أن -ed في waited وحدها تضيف مقطعاً صوتياً كاملاً.

activities.prompt: Read the company's message. Why did the team use the stairs?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ رسالة الشركة. لماذا استخدم الفريق الدرج؟
activities.sourceText: Message from the removal company: We collected your boxes at eight and arrived at the new building before noon. The lift was broken, so our team carried everything up the stairs. We finished at four and locked the door.
options: The lift was broken
The boxes were too big for the lift
They arrived before the lift opened
activities.answer: The lift was broken

activities.prompt: Why did Nadia spend two hours in Samarra?
activities.promptAr: لماذا أمضت نادية ساعتين في سامراء؟
options: Her train stopped at every village
She missed her train
Her aunt lived there
activities.answer: Her train stopped at every village
activities.audioTranscript: Yesterday Nadia packed a small bag and walked to the station. Her train stopped at every village, so she waited two hours in Samarra. She decided to call her aunt, and they talked all afternoon.

activities.prompt: Your neighbour is telling you about her moving day. Tell her about a day when you packed or carried something heavy, and ask her two questions about hers.
activities.promptAr: جارتكَ تحدّثكَ عن يوم انتقالها. أخبرها عن يوم حزمتَ فيه أو حملتَ شيئاً ثقيلاً، واسألها سؤالين عن يومها.
partnerTurns: We moved on Saturday. I packed the whole kitchen at six in the morning!
My brothers helped, but the van stopped twice and we waited an hour on the road.
We finished at midnight. Now tell me about your worst moving day, and ask me anything.

dialogue.speaker: Hazim
dialogue.en: You came home very late last night, Ruba.
dialogue.ar: عدتِ إلى البيت متأخرة جداً ليلة أمس يا ربى.

dialogue.speaker: Ruba
dialogue.en: Sorry, Baba. We went to Babylon with the college.
dialogue.ar: آسفة يا بابا. ذهبنا إلى بابل مع الكلية.

dialogue.speaker: Hazim
dialogue.en: And your phone? You always lose that phone.
dialogue.ar: وأين هاتفكِ؟ أنتِ تضيّعين هذا الهاتف دائماً.

dialogue.speaker: Ruba
dialogue.en: I lost it at the gate! A guard found it and kept it for me.
dialogue.ar: أضعتُه عند البوابة! وجده أحد الحراس واحتفظ به من أجلي.

dialogue.speaker: Hazim
dialogue.en: Tell me everything.
dialogue.ar: احكي لي كل شيء.

dialogue.speaker: Ruba
dialogue.en: On the way back we bought sweets in Hilla and had a great time.
dialogue.ar: في طريق العودة اشترينا حلويات في الحلة وقضينا وقتاً رائعاً.

activities.prompt: What is Hazim asking his daughter about?
activities.promptAr: عمَّ يسأل حازم ابنته؟
options: Her late return from a college trip
A phone she wants to buy
Her exam next week
activities.answer: Her late return from a college trip
activities.audioTranscript: You came home very late last night, Ruba. Sorry, Baba. We went to Babylon with the college. And your phone? You always lose that phone. I lost it at the gate! A guard found it and kept it for me. Tell me everything. On the way back we bought sweets in Hilla and had a great time.

activities.prompt: This verb is irregular, so it never takes -ed. Choose its past form.
activities.promptAr: هذا الفعل شاذ، فهو لا يأخذ -ed أبداً. اختر صيغة الماضي منه.
activities.text: Yesterday I ___ two tickets at the station.
options: bought
buy
buyed
activities.answer: bought

activities.prompt: Read the page from Ruba's notebook. What did she bring home from the trip?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الصفحة من دفتر ربى. ماذا أحضرت معها من الرحلة؟
activities.sourceText: From Ruba's notebook: Our college went to Babylon in March. The guide spoke for two hours and showed us the old walls. I bought a small book at the shop, and on the way back the driver sang with us.
options: A small book from the shop
A photograph of the guide
A ticket from the college
activities.answer: A small book from the shop

activities.prompt: How did Ghassan get his wallet back?
activities.promptAr: كيف استعاد غسان محفظته؟
options: A boy found it and returned it
He bought a new one in the market
The shopkeeper posted it to him
activities.answer: A boy found it and returned it
activities.audioTranscript: Ghassan goes to Turkey every summer. Last May he lost his wallet in an Istanbul market on the first day. He told a shopkeeper, and an hour later a boy found it near the mosque. Nothing was missing, and he had a great time.

activities.prompt: Tell the story of a day out you still remember. Use at least three irregular past verbs, and say one thing that went wrong.
activities.promptAr: احكِ قصة نزهة ما زلتَ تتذكرها. استخدم ثلاثة أفعال ماضية شاذة على الأقل، واذكر شيئاً واحداً لم يسر كما يجب.

dialogue.speaker: Ziad
dialogue.en: You went to the food festival, Amal. How was it?
dialogue.ar: ذهبتِ إلى مهرجان الطعام يا أمل. كيف كان؟

dialogue.speaker: Amal
dialogue.en: Amazing. We ate things I never tried before.
dialogue.ar: مذهل. أكلنا أشياء لم أجرّبها من قبل.

dialogue.speaker: Ziad
dialogue.en: Did you go on Friday?
dialogue.ar: هل ذهبتِ يوم الجمعة؟

dialogue.speaker: Amal
dialogue.en: No, we didn't. We went two weeks ago, on the quiet day.
dialogue.ar: لا، لم نذهب. ذهبنا منذ أسبوعين، في اليوم الهادئ.

dialogue.speaker: Ziad
dialogue.en: What happened to the cooking competition? Did they cancel it?
dialogue.ar: ماذا حدث لمسابقة الطبخ؟ هل ألغوها؟

dialogue.speaker: Amal
dialogue.en: Not really. They moved it to the evening, so we didn't see it.
dialogue.ar: ليس تماماً. نقلوها إلى المساء، فلم نرها.

activities.prompt: What are the two colleagues discussing?
activities.promptAr: عمَّ يتحدث الزميلان؟
options: Amal's visit to a food festival
A cooking course they both joined
A competition at their office
activities.answer: Amal's visit to a food festival
activities.audioTranscript: You went to the food festival, Amal. How was it? Amazing. We ate things I never tried before. Did you go on Friday? No, we didn't. We went two weeks ago, on the quiet day. What happened to the cooking competition? Did they cancel it? Not really. They moved it to the evening, so we didn't see it.

activities.prompt: Build the past question. Remember that did is followed by the base verb.
activities.promptAr: كوّن سؤال الماضي. تذكّر أن did يأتي بعده الفعل في صيغته الأساسية.

activities.prompt: Listen to the two friends. Why did the speaker miss the visit?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى الصديقين. لماذا فاتت المتحدثَ الزيارة؟
options: His car would not start
His uncle was away
He forgot the date
activities.answer: His car would not start
activities.audioTranscript: Did you visit your uncle last month? No, I didn't. I wanted to, but my car didn't start. What happened? Nothing serious. A mechanic fixed it two days later, and I travelled last Friday.

activities.prompt: Read the entry in the visitor book. What changed between the writer's two visits?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ ما كُتب في دفتر الزوار. ما الذي تغيّر بين زيارتَي الكاتبة؟
activities.sourceText: Visitor book, Basra Heritage House: I came here ten years ago with my school and I did not understand much. This week I returned with my own students. The rooms did not change at all, but the experience was completely different.
options: How much the writer understood
The rooms of the house
The number of visitors each day
activities.answer: How much the writer understood

activities.prompt: A friend writes: I went to the food festival last week. Write a reply. Say one thing you did recently and one thing you did not do, and ask her two questions with did.
activities.promptAr: تكتب لكَ صديقة: «ذهبتُ إلى مهرجان الطعام الأسبوع الماضي». اكتب رداً. اذكر شيئاً فعلتَه مؤخراً وشيئاً لم تفعله، واسألها سؤالين باستخدام did.

dialogue.speaker: Salim
dialogue.en: You arrived four hours late. What was the story?
dialogue.ar: وصلتُما متأخرتين أربع ساعات. ما القصة؟

dialogue.speaker: Hoda
dialogue.en: At first everything was fine. We left Ramadi at seven.
dialogue.ar: في البداية كان كل شيء على ما يرام. غادرنا الرمادي في السابعة.

dialogue.speaker: Basma
dialogue.en: Then the old bus broke down near the lake.
dialogue.ar: ثم تعطلت الحافلة القديمة قرب البحيرة.

dialogue.speaker: Hoda
dialogue.en: After that we waited for a mechanic. Suddenly it started to rain.
dialogue.ar: بعد ذلك انتظرنا ميكانيكياً. وفجأة بدأت تمطر.

dialogue.speaker: Salim
dialogue.en: Poor you!
dialogue.ar: يا لكما من مسكينتين!

dialogue.speaker: Basma
dialogue.en: In the end a farmer drove us, and we finally reached the hotel at midnight.
dialogue.ar: في النهاية أوصلنا أحد المزارعين بسيارته، ووصلنا أخيراً إلى الفندق عند منتصف الليل.

activities.prompt: What are the three friends explaining?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي يشرحه الأصدقاء الثلاثة؟
options: Why their journey took so long
Which hotel they chose
How much the bus ticket cost
activities.answer: Why their journey took so long
activities.audioTranscript: You arrived four hours late. What was the story? At first everything was fine. We left Ramadi at seven. Then the old bus broke down near the lake. After that we waited for a mechanic. Suddenly it started to rain. Poor you! In the end a farmer drove us, and we finally reached the hotel at midnight.

activities.prompt: Rebuild the sentence so that the sequence linker comes first.
activities.promptAr: أعد بناء الجملة بحيث يأتي رابط التسلسل أولاً.

activities.prompt: Read the exhibition caption. Which photograph comes last?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ شرح المعرض. أي صورة تأتي في النهاية؟
activities.sourceText: Exhibition caption: These six photographs show the sequence of one night in Baghdad. At first the square was empty. Then the lights came on. After that, thousands of people arrived, and finally the fireworks started at midnight.
options: The fireworks at midnight
The empty square
The lights coming on
activities.answer: The fireworks at midnight

activities.prompt: Who helped the driver in the end?
activities.promptAr: من الذي ساعد السائق في النهاية؟
options: A lorry driver
His brother
A mechanic from the next town
activities.answer: A lorry driver
activities.audioTranscript: Old cars break down, and mine stopped on the motorway last winter. At first I tried to fix it myself. After that I called my brother, but his phone was off. In the end a lorry driver pulled me to the next town.

activities.prompt: Your friend's bus journey went wrong yesterday. Ask her what happened first, what happened next, and how it ended. Then tell her about a journey of your own that went wrong.
activities.promptAr: رحلة صديقتكَ بالحافلة أمس ساءت. اسألها ماذا حدث أولاً، وماذا حدث بعد ذلك، وكيف انتهى الأمر. ثم أخبرها عن رحلة لكَ ساءت هي الأخرى.
partnerTurns: You will not believe my Thursday. I left the house at six and everything went wrong.
The bus was full, so I waited for the next one. After that the road to Kut was closed.
Ask me what happened next, because it gets worse. Then tell me about your worst journey.

readingText.title: A Story from the Road
readingText.text: Two years ago I travelled from Baghdad to Sulaymaniyah for my cousin's wedding. I packed the night before and left at five in the morning. At first the road was quiet. Then, near Kirkuk, the bus stopped and the driver said we needed a new tyre. We waited three hours in the sun. I was sure I would miss the party. In the end I arrived at ten, and the music was still playing. I was lucky, and we had a great time until sunrise.
readingText.textAr: قبل سنتين سافرتُ من بغداد إلى السليمانية لحضور عرس ابنة عمي. حزمتُ حقيبتي في الليلة السابقة وغادرتُ في الخامسة صباحاً. في البداية كان الطريق هادئاً، ثم توقفت الحافلة قرب كركوك وقال السائق إننا نحتاج إطاراً جديداً. انتظرنا ثلاث ساعات تحت الشمس، وكنتُ واثقة أنني سأفوّت الحفل. في النهاية وصلتُ في العاشرة، وكانت الموسيقى ما زالت تُعزف. كنتُ محظوظة، وقضينا وقتاً رائعاً حتى شروق الشمس.

activities.prompt: Read the story once. What kind of story is the writer telling?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ القصة مرة واحدة. أي نوع من القصص ترويه الكاتبة؟
options: A long journey that ended well
A wedding she could not reach
A bus she decided not to take
activities.answer: A long journey that ended well

activities.prompt: Listen to a second story. Why does the speaker call the delay a good thing?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى قصة ثانية. لماذا يعدّ المتحدث التأخير أمراً جيداً؟
options: They met a family and got a free meal
The plane arrived early in the end
The airline paid for a hotel
activities.answer: They met a family and got a free meal
activities.audioTranscript: Here is my story. Last summer our flight to Cairo left four hours late. At first we were angry. Then the airline gave every passenger a free meal, and we met a family from Mosul. In the end we were surprised: the delay was the best part.

activities.prompt: Before you write anything, tell your own story aloud the way the model tells it. Give the time and place, two events in order, and how it ended.
activities.promptAr: قبل أن تكتب شيئاً، احكِ قصتكَ بصوت عالٍ كما يحكيها النموذج. اذكر الزمان والمكان، وحدثين بالترتيب، وكيف انتهت.

activities.prompt: Mrs Haddad cannot read English. Tell her son what happened to his wallet, in the order the events happened, and where it is now.
activities.promptAr: السيدة حداد لا تقرأ الإنجليزية. أخبر ابنها بما حدث لمحفظته، بترتيب وقوع الأحداث، وأين هي الآن.
activities.sourceCard: Police note for Mrs Haddad: These are the events. A driver found your son's wallet on the number nine bus at two. He gave it to his manager at three, and the manager brought it to this station at four. Nothing is missing.

activities.prompt: Now write your own short story about a day that did not go as planned. Give the time and place, put the events in order, and finish with how it ended.
activities.promptAr: اكتب الآن قصتك القصيرة عن يوم لم يسر كما خُطّط له. اذكر الزمان والمكان، ورتّب الأحداث، واختم بكيفية انتهائه.

lessons.title: Mission: A Memorable Day
lessons.scenario: Tell a friend about a memorable day, answer questions, order its events and send a written version.

activities.prompt: Read Hana's blog post. Why does she call a missed train a good day?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ تدوينة هناء. لماذا تصف فوات القطار بأنه يوم جيد؟
activities.sourceText: From Hana's blog: Last October I missed the early train to Mosul. I waited on the platform for two hours and met a woman from my old school. We travelled together and talked the whole way. I lost a morning and found a friend.
options: She met an old schoolfriend and travelled with her
The next train was faster and cheaper
She had two quiet hours to read
activities.answer: She met an old schoolfriend and travelled with her

activities.prompt: Listen to Hana's voice message. What did Ruqayya offer?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة هناء الصوتية. ماذا عرضت رقية؟
options: A visit to her school in May
A room in her flat in Mosul
A job at the station café
activities.answer: A visit to her school in May
activities.audioTranscript: Hi, it's Hana. I forgot to tell you the best part. My friend's name is Ruqayya and she teaches in Mosul now. We ate lunch at the station café, and she invited me to her school in May. One missed train, one whole friendship.

activities.prompt: Hana wants to hear about your memorable day. Tell her what happened, and answer at least three of her questions.
activities.promptAr: تريد هناء أن تسمع عن يومكَ الذي لا يُنسى. أخبرها بما حدث، وأجب عن ثلاثة من أسئلتها على الأقل.
partnerTurns: That was my day. Now tell me about a day you still remember. When was it?
Really? And who were you with? What happened first?
That is amazing. How did it end, and why do you still remember it?

activities.prompt: Give your own one-to-two-minute account of a memorable day. Say when and where it was, tell the events in order, and say why you still remember it.
activities.promptAr: قدّم روايتك الخاصة في دقيقة إلى دقيقتين عن يوم لا يُنسى. قل متى كان وأين، واسرد الأحداث بالترتيب، وبيّن لماذا ما زلتَ تتذكره.

activities.prompt: Your friend Firas missed the club's family day and does not read English. Tell him what the group did, in order, and what he must bring next time.
activities.promptAr: فاتَ صديقَكَ فراس يومُ العائلة في النادي، وهو لا يقرأ الإنجليزية. أخبره بما فعلته المجموعة بالترتيب، وبما عليه أن يحضره في المرة القادمة.
activities.sourceCard: Club newsletter: Our family day started at nine with a walk by the river. After that the children played football, and at one we all ate together. Finally the photographs were taken at four. Next time, please bring a chair and a hat.

activities.prompt: Write the memorable day for Hana as a short story. Put the events in order, use past forms, and end with why the day stayed with you.
activities.promptAr: اكتب لهناء اليوم الذي لا يُنسى على شكل قصة قصيرة. رتّب الأحداث، واستخدم صيغ الماضي، واختم بسبب بقاء هذا اليوم في ذاكرتك.

dialogue.speaker: Hanan
dialogue.en: You are collecting Doctor Salwa at the airport. Do you know her?
dialogue.ar: ستستقبل الدكتورة سلوى في المطار. هل تعرفها؟

dialogue.speaker: Yousef
dialogue.en: No, never. What does she look like?
dialogue.ar: لا، لم أرها قط. كيف تبدو؟

dialogue.speaker: Hanan
dialogue.en: She is short, with curly grey hair, and she wears glasses.
dialogue.ar: قصيرة القامة، شعرها رمادي مجعد، وترتدي نظارة.

dialogue.speaker: Yousef
dialogue.en: Half the airport wears glasses. Tell me about her appearance.
dialogue.ar: نصف من في المطار يرتدون نظارات. حدّثيني أكثر عن مظهرها.

dialogue.speaker: Hanan
dialogue.en: She looks similar to her sister Rasha, and her suitcase is red.
dialogue.ar: تشبه أختها رشا، وحقيبتها حمراء.

dialogue.speaker: Yousef
dialogue.en: Rasha! Now I will recognise her.
dialogue.ar: رشا! الآن سأتعرّف عليها.

activities.prompt: Why does Yousef need the description?
activities.promptAr: لماذا يحتاج يوسف إلى الوصف؟
options: So he can find Doctor Salwa at the airport
So he can book her a taxi home
So he can send her photo to Rasha
activities.answer: So he can find Doctor Salwa at the airport
activities.audioTranscript: You are collecting Doctor Salwa at the airport. Do you know her? No, never. What does she look like? She is short, with curly grey hair, and she wears glasses. Half the airport wears glasses. Tell me about her appearance. She looks similar to her sister Rasha, and her suitcase is red. Rasha! Now I will recognise her.

activities.prompt: Looks, not character. Choose the missing word.
activities.promptAr: المظهر لا الطبع. اختر الكلمة الناقصة.
activities.text: What ___ the new teacher look like?
options: does
is
has
activities.answer: does

activities.prompt: Match each traveller to the detail that will help the driver find them.
activities.promptAr: طابق كل مسافر بالتفصيل الذي يساعد السائق على إيجاده.
pairs: Doctor Salwa looks similar to her sister,
so Yousef already knows her face.
Mister Adel has a short grey beard,
and he is wearing a blue jacket.
Huda is not tall,
but her suitcase is bright red.

activities.prompt: Listen to the driver's voice message. How will the traveller know it is Yousef?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة السائق الصوتية. كيف ستعرف المسافرة أنه يوسف؟
options: He is holding a card with her name on it
He is wearing a bright red jacket
He will call her before the plane lands
activities.answer: He is holding a card with her name on it
activities.audioTranscript: This is Yousef at the arrivals gate. I am holding a card with your name on it. I am tall, and I have a short black beard and a grey cap. My English is not good, but my sister wrote this message. Call me when you land.

activities.prompt: A driver is meeting your friend at the airport tomorrow and has never seen her. Describe her out loud: her height, her hair, and one detail he will find quickly.
activities.promptAr: سيستقبل سائقٌ صديقتَك في المطار غداً، وهو لم يرها من قبل. صِفها بصوت عالٍ: طولها، وشعرها، وتفصيلاً واحداً يلاحظه بسرعة.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.en: You worked with Nabil last year. What is he like?
dialogue.ar: عملتِ مع نبيل العام الماضي. كيف هي شخصيته؟

dialogue.speaker: Dima
dialogue.en: Very patient. He never shouts, even on a bad day.
dialogue.ar: صبور جداً. لا يرفع صوته أبداً، حتى في يوم سيّئ.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.en: Is he outgoing? Our office eats lunch together.
dialogue.ar: وهل هو اجتماعي؟ نحن في المكتب نتغدّى معاً.

dialogue.speaker: Dima
dialogue.en: A little shy at first, but he is easy to talk to.
dialogue.ar: خجول قليلاً في البداية، لكن الحديث معه سهل.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.en: And is he reliable? I need someone for Saturdays.
dialogue.ar: وهل هو موثوق؟ أحتاج إلى شخص لأيام السبت.

dialogue.speaker: Dima
dialogue.en: Completely. He is also generous, and he always brings coffee.
dialogue.ar: تماماً. وهو كريم أيضاً، ويُحضر القهوة دائماً.

activities.prompt: What is Karim trying to find out?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي يحاول كريم معرفته؟
options: What sort of person Nabil is
What Nabil looks like
Where Nabil worked last year
activities.answer: What sort of person Nabil is
activities.audioTranscript: You worked with Nabil last year. What is he like? Very patient. He never shouts, even on a bad day. Is he outgoing? Our office eats lunch together. A little shy at first, but he is easy to talk to. And is he reliable? I need someone for Saturdays. Completely. He is also generous, and he always brings coffee.

activities.prompt: Character, not looks. Choose the missing word.
activities.promptAr: الطبع لا المظهر. اختر الكلمة الناقصة.
activities.text: What ___ your new flatmate like? She is quiet and very generous.
options: is
does
has
activities.answer: is

activities.prompt: Read the message about a new flatmate. What is it warning Rana about?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الرسالة عن شريكة السكن الجديدة. مِمَّ تحذّر رنا؟
options: Suha needs quiet late in the evening
Suha never cooks for other people
Suha is shy and hard to talk to
activities.answer: Suha needs quiet late in the evening
activities.sourceText: Hi Rana. About the room: my flatmate Suha is quiet in the morning, and she cooks for everyone on Fridays. She is not shy at all once she knows you, and she is generous with her things. She does not like loud music after ten.

activities.prompt: Listen to the reference for Fadi. What does the speaker warn you about?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى التزكية الخاصة بفادي. ممَّ يحذّرك المتحدث؟
options: He will be quiet with new people
He is often late in the morning
He does not like helping anyone
activities.answer: He will be quiet with new people
activities.audioTranscript: You asked about Fadi. He is a very patient man, and he is reliable too. He was never late in three years. He is not outgoing, so he will not talk much at the party, but he is generous with his time and he listens.

activities.prompt: Answer your friend. Say what Hala is like, give two qualities with an example for each, then ask your friend one question about her new office.
activities.promptAr: أجب صديقتك. قل كيف هي شخصية هالة، واذكر صفتين مع مثال لكل صفة، ثم اسألها سؤالاً واحداً عن مكتبها الجديد.
partnerTurns: So you know Hala well. I am sharing an office with her from Sunday. What is she like?
That is good to hear. And is she easy to talk to? I am a bit shy myself.
Thank you. Tell me one more thing about her, and then ask me anything you want.

dialogue.speaker: Ruba
dialogue.en: I have to present on Thursday. Who should I ask for help?
dialogue.ar: عليّ تقديم عرض يوم الخميس. مَن أطلب منه المساعدة؟

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.en: Maha or Ziad. Maha is calmer, and she explains things slowly.
dialogue.ar: مها أو زياد. مها أهدأ، وتشرح الأمور ببطء.

dialogue.speaker: Ruba
dialogue.en: And Ziad? He is more confident than both of us.
dialogue.ar: وزياد؟ هو أكثر ثقة منا نحن الاثنين.

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.en: He is, but he is busier this week than Maha.
dialogue.ar: صحيح، لكنه أكثر انشغالاً من مها هذا الأسبوع.

dialogue.speaker: Ruba
dialogue.en: Then Maha. She is also more organised, so she will answer.
dialogue.ar: إذاً مها. وهي أكثر تنظيماً أيضاً، لذا سترد عليّ.

activities.prompt: What are Ruba and Samer deciding?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي تقرره ربى مع سامر؟
options: Who Ruba should ask to help her practise
Which day Ruba will give her presentation
Who is the best speaker in the office
activities.answer: Who Ruba should ask to help her practise
activities.audioTranscript: I have to present on Thursday. Who should I ask for help? Maha or Ziad. Maha is calmer, and she explains things slowly. And Ziad? He is more confident than both of us. He is, but he is busier this week than Maha. Then Maha. She is also more organised, so she will answer.

activities.prompt: A short adjective or a long one? Choose the correct comparative.
activities.promptAr: صفة قصيرة أم طويلة؟ اختر صيغة المقارنة الصحيحة.
activities.text: Maha explains slowly, so she is ___ than Ziad in a long meeting.
options: calmer
more calm
calmest
activities.answer: calmer

activities.prompt: Read the note on the office door. Who should you ask first about a slow laptop?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الملاحظة على باب المكتب. مَن تسأل أولاً عن حاسوب بطيء؟
options: Rami, because he explains patiently
Sawsan, because she is quicker
Either of them, because they work together
activities.answer: Rami, because he explains patiently
activities.sourceText: Note on the office door: if your laptop stops working, ask Rami first. He is slower than Sawsan, but he is more helpful with beginners and he never makes you feel silly. Sawsan is quicker, so ask her when the problem is urgent.

activities.prompt: Listen. Why does the speaker choose Basma to feed the cat?
activities.promptAr: استمع. لماذا تختار المتحدثة بسمة لإطعام القطة؟
options: She lives nearer and is more careful
She is friendlier than Huda
She is the only one who is free
activities.answer: She lives nearer and is more careful
activities.audioTranscript: I need someone to feed the cat next weekend. Huda is friendlier than Basma, but she travels a lot. Basma is quieter and lives closer to us, and she is more careful with keys. So I will ask Basma this time, and Huda in August.

activities.prompt: Think of two people you could ask for help with a difficult form. Compare them using at least two comparative forms, then say which one you will ask and why.
activities.promptAr: فكّر في شخصين يمكنك أن تطلب منهما المساعدة في استمارة صعبة. قارن بينهما بصيغتَي مقارنة على الأقل، ثم قل مَن ستسأل ولماذا.

dialogue.speaker: Faris
dialogue.en: Three roles, three people. Who takes the welcome desk?
dialogue.ar: ثلاثة أدوار وثلاثة أشخاص. مَن يتولّى مكتب الاستقبال؟

dialogue.speaker: Suad
dialogue.en: Nawal. She has the most experience with visitors.
dialogue.ar: نوال. لديها أكبر خبرة مع الزوّار.

dialogue.speaker: Hani
dialogue.en: And the posters? Karim is the most creative person here.
dialogue.ar: وماذا عن الملصقات؟ كريم أكثرنا إبداعاً هنا.

dialogue.speaker: Suad
dialogue.en: Agreed. That leaves the children's games.
dialogue.ar: متفقة. يبقى إذاً ألعاب الأطفال.

dialogue.speaker: Faris
dialogue.en: Rania, then. She is the most active of all of us.
dialogue.ar: رانية إذاً. هي الأنشط بيننا جميعاً.

dialogue.speaker: Hani
dialogue.en: Three different roles, three best choices. Nobody does everything.
dialogue.ar: ثلاثة أدوار مختلفة وثلاثة خيارات أفضل. لا أحد يقوم بكل شيء.

activities.prompt: How are the three of them dividing the work?
activities.promptAr: كيف يوزّع الثلاثة العمل بينهم؟
options: Each person takes the job that suits them best
One person will do all three jobs
They cannot agree on anything
activities.answer: Each person takes the job that suits them best
activities.audioTranscript: Three roles, three people. Who takes the welcome desk? Nawal. She has the most experience with visitors. And the posters? Karim is the most creative person here. Agreed. That leaves the children's games. Rania, then. She is the most active of all of us. Three different roles, three best choices. Nobody does everything.

activities.prompt: One person above everyone else. Choose the correct form.
activities.promptAr: شخص واحد يتفوق على الجميع. اختر الصيغة الصحيحة.
activities.text: Of the four volunteers, Rania is ___ active.
options: the most
more
as
activities.answer: the most

activities.prompt: Listen to the manager give out the jobs. Why does Lubna write the report?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى المديرة وهي توزّع المهام. لماذا تكتب لبنى التقرير؟
options: She is the most careful with numbers
She knows the city best
She is the friendliest of them
activities.answer: She is the most careful with numbers
activities.audioTranscript: Listen, everybody. Ahmad will drive the van, because he knows the city best. Sana will meet the families at the door; she is the friendliest of us. And Lubna will write the report, because she is the most careful with numbers. Nobody is the best at everything.

activities.prompt: Read the staff notice. Why does Yasmin lead the group?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ إعلان الموظفين. لماذا تقود ياسمين المجموعة؟
options: She has the most experience
She is the strongest of them
She wrote the list of names
activities.answer: She has the most experience
activities.sourceText: Saturday clean-up: the roles are now fixed. Yasmin leads the group, because she has the most experience. Omar takes the tools; he is the strongest of us. Dalia writes the list of names. Please do not swap roles on the day.

activities.prompt: Two colleagues are waiting for their jobs at a school open day: one is very organised, the other is very good with children. Write a short note to the head teacher. Give each of them one role, and say why each one is the best choice for it.
activities.promptAr: زميلان ينتظران مهمتيهما في يوم مفتوح بالمدرسة: أحدهما منظّم جداً، والآخر يجيد التعامل مع الأطفال. اكتب ملاحظة قصيرة إلى مدير المدرسة. امنح كل واحد منهما دوراً، وبيّن لماذا هو الخيار الأفضل له.

dialogue.speaker: Iman
dialogue.en: Our street needs a person who can speak to the council.
dialogue.ar: شارعنا يحتاج إلى شخص يستطيع مخاطبة البلدية.

dialogue.speaker: Bashir
dialogue.en: Ask Mister Jalal. He is the neighbour who fixed the lights.
dialogue.ar: اسألي الأستاذ جلال. هو الجار الذي أصلح الإنارة.

dialogue.speaker: Iman
dialogue.en: Does he get on well with the office there?
dialogue.ar: وهل ينسجم مع الموظفين هناك؟

dialogue.speaker: Bashir
dialogue.en: Very well. My colleague Sara works there, and they trust him.
dialogue.ar: ينسجم تماماً. زميلتي سارة تعمل هناك، وهم يثقون به.

dialogue.speaker: Iman
dialogue.en: Good. A quiet relationship like that opens more doors than shouting.
dialogue.ar: جيد. علاقة هادئة كهذه تفتح أبواباً أكثر من الصراخ.

activities.prompt: What does the street need?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي يحتاجه الشارع؟
options: Someone who can talk to the council for them
A new set of street lights
A neighbour who can drive a van
activities.answer: Someone who can talk to the council for them
activities.audioTranscript: Our street needs a person who can speak to the council. Ask Mister Jalal. He is the neighbour who fixed the lights. Does he get on well with the office there? Very well. My colleague Sara works there, and they trust him. Good. A quiet relationship like that opens more doors than shouting.

activities.prompt: Which word introduces the person? Complete the advert.
activities.promptAr: أي كلمة تُدخِل وصف الشخص؟ أكمل الإعلان.
activities.text: We are looking for someone ___ can drive a small van.
options: who
which
where
activities.answer: who

activities.prompt: Read the noticeboard advert. Who is it looking for?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ إعلان لوحة الحي. عمَّن يبحث؟
options: Someone who can explain English letters to older people
Someone who can teach an English class on Sundays
Someone who can drive older neighbours to the post office
activities.answer: Someone who can explain English letters to older people
activities.sourceText: Noticeboard, Al-Hadba Street. Wanted: a person who can read letters in English for older neighbours, one hour on Sunday mornings. You do not need any training. You do need patience, and a neighbour who will sit with you the first time.

activities.prompt: Listen to the three neighbours. Who would you ask about a letter you cannot read?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى وصف الجيران الثلاثة. مَن تسأل بشأن رسالة لا تستطيع قراءتها؟
options: Widad
Umm Salim
Abu Nasser
activities.answer: Widad
activities.audioTranscript: Three people help on our street. Umm Salim is the woman who cooks when a family has a new baby. Abu Nasser is a neighbour who repairs bicycles for free. And Widad is a colleague of mine who writes letters for people who cannot read.

activities.prompt: Answer your neighbour. Suggest a person who could help her mother, describe that person with someone who, and ask your neighbour one question about what her mother needs.
activities.promptAr: أجب جارتك. اقترح شخصاً يستطيع مساعدة والدتها، وصِفه بعبارة someone who، ثم اسألها سؤالاً واحداً عمّا تحتاجه والدتها.
partnerTurns: Good morning. My mother is alone all day now, and I work until six. I do not know who to ask.
That is kind of you. Is she someone my mother will trust? My mother is very shy with new people.
Thank you. Tell me how you know her, and then ask me anything you need to know.

readingText.title: Who I Would Choose
readingText.text: Dear Mrs Zeinab, you asked me about the two new members for the reading team. I would choose Hind and Ayman. Hind is good at planning, and she is the most organised person in our group. Ayman is good with children, and he is patient as well. Hind is quieter than Ayman, but that is useful: he talks to the families and she keeps the lists. Their strengths are different, so they are a suitable pair. Warm regards, Nour.
readingText.textAr: عزيزتي السيدة زينب، سألتِني عن العضوين الجديدين لفريق القراءة. أختار هند وأيمن. هند تجيد التخطيط، وهي أكثرنا تنظيماً في المجموعة. وأيمن يحسن التعامل مع الأطفال، وهو صبور أيضاً. هند أهدأ من أيمن، لكن ذلك مفيد: هو يتحدث إلى العائلات وهي تتولّى القوائم. نقاط قوتهما مختلفة، لذا فهما ثنائي مناسب. مع خالص التحية، نور.

activities.prompt: Read Nour's note once. What is she telling Mrs Zeinab?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ ملاحظة نور مرة واحدة. ماذا تخبر به السيدة زينب؟
options: Why these two people work well together
That the team already has too many members
That she cannot join the team herself
activities.answer: Why these two people work well together

activities.prompt: Listen to Mrs Zeinab's reply. What is her worry about Ayman?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى ردّ السيدة زينب. ما الذي يقلقها بشأن أيمن؟
options: He may not have the time every week
He is not good enough with children
He is less organised than Hind
activities.answer: He may not have the time every week
activities.audioTranscript: It is Zeinab. Thank you for the note. I agree about Hind, and she is the most organised of all of us. I am not sure about Ayman, though. He is kind, but he is also the busiest man in the building. Can he really come every Saturday?

activities.prompt: Before you write, say your own recommendation out loud, the way Nour wrote hers. Name two people, say what each one is good at, and add one quality they share using too or also.
activities.promptAr: قبل أن تكتب، قل توصيتك بصوت عالٍ كما كتبت نور توصيتها. سمِّ شخصين، واذكر ما يجيده كل منهما، وأضف صفة مشتركة بينهما مستخدماً too أو also.

activities.prompt: Mrs Zeinab sent you this message and Ayman never saw it. Tell him when and where the team meets, the two kinds of person it needs, and the one condition.
activities.promptAr: أرسلت لكَ السيدة زينب هذه الرسالة، ولم يرَها أيمن. أخبره متى يجتمع الفريق وأين، وأي نوعين من الأشخاص يحتاج، والشرط الوحيد.
activities.sourceCard: Message from Mrs Zeinab: the reading team meets on Saturdays from nine to eleven, in the room behind the mosque. We need one person who is good with children and one who can keep the lists. No experience is needed, but please come for both hours.

activities.prompt: Write your own note recommending two people for a small team. Say what each one is good at, add one quality they share with too or also, and explain with and, but and because why the two of them fit together.
activities.promptAr: اكتب ملاحظتك الخاصة توصي فيها بشخصين لفريق صغير. اذكر ما يجيده كل منهما، وأضف صفة مشتركة بينهما بـ too أو also، واشرح بـ and وbut وbecause لماذا يتكاملان معاً.

lessons.title: Mission: Choose the Best Person for a Team
lessons.scenario: A community project needs two new members. Understand the profiles, discuss the candidates, make a choice and explain it.

activities.prompt: Read the three candidate notes. Who is the best choice for the morning shift, and why?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ ملاحظات المرشحين الثلاثة. مَن الخيار الأفضل لنوبة الصباح ولماذا؟
options: Lubna, because she is free all day
Hanaa, because she has the most experience
Mazen, because he knows every street
activities.answer: Lubna, because she is free all day
activities.sourceText: Candidates for the community kitchen. Hanaa: five years in a school canteen, very organised, cannot come before four. Mazen: no experience with food, but he drives a van and knows every street. Lubna: calm and quick, free all day, new to the city.

activities.prompt: Listen to the kitchen manager. What does she say about the driver?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى مديرة المطبخ. ماذا تقول عن السائق؟
options: He does not have to cook at all
He must start work at seven
He needs experience with food
activities.answer: He does not have to cook at all
activities.audioTranscript: This is Umm Rami from the kitchen. Two things. The morning cook must start at seven, so anybody who works until four is no good for us. And the driver does not need to cook at all; he only needs a clean van and a good map.

activities.prompt: Discuss the three candidates with the project leader. Compare at least two of them, disagree politely once, and agree on two names.
activities.promptAr: ناقش المرشحين الثلاثة مع مسؤولة المشروع. قارن بين اثنين منهم على الأقل، واعترض بلطف مرة واحدة، واتفقا على اسمين.
partnerTurns: So, we have three names and two places. I like Hanaa; nobody here has more experience than her.
That is true, but she cannot start before four, and the cooking starts at seven. Who else, then?
Good. Tell me your two names, and I will write them on the list.

activities.prompt: Explain your choice to the whole group in one minute. Describe the two people you chose, compare them with each other, and say which part of the work each one is best at.
activities.promptAr: اشرح اختيارك أمام المجموعة كلها في دقيقة واحدة. صف الشخصين اللذين اخترتهما، وقارن بينهما، وقل أي جزء من العمل يجيده كل واحد منهما أكثر.

activities.prompt: The two people you chose do not read English. Tell them when the training is, what to bring, what the centre pays for, and what to do if they cannot come.
activities.promptAr: الشخصان اللذان اخترتهما لا يقرآن الإنجليزية. أخبرهما متى التدريب، وماذا يُحضران، وما الذي يدفع المركز ثمنه، وماذا يفعلان إن تعذّر حضورهما.
activities.sourceCard: Message from the community centre: both new volunteers must come to a short training on Thursday evening, from six to seven. Bring an identity card. The centre pays for the bus, but not for food. If you cannot come on Thursday, tell us before Tuesday.

activities.prompt: Write your recommendation to the community centre. Name the two people you chose, give each one a job, compare them with the candidate you did not choose, and explain your reasons with and, but and because.
activities.promptAr: اكتب توصيتك إلى المركز المجتمعي. سمِّ الشخصين اللذين اخترتهما، وامنح كلاً منهما مهمة، وقارنهما بالمرشح الذي لم تختره، واشرح أسبابك بـ and وbut وbecause.

dialogue.speaker: Sameer
dialogue.en: How is the new flat, Ruba?
dialogue.ar: كيف هي الشقة الجديدة يا ربى؟

dialogue.speaker: Ruba
dialogue.en: Much better. In the old building there wasn't a lift, and we were on the fourth floor.
dialogue.ar: أفضل بكثير. في البناية القديمة لم يكن هناك مصعد، وكنّا في الطابق الرابع.

dialogue.speaker: Sameer
dialogue.en: Was there a balcony?
dialogue.ar: وهل كانت فيها شرفة؟

dialogue.speaker: Ruba
dialogue.en: No, there wasn't. And the heating was always broken in winter.
dialogue.ar: لا، لم تكن. وكانت التدفئة معطّلة دائماً في الشتاء.

dialogue.speaker: Sameer
dialogue.en: So that is why you moved.
dialogue.ar: إذن لهذا السبب انتقلتِ.

dialogue.speaker: Ruba
dialogue.en: Yes. There used to be a garden, though, and I miss it.
dialogue.ar: نعم. لكن كانت هناك حديقة فيما مضى، وأنا أفتقدها.

activities.prompt: What is Ruba comparing?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي تقارنه ربى؟
options: Her old building and her new flat
Two gardens on the same street
Two jobs in the same city
activities.answer: Her old building and her new flat
activities.audioTranscript: How is the new flat, Ruba? Much better. In the old building there wasn't a lift, and we were on the fourth floor. Was there a balcony? No, there wasn't. And the heating was always broken in winter. So that is why you moved. Yes. There used to be a garden, though, and I miss it.

activities.prompt: The old house had more than one bedroom. Choose the form that says so.
activities.promptAr: كان في المنزل القديم أكثر من غرفة نوم واحدة. اختر الصيغة التي تعبّر عن ذلك.
activities.text: There ___ three bedrooms in the old house, but only one bathroom.
options: were
was
are
activities.answer: were

activities.prompt: Match each sentence about an old home with the part that finishes it.
activities.promptAr: طابق كل جملة عن منزل قديم بالجزء الذي يكملها.
pairs: There wasn't a lift,
so we carried the shopping upstairs.
There were two long balconies,
and my mother grew flowers on both.
The heating was very old,
so the rooms were cold in January.

activities.prompt: How did the family keep warm in winter?
activities.promptAr: كيف كانت العائلة تتدفأ في الشتاء؟
options: They all sat in the kitchen
They closed the balcony door
They turned the heating on
activities.answer: They all sat in the kitchen
activities.audioTranscript: Before we moved to Basra, we lived in a small house in Duhok. There were two rooms and a long balcony at the back. There was no heating, so in winter we all sat in the kitchen next to the stove.

activities.prompt: Describe a home you lived in before. Say what there was, what there wasn't, and one thing you miss about it.
activities.promptAr: صف منزلاً سكنتَ فيه سابقاً. اذكر ما كان فيه، وما لم يكن فيه، وشيئاً واحداً تفتقده منه.

dialogue.speaker: Kamal
dialogue.en: How is your new neighbourhood, Nour?
dialogue.ar: كيف هو حيّكِ الجديد يا نور؟

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.en: Very convenient. There are a lot of small shops, and the market is close to us.
dialogue.ar: ملائم جداً. توجد متاجر صغيرة كثيرة، والسوق قريب منّا.

dialogue.speaker: Kamal
dialogue.en: Are there many buses?
dialogue.ar: وهل هناك حافلات كثيرة؟

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.en: Not many after nine, but the metro station is within walking distance.
dialogue.ar: ليست كثيرة بعد التاسعة، لكن محطة المترو على بعد مسافة قصيرة سيراً على الأقدام.

dialogue.speaker: Kamal
dialogue.en: And is there much noise at night?
dialogue.ar: وهل هناك ضجيج كثير في الليل؟

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.en: Not much. There is one café nearby, and it closes at eleven.
dialogue.ar: ليس كثيراً. يوجد مقهى واحد قريب، ويُغلق في الحادية عشرة.

activities.prompt: What is Kamal finding out about Nour's area?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي يكتشفه كمال عن منطقة نور؟
options: What is nearby and how busy it is
How much rent she pays
Which floor her flat is on
activities.answer: What is nearby and how busy it is
activities.audioTranscript: How is your new neighbourhood, Nour? Very convenient. There are a lot of small shops, and the market is close to us. Are there many buses? Not many after nine, but the metro station is within walking distance. And is there much noise at night? Not much. There is one café nearby, and it closes at eleven.

activities.prompt: Traffic is one thing you cannot count. Choose the word that fits it.
activities.promptAr: حركة المرور شيء لا يُعَدّ. اختر الكلمة المناسبة له.
activities.text: Is there ___ traffic on your street in the evening?
options: much
many
few
activities.answer: much

activities.prompt: Read the flat listing. What should a person with a car check first?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ إعلان الشقة. ما الذي يجب أن يتحقق منه صاحب السيارة أولاً؟
options: Whether a parking space is free
Whether there is a pharmacy
Whether the flat has two bedrooms
activities.answer: Whether a parking space is free
activities.sourceText: TO LET: two-bedroom flat, Al-Mansour. Third floor, no lift. A lot of natural light. The building has one shared facility, a roof terrace. Not many parking spaces. Bus stop and pharmacy within walking distance. 600,000 IQD monthly.

activities.prompt: What is this area short of?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي تفتقر إليه هذه المنطقة؟
options: Restaurants
Schools
Shops
activities.answer: Restaurants
activities.audioTranscript: I chose this neighbourhood because of the facilities. There are a lot of good schools, and there is a big park at the end of the road. There aren't many restaurants, but the supermarket is open until midnight, and that is enough for us.

activities.prompt: Answer Rana's questions about your area, then ask her one question about what she needs.
activities.promptAr: أجب عن أسئلة رنا حول منطقتك، ثم اسألها سؤالاً واحداً عمّا تحتاج إليه.
partnerTurns: Hello! I am looking at a flat in your street. What is the area like?
That sounds good. Is there much noise in the evening?
One more thing: are there many shops within walking distance? Tell me, and then ask me what I need.

dialogue.speaker: Ammar
dialogue.en: You know both areas, Suha. Which one should I choose?
dialogue.ar: أنتِ تعرفين المنطقتين يا سُها. أيّهما أختار؟

dialogue.speaker: Suha
dialogue.en: The riverside is greener, but it is not as cheap as Al-Jisr.
dialogue.ar: منطقة النهر أكثر خضرةً، لكنها ليست رخيصة مثل الجسر.

dialogue.speaker: Ammar
dialogue.en: Is it far from the hospital?
dialogue.ar: وهل هي بعيدة عن المستشفى؟

dialogue.speaker: Suha
dialogue.en: It is further, yes. Al-Jisr is more crowded, though, and less peaceful.
dialogue.ar: نعم، أبعد قليلاً. لكن الجسر أكثر ازدحاماً وأقلّ هدوءاً.

dialogue.speaker: Ammar
dialogue.en: So the riverside is quieter?
dialogue.ar: إذن منطقة النهر أهدأ؟

dialogue.speaker: Suha
dialogue.en: Much quieter. Compared with Al-Jisr, it feels like another city.
dialogue.ar: أهدأ بكثير. بالمقارنة مع الجسر، تبدو وكأنها مدينة أخرى.

activities.prompt: What are Ammar and Suha comparing?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي يقارنه عمّار وسُها؟
options: Two areas of the same city
Two flats in the same building
Two ways to reach the hospital
activities.answer: Two areas of the same city
activities.audioTranscript: You know both areas, Suha. Which one should I choose? The riverside is greener, but it is not as cheap as Al-Jisr. Is it far from the hospital? It is further, yes. Al-Jisr is more crowded, though, and less peaceful. So the riverside is quieter? Much quieter. Compared with Al-Jisr, it feels like another city.

activities.prompt: The two flats cost exactly the same. Choose the word that says so.
activities.promptAr: الشقتان تكلّفان المبلغ نفسه تماماً. اختر الكلمة التي تعبّر عن ذلك.
activities.text: The riverside flat is ___ expensive as the one on Al-Jisr Street.
options: as
more
than
activities.answer: as

activities.prompt: Read the two listings. Which home suits a family that wants space?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الإعلانين. أي منزل يناسب عائلة تريد مساحة؟
options: The Al-Jisr house
The riverside flat
Neither of them
activities.answer: The Al-Jisr house
activities.sourceText: Al-Jisr Street: a spacious three-bedroom house with a small garden, ten minutes from the market by bus. Riverside: a two-bedroom flat, not as big as the house, but the rooms are brighter and the street is much quieter at night.

activities.prompt: Why did the speaker choose Zayouna?
activities.promptAr: لماذا اختار المتحدث زيونة؟
options: He needs a quiet place to work
The flats there are bigger
There is a market on every corner
activities.answer: He needs a quiet place to work
activities.audioTranscript: I looked at two areas last month. Al-Karrada is livelier, and there is a market on every corner. But it is not as peaceful as Zayouna, and the flats there are smaller. In the end I chose Zayouna, because I work from home.

activities.prompt: Compare two areas you know. Say which one is cheaper, bigger or quieter, use not as ... as once, and say where you would live and why.
activities.promptAr: قارن بين منطقتين تعرفهما. قل أيّهما أرخص أو أوسع أو أهدأ، واستخدم not as ... as مرة واحدة، ثم قل أين تفضّل السكن ولماذا.

lessons.title: Too Small or Big Enough?
lessons.titleAr: صغير جداً أم كبير بما يكفي؟

dialogue.speaker: Fouad
dialogue.en: This is the living room. Is it bright enough for you?
dialogue.ar: هذه غرفة المعيشة. هل هي مضيئة بما يكفي بالنسبة لكِ؟

dialogue.speaker: Maryam
dialogue.en: Yes, but the kitchen is too small for three children.
dialogue.ar: نعم، لكن المطبخ صغير أكثر من اللازم لثلاثة أطفال.

dialogue.speaker: Fouad
dialogue.en: There is a storage space next to it.
dialogue.ar: توجد مساحة تخزين بجانبه.

dialogue.speaker: Maryam
dialogue.en: Good. Is the street noisy?
dialogue.ar: جيد. وهل الشارع صاخب؟

dialogue.speaker: Fouad
dialogue.en: Not in the day. At night the café below is too loud.
dialogue.ar: ليس في النهار. أما في الليل فالمقهى الذي في الأسفل صاخب أكثر من اللازم.

dialogue.speaker: Maryam
dialogue.en: Then the bedrooms are not quiet enough for us.
dialogue.ar: إذن غرف النوم ليست هادئة بما يكفي لنا.

activities.prompt: What is Maryam deciding?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي تقرّره مريم؟
options: Whether the flat suits her family
Which street is the cheapest
What time the café closes
activities.answer: Whether the flat suits her family
activities.audioTranscript: This is the living room. Is it bright enough for you? Yes, but the kitchen is too small for three children. There is a storage space next to it. Good. Is the street noisy? Not in the day. At night the café below is too loud. Then the bedrooms are not quiet enough for us.

activities.prompt: The room is a problem, not a good size. Choose the word that shows it.
activities.promptAr: الغرفة مشكلة، لا حجماً مناسباً. اختر الكلمة التي تُظهر ذلك.
activities.text: The second bedroom is ___ narrow for two beds.
options: too
enough
quite
activities.answer: too

activities.prompt: Listen to the voice message. Why is the speaker still unsure?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى الرسالة الصوتية. لماذا ما زالت المتحدثة مترددة؟
options: Her mother cannot climb five floors
The rooms are too dark
There is no storage at all
activities.answer: Her mother cannot climb five floors
activities.audioTranscript: I saw the flat on Palm Street this morning. The living room is bright enough and there is plenty of storage. But the building has no lift, and the fifth floor is too high for my mother. I am still thinking about it.

activities.prompt: Read the notice in the entrance hall. What must residents not do this week?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الإعلان المعلّق في مدخل البناية. ما الذي يُمنع على السكان فعله هذا الأسبوع؟
options: Leave bags on the stairs
Use the basement storage
Come home after midnight
activities.answer: Leave bags on the stairs
activities.sourceText: NOTICE TO ALL TENANTS. The lift will be switched off from Monday to Thursday for repairs. The stairs are wide enough for two people, but please do not leave bags on them. The basement storage will stay open. Sorry for the trouble. The Building Office.
