activities.prompt: You saw a flat yesterday with the friend who is moving with you. Write her a message. Say one thing that is good enough, two things that are too small, too noisy or too far, and what you want to do next.
activities.promptAr: شاهدتَ شقة أمس مع صديقتك التي ستنتقل معك. اكتب لها رسالة. اذكر شيئاً واحداً جيداً بما يكفي، وشيئين أصغر أو أصخب أو أبعد من اللازم، وما الذي تريد فعله بعد ذلك.

dialogue.speaker: Ilham
dialogue.en: Good morning, Mr Jabbar. There is a problem with the bathroom.
dialogue.ar: صباح الخير يا أستاذ جبّار. هناك مشكلة في الحمّام.

dialogue.speaker: Mr Jabbar
dialogue.en: What kind of problem?
dialogue.ar: أي نوع من المشاكل؟

dialogue.speaker: Ilham
dialogue.en: A pipe is leaking, and the wall behind it is damp.
dialogue.ar: هناك أنبوب يسرّب الماء، والجدار خلفه رطب.

dialogue.speaker: Mr Jabbar
dialogue.en: How long has it been like that?
dialogue.ar: منذ متى وهو على هذه الحال؟

dialogue.speaker: Ilham
dialogue.en: Since Sunday. Could you send someone to repair it this week?
dialogue.ar: منذ يوم الأحد. هل يمكنك أن ترسل أحداً لإصلاحه هذا الأسبوع؟

dialogue.speaker: Mr Jabbar
dialogue.en: I will call the plumber today. He can come tomorrow morning.
dialogue.ar: سأتصل بالسبّاك اليوم. يستطيع أن يأتي صباح الغد.

activities.prompt: Why is Ilham calling?
activities.promptAr: لماذا تتصل إلهام؟
options: To report a leak in the bathroom
To ask when the rent is due
To say that she is leaving the flat
activities.answer: To report a leak in the bathroom
activities.audioTranscript: Good morning, Mr Jabbar. There is a problem with the bathroom. What kind of problem? A pipe is leaking, and the wall behind it is damp. How long has it been like that? Since Sunday. Could you send someone to repair it this week? I will call the plumber today. He can come tomorrow morning.

activities.prompt: Put this polite request to the landlord in the correct order.
activities.promptAr: رتّب هذا الطلب المهذّب الموجّه إلى مالك العقار بالترتيب الصحيح.

activities.prompt: Read the note your neighbour left. What does Hala want you to do?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الملاحظة التي تركتها جارتك. ماذا تريد منك هالة أن تفعل؟
options: Look at the taps in your bathroom
Call the landlord for her
Pay for a new ceiling
activities.answer: Look at the taps in your bathroom
activities.sourceText: Note from flat 4: Dear neighbour, water is coming through my ceiling, and I think it comes from your bathroom. I told the landlord yesterday, but nobody called me back. Could you check your taps tonight? Thank you. Hala.

activities.prompt: When can the engineer visit Adnan?
activities.promptAr: متى يستطيع الفني زيارة عدنان؟
options: In the afternoon
Only on Friday
At the weekend
activities.answer: In the afternoon
activities.audioTranscript: Hello, this is Adnan from flat 12. The heating stopped on Friday, and the children's room is very cold. I tried the switch, but nothing happened. Could you send an engineer as soon as possible? I am at home every afternoon this week.

activities.prompt: Phone the letting office about a problem in your flat. Say what the problem is, explain how it affects you, and make a polite request.
activities.promptAr: اتصل بمكتب التأجير بشأن مشكلة في شقتك. قل ما هي المشكلة، واشرح كيف تؤثر عليك، ثم قدّم طلباً مهذّباً.
partnerTurns: Hello, this is the letting office. How can I help you?
I see. And how long has this been a problem?
All right. Tell me exactly what you want us to do, and when we can come.

readingText.title: Which Home for Samar?
readingText.text: Samar, I looked at both options yesterday. The Karrada flat is furnished and the rent is 550 a month, with bills included. It is not as quiet as the other one, but it is only ten minutes from your office. The Zayouna flat is cheaper and more spacious, and the street is peaceful. However, it is unfurnished, the deposit is two months, and there is no bus after nine. For you, I recommend Karrada. The rent is higher, but you will not need a car.
readingText.textAr: سمر، نظرتُ إلى الخيارين أمس. شقة الكرادة مفروشة، وإيجارها 550 في الشهر مع الفواتير. هي ليست هادئة مثل الشقة الأخرى، لكنها على بعد عشر دقائق فقط من مكتبكِ. شقة زيونة أرخص وأوسع، والشارع فيها هادئ. لكنها غير مفروشة، والتأمين إيجار شهرين، ولا توجد حافلة بعد التاسعة. بالنسبة لكِ، أنصحكِ بالكرادة: الإيجار أعلى، لكنكِ لن تحتاجي إلى سيارة.

activities.prompt: Read the message once. What is the writer doing?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الرسالة مرة واحدة. ماذا يفعل كاتبها؟
options: Recommending one of two flats
Asking Samar to lend her money
Describing her own new home
activities.answer: Recommending one of two flats

activities.prompt: Listen to the agent's voice note. What is the problem with the house?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى الرسالة الصوتية من الوكيلة. ما المشكلة في المنزل؟
options: The deposit is very high
Somebody has already rented it
It has no furniture at all
activities.answer: The deposit is very high
activities.audioTranscript: Hello, this is Widad from the agency. The house you liked is still free, but the owner wants three months' deposit. There is a smaller flat on the same street for less money, and it is furnished. Shall I book a viewing for Saturday?

activities.prompt: Before you write anything, say your recommendation aloud, the way the message does. Compare two homes, then say which one you recommend and why.
activities.promptAr: قبل أن تكتب شيئاً، قل توصيتك بصوت عالٍ كما فعلت الرسالة. قارن بين منزلين، ثم قل بأيّهما توصي ولماذا.

activities.prompt: Your friend Bilal does not read English, and this listing is on the door of the bakery. Tell him what the flat costs, what is included, what the deposit is, and when he can see it.
activities.promptAr: صديقك بلال لا يقرأ الإنجليزية، وهذا الإعلان معلّق على باب المخبز. أخبره كم يكلّف إيجار الشقة، وما الذي يشمله، وكم مبلغ التأمين، ومتى يستطيع معاينتها.
activities.sourceCard: FOR RENT: one-bedroom flat above the bakery, Al-Wahda Street. Furnished. 400,000 IQD monthly, bills included. Deposit: one month. No pets. The room at the back is not as bright as the front one. Viewings Thursday and Friday only. Call Um Ahmed.

activities.prompt: Now write your own recommendation to a friend who is moving. Compare two homes, say which one you recommend, give your reason, and warn her about one thing she should check.
activities.promptAr: اكتب الآن توصيتك أنتَ إلى صديقة ستنتقل إلى سكن جديد. قارن بين منزلين، وقل بأيّهما توصي، واذكر سببك، ونبّهها إلى أمر واحد عليها التحقق منه.

lessons.title: Mission: Choose Between Two Homes
lessons.scenario: A friend is moving. Compare two unseen listings, discuss needs, identify a possible problem and recommend the better home.

activities.prompt: Read the two listings your friend sent. Which home is harder for someone carrying a heavy suitcase?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الإعلانين اللذين أرسلتهما صديقتك. أي منزل أصعب على من يحمل حقيبة ثقيلة؟
options: Home A
Home B
Both are the same
activities.answer: Home A
activities.sourceText: HOME A, Riverside: two bedrooms, third floor, no lift, 620 a month, bills not included. Quiet street, small balcony. HOME B, Centre: one large room, ground floor, 510 a month, bills included. Buses and shops at the door, but the street is crowded until midnight.

activities.prompt: Listen to Yara's voice message. What does she need that neither home gives her?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة يارا الصوتية. ما الذي تحتاجه ولا يوفره لها أيّ من المنزلين؟
options: A separate place to work
A second bathroom
A balcony
activities.answer: A separate place to work
activities.audioTranscript: It's Yara. I looked at both places again today. Home A has a real kitchen, but there isn't enough space for my desk in either bedroom. Home B is one room, so I would work and sleep in the same place. Tell me honestly what you think.

activities.prompt: Talk to Yara about the two homes. Ask her what matters most to her, then give the advantages and the disadvantages of each one.
activities.promptAr: تحدّث إلى يارا عن المنزلين. اسألها ما الأهم بالنسبة لها، ثم اذكر مزايا كل منزل وعيوبه.
partnerTurns: Thanks for looking at them for me. Before you say anything, ask me what matters most.
Well, I work from home four days a week, and my mother visits every weekend.
Money is not the main thing. So which one, and why?

activities.prompt: Give Yara your recommendation, one to two minutes long. Compare the two homes, say clearly which one she should take, and give a practical reason.
activities.promptAr: قدّم ليارا توصيتك، في دقيقة إلى دقيقتين. قارن بين المنزلين، وقل بوضوح أيّهما ينبغي أن تأخذ، واذكر سبباً عملياً.

activities.prompt: Yara cannot read the owner's English. Tell her the new rent and its condition, what the deposit is, what will change in March, and the two rules.
activities.promptAr: يارا لا تستطيع قراءة رسالة المالك بالإنجليزية. أخبرها بالإيجار الجديد وشرطه، وبمبلغ التأمين، وبما سيتغيّر في آذار، وبالقاعدتين.
activities.sourceCard: Reply from the owner of Home A: I can lower the rent to 590 if your friend signs for two years. The deposit is one month. The lift will be repaired in March. I cannot allow pets, and the rent does not include water.

activities.prompt: Write Yara your recommendation. Compare the two homes, choose one for her, give your reason, and warn her about one possible problem.
activities.promptAr: اكتب ليارا توصيتك. قارن بين المنزلين، واختر أحدهما لها، واذكر سببك، ونبّهها إلى مشكلة محتملة واحدة.

dialogue.speaker: Tareq
dialogue.en: Hadeel, how much flour do we need for this dough?
dialogue.ar: هديل، كم نحتاج من الطحين لهذه العجينة؟

dialogue.speaker: Hadeel
dialogue.en: Six hundred grams. There isn't much sugar left, but the dough doesn't need a lot of it.
dialogue.ar: ستمئة غرام. لم يبقَ سكر كثير، لكن العجينة لا تحتاج الكثير منه.

dialogue.speaker: Tareq
dialogue.en: And how many eggs do we need?
dialogue.ar: وكم بيضة نحتاج؟

dialogue.speaker: Hadeel
dialogue.en: Four. Look in the fridge door, please.
dialogue.ar: أربع بيضات. انظرْ في باب الثلاجة من فضلك.

dialogue.speaker: Tareq
dialogue.en: There are only two. How many spices does the filling take?
dialogue.ar: لا توجد إلا بيضتان. وكم نوعاً من البهارات تحتاج الحشوة؟

dialogue.speaker: Hadeel
dialogue.en: A lot of them, but buy them at the stall near the gate — they're cheaper there.
dialogue.ar: الكثير منها، لكن اشترِها من البسطة القريبة من البوابة، فهي أرخص هناك.

activities.prompt: What are Tareq and Hadeel working out?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي يحاول طارق وهديل تحديده؟
options: How much of each ingredient they have
Which restaurant to order the lunch from
How long the family lunch will take
activities.answer: How much of each ingredient they have
activities.audioTranscript: Hadeel, how much flour do we need for this dough? Six hundred grams. There isn't much sugar left, but the dough doesn't need a lot of it. And how many eggs do we need? Four. Look in the fridge door, please. There are only two. How many spices does the filling take? A lot of them, but buy them at the stall near the gate — they're cheaper there.

activities.prompt: Ingredients can be counted one by one. Choose the word that fits them.
activities.promptAr: المكوّنات تُعَدّ واحداً واحداً. اختر الكلمة التي تناسبها.
activities.text: How ___ ingredients does this bread need?
options: many
much
a lot
activities.answer: many

activities.prompt: Match each sentence about the shopping with the part that finishes it.
activities.promptAr: طابق كل جملة عن التسوّق بالجزء الذي يكملها.
pairs: There isn't much flour left,
so we can only make half the dough.
There are a lot of spices at the stall,
but this dish needs only three of them.
How many grams of cheese did you buy,
and is that enough for six people?

activities.prompt: Listen to the voice message. What does the speaker want a lot of?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى الرسالة الصوتية. ما الذي يريده المتحدث بكمية كبيرة؟
options: Tomatoes
Onions
Oil
activities.answer: Tomatoes
activities.audioTranscript: Before you come home, go to the market for me. We need a lot of tomatoes — two kilos is fine. Do not buy many onions; three are enough. Buy two hundred grams of white cheese, and only a little oil, because we still have some. The spices at the stall by the gate are fresher, so buy the black pepper there.

activities.prompt: Describe a dish you cook often. Say how much of two ingredients it needs, how many of one more, and where you buy them.
activities.promptAr: صف طبقاً تطبخه كثيراً. قل كم يحتاج من مكوّنين، وكم عدد مكوّن ثالث، ومن أين تشتريها.

dialogue.speaker: Sawsan
dialogue.en: Put the big pot on the heat first, Yousef, and boil two litres of water.
dialogue.ar: ضَعْ القِدر الكبير على النار أولاً يا يوسف، واغلِ لترين من الماء.

dialogue.speaker: Yousef
dialogue.en: Should I chop the vegetables now?
dialogue.ar: هل أفرم الخضار الآن؟

dialogue.speaker: Sawsan
dialogue.en: Chop them while the water heats. Then mix the spices with a little oil.
dialogue.ar: افرمها بينما يسخن الماء. ثم اخلط البهارات مع قليل من الزيت.

dialogue.speaker: Yousef
dialogue.en: And when does the rice go into the pot?
dialogue.ar: ومتى يدخل الأرز في القِدر؟

dialogue.speaker: Sawsan
dialogue.en: After the water boils. Stir it once, then cook it for twelve minutes.
dialogue.ar: بعد أن يغلي الماء. حرّكه مرة واحدة، ثم اطبخه اثنتي عشرة دقيقة.

dialogue.speaker: Yousef
dialogue.en: And finally I add the vegetables and the sauce?
dialogue.ar: وأخيراً أضيف الخضار والصلصة؟

dialogue.speaker: Sawsan
dialogue.en: Exactly. Mix everything gently and leave it for five minutes.
dialogue.ar: بالضبط. اخلط كل شيء بلطف واتركه خمس دقائق.

activities.prompt: What is Sawsan doing?
activities.promptAr: ماذا تفعل سوسن؟
options: Guiding Yousef through the steps of a dish
Ordering a meal for the whole class
Explaining why the pot is broken
activities.answer: Guiding Yousef through the steps of a dish
activities.audioTranscript: Put the big pot on the heat first, Yousef, and boil two litres of water. Should I chop the vegetables now? Chop them while the water heats. Then mix the spices with a little oil. And when does the rice go into the pot? After the water boils. Stir it once, then cook it for twelve minutes. And finally I add the vegetables and the sauce? Exactly. Mix everything gently and leave it for five minutes.

activities.prompt: Put this instruction from a recipe card in the correct order.
activities.promptAr: رتّب هذه التعليمة من بطاقة وصفة بالترتيب الصحيح.

activities.prompt: A recipe gives its steps as orders, not as descriptions. Choose the right form.
activities.promptAr: الوصفة تعطي خطواتها بصيغة الأمر لا بصيغة الوصف. اختر الصيغة الصحيحة.
activities.text: ___ the sauce for two minutes, then turn off the heat.
options: Stir
Stirs
Stirring
activities.answer: Stir

activities.prompt: Listen to the recipe. What is the last step before the guests eat?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى الوصفة. ما الخطوة الأخيرة قبل أن يأكل الضيوف؟
options: Letting the cake cool
Adding the flour
Heating the oven
activities.answer: Letting the cake cool
activities.audioTranscript: This is how my mother makes her tea cake. First, mix three eggs with a cup of sugar for two minutes. Then add the flour slowly and stir until it is smooth. Put it in a hot oven for half an hour. Finally, leave it on the table to cool, and cut it when your guests arrive.

activities.prompt: Your friend is cooking and phones you for help. Answer her questions and give the steps in order.
activities.promptAr: صديقتك تطبخ وتتصل بك طلباً للمساعدة. أجب عن أسئلتها واذكر الخطوات بالترتيب.
partnerTurns: Hi! I have rice, an onion and some tomatoes. What do I do first?
The onion is in the pot now. What comes next?
It smells good. Tell me the last two steps and how long they take.

dialogue.speaker: Ziad
dialogue.en: Is there enough for dinner, Rania?
dialogue.ar: هل يوجد ما يكفي للعشاء يا رانيا؟

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.en: A little rice, a few eggs and half a bottle of oil.
dialogue.ar: قليل من الأرز، وبضع بيضات، ونصف زجاجة من الزيت.

dialogue.speaker: Ziad
dialogue.en: There's a piece of cheese too, and a few olives.
dialogue.ar: وهناك قطعة من الجبن أيضاً، وبضع حبات من الزيتون.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.en: Good. Taste the sauce, please — I think it needs a little bit of salt.
dialogue.ar: جيد. تذوّق الصلصة من فضلك، أظن أنها تحتاج قليلاً من الملح.

dialogue.speaker: Ziad
dialogue.en: It's fine now. The bread isn't fresh, though, so I only want a slice of it.
dialogue.ar: صارت جيدة الآن. لكن الخبز ليس طازجاً، لذلك لا أريد منه إلا شريحة واحدة.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.en: Then buy a fresh one tomorrow, and a few tomatoes from the market.
dialogue.ar: إذن اشترِ خبزاً طازجاً غداً، وبضع حبات من الطماطم من السوق.

activities.prompt: What are Rania and Ziad deciding?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي تقرره رانيا وزياد؟
options: Whether they can cook dinner with what is left
Which restaurant to book for the evening
How much the shopping cost last week
activities.answer: Whether they can cook dinner with what is left
activities.audioTranscript: Is there enough for dinner, Rania? A little rice, a few eggs and half a bottle of oil. There's a piece of cheese too, and a few olives. Good. Taste the sauce, please — I think it needs a little bit of salt. It's fine now. The bread isn't fresh, though, so I only want a slice of it. Then buy a fresh one tomorrow, and a few tomatoes from the market.

activities.prompt: Sugar cannot be counted one by one. Choose the words that fit it.
activities.promptAr: السكر لا يُعَدّ حبةً حبة. اختر العبارة المناسبة له.
activities.text: Add ___ sugar to the sauce, but not too much.
options: a little
a few
many
activities.answer: a little

activities.prompt: Read the board outside the café. Which dish suits a guest who cannot eat much salt?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ اللوحة المعلّقة خارج المقهى. أي طبق يناسب ضيفاً لا يستطيع تناول الكثير من الملح؟
options: The village salad
The grilled fish
The lentil soup
activities.answer: The village salad
activities.sourceText: THE RIVER CAFE, TODAY. Village salad: fresh tomatoes, a few olives, no salt added. Lentil soup: a little salt, served with a slice of bread. Grilled fish: salty sauce and a piece of lemon. Tea or juice with every meal.

activities.prompt: Listen to the cook. What does she use instead of salt?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى الطاهية. ما الذي تستخدمه بدلاً من الملح؟
options: Herbs and lemon
More butter
Two small portions
activities.answer: Herbs and lemon
activities.audioTranscript: I cook for my grandmother every Sunday, and her doctor told her to eat less salt. So I use a few herbs instead: a little parsley, a few mint leaves and half a lemon. I still add a piece of butter at the end, because she says food without it tastes of nothing. She eats two small portions and leaves the rest for Monday.

activities.prompt: Look in your own kitchen. Say what there is a little of, what there is a few of, and one dish you could make with them.
activities.promptAr: تفقّد مطبخك أنت. قل ما الذي يوجد منه قليل، وما الذي توجد منه بضع قطع، وطبقاً واحداً يمكنك إعداده منها.

dialogue.speaker: Muna
dialogue.en: Hello, I'm calling about our delivery. It arrived twenty minutes ago.
dialogue.ar: مرحباً، أتصل بخصوص طلب التوصيل. وصل قبل عشرين دقيقة.

dialogue.speaker: Bashar
dialogue.en: Is there a problem with it, madam?
dialogue.ar: هل هناك مشكلة فيه يا سيدتي؟

dialogue.speaker: Muna
dialogue.en: Yes. This isn't what I ordered. I asked for two vegetable meals, and you sent me chicken.
dialogue.ar: نعم. هذا ليس ما طلبته. طلبتُ وجبتَي خضار، وأنتم أرسلتم لي دجاجاً.

dialogue.speaker: Bashar
dialogue.en: I apologise. Did the salad reach you?
dialogue.ar: أعتذر. وهل وصلتكِ السلطة؟

dialogue.speaker: Muna
dialogue.en: No — something is missing. The salad isn't here, but there is an extra soup.
dialogue.ar: لا، هناك شيء ناقص. السلطة غير موجودة، لكن هناك حساء إضافي.

dialogue.speaker: Bashar
dialogue.en: I'll send the driver back with your two meals, and he will take the soup.
dialogue.ar: سأرسل السائق مرة أخرى بوجبتيكِ، وسيأخذ الحساء.

activities.prompt: Why is Muna calling the delivery office?
activities.promptAr: لماذا تتصل منى بمكتب التوصيل؟
options: The food is wrong and one item is missing
She wants to order more food for tomorrow
She wants to pay for the meal by card
activities.answer: The food is wrong and one item is missing
activities.audioTranscript: Hello, I'm calling about our delivery. It arrived twenty minutes ago. Is there a problem with it, madam? Yes. This isn't what I ordered. I asked for two vegetable meals, and you sent me chicken. I apologise. Did the salad reach you? No — something is missing. The salad isn't here, but there is an extra soup. I'll send the driver back with your two meals, and he will take the soup.

activities.prompt: Two juices is more than one thing. Choose the pronoun that stands for both.
activities.promptAr: عصيران شيئان لا شيء واحد. اختر الضمير الذي يحل محلهما.
activities.text: We ordered two juices, but the driver forgot ___.
options: them
it
us
activities.answer: them

activities.prompt: Listen to the manager's message to the kitchen staff. What must they do when something is missing?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة المدير لعمّال المطبخ. ماذا عليهم أن يفعلوا عندما ينقص شيء؟
options: Tell the customer before the customer calls
Send the driver home for the evening
Write a new menu for the week
activities.answer: Tell the customer before the customer calls
activities.audioTranscript: Team, listen before the evening shift. A customer called this afternoon: we sent her chicken instead of vegetables, and we forgot her salad. Read every order twice before it leaves the kitchen, and count the boxes with the driver. If something is missing, tell the customer first; do not wait for them to call us.

activities.prompt: Read the order summary from the app. What did the kitchen send by mistake?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ ملخّص الطلب من التطبيق. ما الذي أرسله المطبخ بالخطأ؟
options: Chicken meals and a soup
Two bottles of water
A green salad
activities.answer: Chicken meals and a soup
activities.sourceText: ORDER 4482 — Muna A. Ordered: 2 x vegetable meal, 1 x green salad, 2 x water. Delivered: 2 x chicken meal, 1 x lentil soup, 2 x water. Note from the driver: one extra soup and no salad. The customer refused the chicken.

activities.prompt: Write a message to the restaurant about a delivery that went wrong. Say what you ordered, what arrived, what is missing, and what you want them to do.
activities.promptAr: اكتب رسالة إلى المطعم عن طلب توصيل وصل خاطئاً. اذكر ما طلبته، وما الذي وصل، وما هو الناقص، وما تريد منهم أن يفعلوه.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.en: Excuse me, could I speak to the manager, please?
dialogue.ar: عفواً، هل يمكنني التحدث إلى المدير من فضلك؟

dialogue.speaker: Faris
dialogue.en: I am the manager. How can I help you?
dialogue.ar: أنا المدير. كيف أستطيع مساعدتكِ؟

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.en: We waited fifty minutes for the fish, and it arrived cold.
dialogue.ar: انتظرنا السمك خمسين دقيقة، ووصل بارداً.

dialogue.speaker: Faris
dialogue.en: I am very sorry. Could I replace it with a hot one?
dialogue.ar: أنا آسف جداً. هل يمكنني أن أستبدله بآخر ساخن؟

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.en: We have finished now. Could you take it off the bill instead?
dialogue.ar: لقد انتهينا الآن. هل يمكنك أن تحذفه من الفاتورة بدلاً من ذلك؟

dialogue.speaker: Faris
dialogue.en: Of course. I will remove the fish and the service charge, and bring you tea.
dialogue.ar: بالتأكيد. سأحذف السمك ورسوم الخدمة، وسأحضر لكِ الشاي.

activities.prompt: What does Nadia want the manager to do?
activities.promptAr: ماذا تريد نادية من المدير أن يفعل؟
options: Change the bill
Give her a table by the window
Bring her a different menu
activities.answer: Change the bill
activities.audioTranscript: Excuse me, could I speak to the manager, please? I am the manager. How can I help you? We waited fifty minutes for the fish, and it arrived cold. I am very sorry. Could I replace it with a hot one? We have finished now. Could you take it off the bill instead? Of course. I will remove the fish and the service charge, and bring you tea.

activities.prompt: Put this polite request to a server in the correct order.
activities.promptAr: رتّب هذا الطلب المهذّب الموجّه إلى النادل بالترتيب الصحيح.

activities.prompt: Read the restaurant's written reply. What is it offering Nadia?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ رد المطعم المكتوب. ما الذي يعرضه على نادية؟
options: A free dessert on her next visit
A refund for the whole meal
A different table for tonight
activities.answer: A free dessert on her next visit
activities.sourceText: Dear Nadia, thank you for your complaint. We are sorry that your fish was cold. We have removed it from your bill, but we cannot give a refund for the meals you ate. Please accept a free dessert on your next visit. The River Restaurant.

activities.prompt: Listen to the voicemail from the café. What will the café do?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى الرسالة الصوتية من المقهى. ما الذي سيفعله المقهى؟
options: Send the money back to the card
Bake a new cake this week
Deliver two more portions tomorrow
activities.answer: Send the money back to the card
activities.audioTranscript: Good afternoon, this is Salma from the Palm Cafe. You left a complaint about the birthday cake we delivered on Saturday. You are right: we used the wrong sauce, and two portions were broken. We cannot replace the cake this week, so we will send a refund to your card by Thursday. Please call me if that does not suit you.

activities.prompt: Phone a restaurant about a meal that was wrong. Say what happened, make a polite request, and agree on what they will do.
activities.promptAr: اتصل بمطعم بشأن وجبة كانت خاطئة. قل ما الذي حدث، وقدّم طلباً مهذّباً، واتفق على ما سيفعلونه.
partnerTurns: Good evening, this is the Palm Restaurant. How can I help you?
I am sorry to hear that. What would you like us to do?
I can do that. Tell me your name and when you can come, and I will write it down.

readingText.title: Lentil Soup for Four
readingText.text: Hala, this is the lentil soup you liked on Friday. The recipe serves four people, and one portion is enough for a light dinner. You need two cups of red lentils, one onion, a few carrots, a piece of ginger, a little salt and one and a half litres of water. The method is simple. First, chop the onion and the carrots, and fry them for three minutes. Then add the lentils, the ginger and the water, and boil everything for twenty-five minutes. Finally, mix the soup until it is smooth, and serve it with a slice of warm bread. Do not add much salt at the start; taste it at the end.
readingText.textAr: هالة، هذا حساء العدس الذي أعجبكِ يوم الجمعة. الوصفة تكفي أربعة أشخاص، وحصة واحدة تكفي لعشاء خفيف. تحتاجين إلى كوبين من العدس الأحمر، وبصلة واحدة، وبضع جزرات، وقطعة من الزنجبيل، وقليل من الملح، ولتر ونصف من الماء. الطريقة بسيطة. أولاً، افرمي البصل والجزر واقليهما ثلاث دقائق. ثم أضيفي العدس والزنجبيل والماء، واغلي كل شيء خمساً وعشرين دقيقة. وأخيراً، اخلطي الحساء حتى يصير ناعماً، وقدّميه مع شريحة من الخبز الدافئ. لا تضيفي ملحاً كثيراً في البداية، وتذوّقيه في النهاية.

activities.prompt: Read the message once. What is the writer doing for Hala?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الرسالة مرة واحدة. ماذا يفعل كاتبها من أجل هالة؟
options: Writing out a recipe she asked for
Inviting her to dinner on Friday
Complaining about a restaurant meal
activities.answer: Writing out a recipe she asked for

activities.prompt: Listen to the voice note that came after the message. What can replace the ginger?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى الرسالة الصوتية التي تلت الرسالة المكتوبة. ما الذي يمكن أن يحلّ محل الزنجبيل؟
options: A little black pepper
A few pieces of potato
The water from the lentils
activities.answer: A little black pepper
activities.audioTranscript: One more thing about the soup. If you cannot find ginger, use a little black pepper instead; it is not the same, but it is good. My sister adds a few pieces of potato, and then it serves six. And do not throw away the water from the lentils. Keep it, and add it slowly while you mix.

activities.prompt: Before you write anything, say your own recipe aloud the way the message does: how many it serves, what it needs, and the steps in order.
activities.promptAr: قبل أن تكتب شيئاً، قل وصفتك أنت بصوت عالٍ كما فعلت الرسالة: كم شخصاً تكفي، وما الذي تحتاجه، والخطوات بالترتيب.

activities.prompt: Your neighbour Um Kareem cannot read the English on this packet. Tell her how many it serves, what she must add, how long it cooks, and the warning at the bottom.
activities.promptAr: جارتك أم كريم لا تستطيع قراءة الإنجليزية المكتوبة على هذه العبوة. أخبرها كم شخصاً تكفي، وما الذي عليها إضافته، وكم مدة الطهي، وما التحذير المكتوب في الأسفل.
activities.sourceCard: QUICK BEAN MIX — serves three. Add one bottle of cold water and two spoons of oil. Boil for fifteen minutes, then stir and leave it for five. Do not add salt: the mix already contains a lot. Keep the packet closed in a dry place.

activities.prompt: Now write your own recipe for a friend. Give it a title, say how many it serves, list what it needs with the amounts, and put the steps in order.
activities.promptAr: اكتب الآن وصفتك أنت لصديق. ضع لها عنواناً، وقل كم شخصاً تكفي، واذكر ما تحتاجه مع الكميات، ورتّب الخطوات.

lessons.title: Mission: Cook and Resolve an Order Error
lessons.titleAr: المهمة: اطبخ وحل خطأ في الطلب
lessons.scenario: Plan a simple meal from a recipe, explain its method, then handle an unexpected restaurant order problem.

activities.prompt: Read the recipe card for tonight. What must you buy on the day itself?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ بطاقة وصفة هذه الليلة. ما الذي يجب شراؤه في اليوم نفسه؟
options: The chicken
The rice
The tomato sauce
activities.answer: The chicken
activities.sourceText: FAMILY RICE WITH CHICKEN — serves five. 500 grams of rice, one bottle of tomato sauce, a few carrots, a little cumin and a piece of butter. Buy the chicken fresh on the day; everything else can wait in the cupboard. Cooking time: forty minutes.

activities.prompt: Listen to Samia's message. What is wrong with the delivery?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة سامية. ما الخطأ في طلب التوصيل؟
options: Two plates are meat instead of vegetable, and the bread is missing
The whole order arrived an hour late
They sent rice when nobody ordered any
activities.answer: Two plates are meat instead of vegetable, and the bread is missing
activities.audioTranscript: It's Samia. I ordered the extra dishes from the restaurant for tonight, and the delivery came ten minutes ago. They sent four meat plates, but we asked for two meat and two vegetable, because Nabil does not eat meat. The bread is missing as well. I am cooking the rice now, so could you call them and sort it out?

activities.prompt: Phone the restaurant about Samia's order. Explain the mistake, answer the server's question, and agree on a solution.
activities.promptAr: اتصل بالمطعم بشأن طلب سامية. اشرح الخطأ، وأجب عن سؤال النادل، واتفق على حل.
partnerTurns: Palm Restaurant, good evening. Do you have the order number?
I see. So which plates are wrong, and what is missing?
We can send a driver in twenty minutes, or take it off your bill. Which do you prefer, and why?

activities.prompt: Explain tonight's dish to a friend who wants to cook it. Give the amounts, the steps in order, and one thing not to do.
activities.promptAr: اشرح طبق هذه الليلة لصديق يريد طبخه. اذكر الكميات، والخطوات بالترتيب، وأمراً واحداً يجب تجنّبه.

activities.prompt: Samia cannot read the restaurant's English reply. Tell her what they are sending, what they will not charge for, when the driver comes, and the one thing they need from her.
activities.promptAr: سامية لا تستطيع قراءة رد المطعم بالإنجليزية. أخبرها بما سيرسلونه، وبما لن يحاسبوها عليه، ومتى يصل السائق، وبالأمر الوحيد الذي يريدونه منها.
activities.sourceCard: Reply from the Palm Restaurant: we are sending two vegetable plates and the bread now. We will not charge for the two meat plates you did not order. The driver leaves in twenty minutes. Please give him the wrong plates at the door.

activities.prompt: Write one message to Samia. Give the recipe steps for tonight in order, then say what you agreed with the restaurant about the wrong order.
activities.promptAr: اكتب رسالة واحدة إلى سامية. اذكر خطوات وصفة هذه الليلة بالترتيب، ثم قل ما اتفقت عليه مع المطعم بشأن الطلب الخطأ.

dialogue.speaker: Faris
dialogue.en: Have you chosen a destination for the holiday yet?
dialogue.ar: هل اخترتِ وجهة العطلة بعد؟

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.en: Petra. We're going to stay overnight there, then drive south.
dialogue.ar: البتراء. سنبيت هناك ليلة واحدة ثم نتجه جنوباً بالسيارة.

dialogue.speaker: Faris
dialogue.en: Two days is short. Which sights are you going to see?
dialogue.ar: يومان وقت قصير. أي المعالم ستزورين؟

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.en: Only three. I plan to book everything in advance this time.
dialogue.ar: ثلاثة فقط. أنوي حجز كل شيء مسبقاً هذه المرة.

dialogue.speaker: Faris
dialogue.en: Send me the itinerary. I know a good place for breakfast.
dialogue.ar: أرسلي لي برنامج الرحلة. أعرف مكاناً جيداً للإفطار.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.en: I'll write it tonight. It's not a long one.
dialogue.ar: سأكتبه الليلة. ليس برنامجاً طويلاً.

activities.prompt: What are Faris and Nadia arranging?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي يرتّبه فارس ونادية؟
options: A short holiday Nadia has decided to take
A work trip Faris cannot avoid
A hotel booking that went wrong
activities.answer: A short holiday Nadia has decided to take
activities.audioTranscript: Have you chosen a destination for the holiday yet? Petra. We're going to stay overnight there, then drive south. Two days is short. Which sights are you going to see? Only three. I plan to book everything in advance this time. Send me the itinerary. I know a good place for breakfast. I'll write it tonight. It's not a long one.

activities.prompt: The decision was made last week. Choose the form that shows it.
activities.promptAr: القرار اتُّخذ الأسبوع الماضي. اختر الصيغة التي تدل على ذلك.
activities.text: They ___ see only three sights, because the trip is short.
options: are going to
are go to
goes to
activities.answer: are going to

activities.prompt: Match each reason to the intention it explains.
activities.promptAr: طابق كل سبب بالنية التي يفسّرها.
pairs: The market closes at four,
so we are going to go straight there.
I don't want to drive all night,
so we are staying overnight in Karak.
She has no destination yet,
but she plans to decide this week.

activities.prompt: Listen to Rami's message. Why is he driving instead of taking the train?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة رامي. لماذا سيقود سيارته بدل أن يأخذ القطار؟
options: He wants to stop at his aunt's house on the way
The train is more expensive this month
His brother cannot travel by train
activities.answer: He wants to stop at his aunt's house on the way
activities.audioTranscript: Hi, it's Rami. About next weekend, I'm going to drive, not take the train, because I want to stop at my aunt's house on the way. I'll leave on Friday at six and stay overnight in Karak. If you want a seat, tell me before Wednesday, because my brother is asking for one too.

activities.prompt: Tell a friend about a short trip you have decided to take. Say where you are going, how long you are going to stay, and two things you plan to do there.
activities.promptAr: أخبر صديقاً برحلة قصيرة قررت القيام بها. قل إلى أين ستذهب، وكم ستبقى، وأمرين تنوي فعلهما هناك.

dialogue.speaker: Salma
dialogue.en: Good morning. I'd like to book a room for the fourteenth.
dialogue.ar: صباح الخير. أريد حجز غرفة ليوم الرابع عشر.

dialogue.speaker: Hisham
dialogue.en: Do you have a reservation with us already, madam?
dialogue.ar: هل لديكِ حجز عندنا من قبل يا سيدتي؟

dialogue.speaker: Salma
dialogue.en: No. Do you have a twin room available for two nights?
dialogue.ar: لا. هل لديكم غرفة بسريرين متاحة لليلتين؟

dialogue.speaker: Hisham
dialogue.en: We do. What time are you arriving on the fourteenth?
dialogue.ar: نعم لدينا. في أي ساعة ستصلين يوم الرابع عشر؟

dialogue.speaker: Salma
dialogue.en: We're taking the late bus, so we check in around ten.
dialogue.ar: سنأخذ الحافلة المتأخرة، لذا سنسجّل الوصول حوالي العاشرة.

dialogue.speaker: Hisham
dialogue.en: That's fine. The accommodation includes breakfast until nine.
dialogue.ar: لا مشكلة. الإقامة تشمل الإفطار حتى التاسعة.

dialogue.speaker: Salma
dialogue.en: Perfect. I'm sending my details now.
dialogue.ar: ممتاز. سأرسل بياناتي الآن.

activities.prompt: What is Salma doing on the phone?
activities.promptAr: ماذا تفعل سلمى في المكالمة؟
options: Making a booking she does not have yet
Changing a booking she already has
Asking why her room was cancelled
activities.answer: Making a booking she does not have yet
activities.audioTranscript: Good morning. I'd like to book a room for the fourteenth. Do you have a reservation with us already, madam? No. Do you have a twin room available for two nights? We do. What time are you arriving on the fourteenth? We're taking the late bus, so we check in around ten. That's fine. The accommodation includes breakfast until nine. Perfect. I'm sending my details now.

activities.prompt: One line is a habit, one is a fixed arrangement. Choose the form.
activities.promptAr: جملة تصف عادة وأخرى تصف ترتيباً ثابتاً. اختر الصيغة المناسبة.
activities.text: I usually travel on Saturday, but this week I ___ on Friday.
options: am travelling
travel
travelled
activities.answer: am travelling

activities.prompt: Read the hotel's reply. What must a late guest do?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ رد الفندق. ما الذي يجب على النزيل المتأخر فعله؟
activities.sourceText: Thank you. Your reservation is confirmed for two nights. You can check in from two in the afternoon. If you are arriving after ten at night, please write to us first, because the desk is not open.
options: Write to the hotel before arriving
Pay for the room in advance
Collect the key from another building
activities.answer: Write to the hotel before arriving

activities.prompt: Listen to the call from the guest house. What has changed?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى اتصال بيت الضيافة. ما الذي تغيّر؟
options: The twin room is not free any more
The price of the room has risen
The guest house is closed on the fourteenth
activities.answer: The twin room is not free any more
activities.audioTranscript: Hello, this is Farah from Cedar Guest House. I'm calling about your booking for the fourteenth. The twin room is not available any more, because a group is staying that night. I can give you two single rooms at the same price, or you can move your reservation to the fifteenth. Tell me which you prefer and I'll hold it for you.

activities.prompt: Phone the guest house. Say which nights you need, ask what is free, say what time you are arriving, and check the price.
activities.promptAr: اتصل ببيت الضيافة. قل الليالي التي تحتاجها، واسأل عمّا هو متاح، وقل في أي ساعة ستصل، وتأكد من السعر.
partnerTurns: Cedar Guest House, good afternoon. How can I help you?
Let me look. We have a double room and a small twin. Which nights do you need?
That's fine. And what time are you arriving? The desk closes at eleven.

dialogue.speaker: Maha
dialogue.en: The direct coach leaves at seven. The slow one is cheaper.
dialogue.ar: حافلة السفر المباشرة تغادر في السابعة. البطيئة أرخص.

dialogue.speaker: Bilal
dialogue.en: How much cheaper? I'm not going to sit on a bus all day.
dialogue.ar: أرخص بكم؟ لن أجلس في حافلة طوال اليوم.

dialogue.speaker: Maha
dialogue.en: Two dinars. But it stops four times and arrives at three.
dialogue.ar: ديناران. لكنها تتوقف أربع مرات وتصل في الثالثة.

dialogue.speaker: Bilal
dialogue.en: Then I'll take the direct one. Two dinars is nothing.
dialogue.ar: إذن سآخذ المباشرة. ديناران ليسا بشيء.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.en: Shall I book the seats tonight? The fare rises on Thursday.
dialogue.ar: هل أحجز المقاعد الليلة؟ الأجرة سترتفع يوم الخميس.

dialogue.speaker: Maha
dialogue.en: Please do. And I'm meeting my sister before the departure.
dialogue.ar: نعم من فضلك. وسألتقي أختي قبل موعد المغادرة.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.en: Then I'll collect you both at six. I'm driving anyway.
dialogue.ar: إذن سأمرّ لأقلّكما في السادسة. سأقود سيارتي على أي حال.

activities.prompt: What are the three friends settling between them?
activities.promptAr: ما الأمر الذي يحسمه الأصدقاء الثلاثة فيما بينهم؟
options: Which coach to take and who drives them there
Which hotel is nearest the station
Whether to travel this week or next
activities.answer: Which coach to take and who drives them there
activities.audioTranscript: The direct coach leaves at seven. The slow one is cheaper. How much cheaper? I'm not going to sit on a bus all day. Two dinars. But it stops four times and arrives at three. Then I'll take the direct one. Two dinars is nothing. Shall I book the seats tonight? The fare rises on Thursday. Please do. And I'm meeting my sister before the departure. Then I'll collect you both at six. I'm driving anyway.

activities.prompt: He decides while he is speaking. Choose the form for that.
activities.promptAr: هو يقرر أثناء حديثه. اختر الصيغة المناسبة لذلك.
activities.text: The slow coach is two hours longer. All right, I ___ take the direct one.
options: will
am going to
am
activities.answer: will

activities.prompt: Read the notice at the port. What can a passenger with a nine o'clock ticket do?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الإشعار في الميناء. ماذا يستطيع الراكب الذي يحمل تذكرة التاسعة أن يفعل؟
activities.sourceText: Notice for passengers: the nine o'clock ferry is full. Passengers with a ticket for it can travel on the eleven o'clock boat at no extra cost, or ask for their money back at window four.
options: Take the later boat for the same price
Buy a cheaper ticket at window four
Travel on any ferry this week
activities.answer: Take the later boat for the same price

activities.prompt: Listen to Nawal's message. What is she offering to do?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة نوال. ما الذي تعرض القيام به؟
options: Pay for Rana's seat and drive her to the coach
Change Rana's ticket to the cheaper coach
Wait for Rana at the station on the day
activities.answer: Pay for Rana's seat and drive her to the coach
activities.audioTranscript: Hi Rana, it's Nawal. I checked the times. The direct coach costs nine dinars and takes four hours; the cheap one takes six. I'm going to take the direct one, and I'll pay for your seat now. You can give me the money later. Shall I collect you from your flat at half past five, or will you meet me at the station?

activities.prompt: Compare two ways of getting to a city you know: the times, the fare and how direct each one is. Then decide which one you will take, and offer to do one thing for the person travelling with you.
activities.promptAr: قارن طريقتين للوصول إلى مدينة تعرفها: المواعيد والأجرة ومدى كون كل منهما مباشرة. ثم قرر أيهما ستأخذ، واعرض أن تقوم بأمر واحد لمن يسافر معك.

dialogue.speaker: Yousef
dialogue.en: My flight to Basra is delayed again. The new time is four.
dialogue.ar: رحلتي إلى البصرة تأخرت مرة أخرى. الموعد الجديد الرابعة.

dialogue.speaker: Dina
dialogue.en: Then you'll miss the two o'clock meeting. Shall we reschedule it?
dialogue.ar: إذن ستفوتك جلسة الثانية. هل نعيد تحديد موعدها؟

dialogue.speaker: Yousef
dialogue.en: If I land at four, I'll be at the office by six.
dialogue.ar: إذا هبطت في الرابعة فسأكون في المكتب قبل السادسة.

dialogue.speaker: Dina
dialogue.en: That's late. If the flight moves again, we'll do it online.
dialogue.ar: هذا متأخر. إذا تغيّر موعد الرحلة مرة أخرى فسنعقدها عبر الإنترنت.

dialogue.speaker: Yousef
dialogue.en: Agreed. That's Plan B.
dialogue.ar: اتفقنا. تلك هي الخطة البديلة.

dialogue.speaker: Dina
dialogue.en: And if they cancel it completely, ask for a refund at the desk.
dialogue.ar: وإذا ألغوها تماماً فاطلب استرداد المبلغ من مكتب الخدمة.

dialogue.speaker: Yousef
dialogue.en: I will. There's an evening alternative, but it costs more.
dialogue.ar: سأفعل. هناك بديل مسائي لكنه أغلى.

activities.prompt: What problem are Yousef and Dina working around?
activities.promptAr: ما المشكلة التي يتدبرها يوسف ودينا؟
options: A meeting that his delayed flight may break
A ticket that cost more than they expected
A colleague who cannot come to Basra
activities.answer: A meeting that his delayed flight may break
activities.audioTranscript: My flight to Basra is delayed again. The new time is four. Then you'll miss the two o'clock meeting. Shall we reschedule it? If I land at four, I'll be at the office by six. That's late. If the flight moves again, we'll do it online. Agreed. That's Plan B. And if they cancel it completely, ask for a refund at the desk. I will. There's an evening alternative, but it costs more.

activities.prompt: The if part stays in the present. Choose the word for the other part.
activities.promptAr: الجزء الذي يبدأ بـ if يبقى في المضارع. اختر الكلمة المناسبة للجزء الآخر.
activities.text: If the weather is bad tomorrow, the ferry ___ not run.
options: will
would
is
activities.answer: will

activities.prompt: Listen to the station announcement. What happens if you do not want to wait?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى إعلان المحطة. ماذا يحدث إن لم تشأ الانتظار؟
options: You get all your money back
You travel on tomorrow's coach
You pay less for the next ticket
activities.answer: You get all your money back
activities.audioTranscript: Good afternoon, passengers. The two o'clock coach to Kirkuk is delayed by ninety minutes. If you are travelling on to Sulaymaniyah tonight, come to the desk and we will change your ticket. If you decide not to wait, we will give you a full refund at window two. We are sorry for the trouble.

activities.prompt: Read the message from the tour office. What happens if the sea is rough?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ رسالة مكتب الرحلات. ماذا يحدث إذا كان البحر هائجاً؟
activities.sourceText: Tomorrow's boat trip depends on the wind. If the sea is rough at eight, we will not sail, and we will move everyone to Thursday. If you cannot come on Thursday, write to us today and we will refund you.
options: The trip moves to Thursday
The trip starts two hours later
The office keeps the money
activities.answer: The trip moves to Thursday

activities.prompt: Your colleague is flying on the morning of an important meeting. Write her a short message: say what the plan is, give two things that could go wrong, and say what you will do in each case.
activities.promptAr: زميلتك ستسافر جواً صباح اجتماع مهم. اكتب لها رسالة قصيرة: اذكر الخطة، وأمرين قد يسيران على غير ما يُراد، وما ستفعله في كل حالة.

dialogue.speaker: Adel
dialogue.en: Sawsan, my arrival time changed. I get in at nine now.
dialogue.ar: سوسن، تغيّر وقت وصولي. سأصل في التاسعة الآن.

dialogue.speaker: Sawsan
dialogue.en: No problem. Message me when you arrive and I'll come out.
dialogue.ar: لا مشكلة. راسلني عندما تصل وسأخرج إليك.

dialogue.speaker: Adel
dialogue.en: There's one transfer in Amman, so I may be running late.
dialogue.ar: هناك تبديل واحد في عمّان، لذا قد أتأخر عن الموعد.

dialogue.speaker: Sawsan
dialogue.en: Don't worry, I'm flexible until noon. But before you leave Amman, listen for the gate announcement.
dialogue.ar: لا تقلق، وقتي مرن حتى الظهر. لكن قبل أن تغادر عمّان انتبه إلى إعلان البوابة.

dialogue.speaker: Adel
dialogue.en: I will. And I'll let you know after I collect my bag.
dialogue.ar: سأفعل. وسأخبركِ بعد أن أستلم حقيبتي.

dialogue.speaker: Sawsan
dialogue.en: Perfect. Rami is driving, and he waits at Exit Three.
dialogue.ar: ممتاز. رامي هو من سيقود، وسينتظر عند المخرج الثالث.

activities.prompt: What are Adel and Sawsan sorting out between them?
activities.promptAr: ما الأمر الذي يرتّبه عادل وسوسن بينهما؟
options: How they will meet after his journey changed
Which hotel he should book in Amman
Whether he should travel on Sunday instead
activities.answer: How they will meet after his journey changed
activities.audioTranscript: Sawsan, my arrival time changed. I get in at nine now. No problem. Message me when you arrive and I'll come out. There's one transfer in Amman, so I may be running late. Don't worry, I'm flexible until noon. But before you leave Amman, listen for the gate announcement. I will. And I'll let you know after I collect my bag. Perfect. Rami is driving, and he waits at Exit Three.

activities.prompt: Put this line from a message in the correct order.
activities.promptAr: رتّب هذا السطر من الرسالة بالترتيب الصحيح.

activities.prompt: Read Sawsan's second message. When should Adel phone the driver?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ رسالة سوسن الثانية. متى ينبغي لعادل أن يتصل بالسائق؟
activities.sourceText: Rami is not free after eight, so Karim will drive instead. He has a grey car and waits at Exit Three. Call him before you leave the building, not after, because he cannot park for long.
options: Before he comes out of the building
As soon as the plane lands
After he finds the grey car
activities.answer: Before he comes out of the building

activities.prompt: Listen to Muna's message. What must you do when you get to the hotel?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة منى. ماذا يجب أن تفعل عندما تصل إلى الفندق؟
options: Ask at the desk for an envelope
Send Muna the meeting papers
Wait for the transfer by the bridge
activities.answer: Ask at the desk for an envelope
activities.audioTranscript: Hi, it's Muna from the office. Two things before you travel. First, the airport transfer is now at seven, not half past six, because the road by the bridge is closed. Second, when you get to the hotel, ask for the envelope at the desk; your meeting papers are inside. Call me after you check in, and I'll tell you the rest.

activities.prompt: Your colleague's flight has moved. Talk to her: confirm the new arrival time, say what you will do when she lands, and agree one thing she should do before she leaves the airport.
activities.promptAr: تغيّر موعد رحلة زميلتك. تحدّث إليها: أكّد وقت الوصول الجديد، وقل ما الذي ستفعله عندما تهبط، واتفقا على أمر تفعله قبل أن تغادر المطار.
partnerTurns: Sorry to call so late. The airline moved my flight. I land at twenty past nine now, not seven.
That's kind of you. Do I wait inside, or come out to the car park?
Fine. And is there anything I should do before I leave the airport?

readingText.title: Hanan's Weekend Plan
readingText.text: Ziad, here is the plan for Saturday and Sunday. I'm taking the seven o'clock coach, so I get to you at about eleven. I have one small suitcase, nothing heavy. On Saturday afternoon we are going to walk around the old market, and in the evening I'm meeting my cousin for dinner; she is working until seven, so we eat late. On Sunday the schedule is looser. We are going to the hill above the river if the morning is clear. If it rains, that's Plan B: the covered market and a long lunch. My coach home leaves at six. Tell me if any of this is difficult and we will move it to another day.
readingText.textAr: زياد، هذه خطة السبت والأحد. سآخذ حافلة السابعة، فأصل إليك حوالي الحادية عشرة. معي حقيبة سفر صغيرة واحدة، لا شيء ثقيل. بعد ظهر السبت سنتجول في السوق القديم، وفي المساء سألتقي ابنة عمي على العشاء؛ هي تعمل حتى السابعة، لذا نتعشى متأخرين. يوم الأحد الجدول أكثر مرونة: سنصعد إلى التلة المطلّة على النهر إذا كان الصباح صافياً. وإذا أمطرت فهذه هي الخطة البديلة: السوق المسقوف وغداء طويل. حافلة عودتي تغادر في السادسة. أخبرني إن كان أي من هذا صعباً وسننقله إلى يوم آخر.

activities.prompt: Read Hanan's plan once. What is she sending Ziad?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ خطة حنان مرة واحدة. ما الذي ترسله إلى زياد؟
options: A two-day plan with one alternative for bad weather
A list of the places she visited last month
A request to change the date of her visit
activities.answer: A two-day plan with one alternative for bad weather

activities.prompt: Listen to Ziad's reply. Why might they go to the museum?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رد زياد. لماذا قد يذهبان إلى المتحف؟
options: The hill path closes after heavy rain
The market is shut on Sunday
His brother needs the car all weekend
activities.answer: The hill path closes after heavy rain
activities.audioTranscript: Ziad here. Your plan is fine, but two small things. My brother is using the car on Saturday morning, so we walk to the market; it's twenty minutes. And the hill path is closed after heavy rain, so if Saturday night is wet, we'll go to the museum instead. Send me your coach number and I'll meet you at the stop.

activities.prompt: Before you write anything, say your own two-day plan aloud, the way Hanan wrote hers. Give one fixed arrangement, one intention, and one alternative for bad weather.
activities.promptAr: قبل أن تكتب شيئاً، قل خطتك ليومين بصوت عالٍ كما كتبت حنان خطتها. اذكر ترتيباً ثابتاً واحداً، ونية واحدة، وبديلاً واحداً إن كان الطقس سيئاً.

activities.prompt: Hanan sent you this in a hurry, and Ziad has not seen it. Tell Ziad what has changed, what time she now gets in, what she plans to do instead, and what he must do before Friday.
activities.promptAr: أرسلت حنان هذه الرسالة على عجل، ولم يرها زياد. أخبر زياد بما تغيّر، وفي أي ساعة ستصل الآن، وما الذي تنوي فعله بدلاً من ذلك، وما عليه فعله قبل الجمعة.
activities.sourceCard: From Hanan: The seven o'clock coach is full, so I'm taking the nine o'clock one and getting in at one. I'm going to skip the market and see the old bridge instead. If Ziad can't meet me at one, tell him to leave the key with his neighbour before Friday.

activities.prompt: Now write your own two-day plan for a visitor. Give the travel times you have fixed, what you are going to do on each day, and one alternative if the weather is bad.
activities.promptAr: اكتب الآن خطتك أنت ليومين من أجل زائر. اذكر مواعيد السفر التي ثبّتها، وما ستفعله في كل يوم، وبديلاً واحداً إذا كان الطقس سيئاً.

lessons.title: Mission: Build a Weekend Itinerary
lessons.titleAr: المهمة: ابنِ برنامج عطلة نهاية أسبوع
lessons.scenario: Plan a visitor's weekend from unseen transport, accommodation and attraction information, then adapt it after a change.

activities.prompt: Your visitor does not mind walking but cannot sleep with noise. Which place suits her?
activities.promptAr: زائرتك لا تمانع المشي لكنها لا تستطيع النوم مع الضجيج. أي مكان يناسبها؟
activities.sourceText: Two places have a free room: the guest house by the station, forty dinars, breakfast included, twenty minutes from the old town; and the flat above the bakery, thirty dinars, no breakfast, three minutes from the old town but noisy until midnight.
options: The guest house by the station
The flat above the bakery
Neither has a free room
activities.answer: The guest house by the station

activities.prompt: Listen to Basma's message. What has changed about her journey?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة بسمة. ما الذي تغيّر في رحلتها؟
options: She gets in two and a half hours later
She is coming on Saturday instead of Friday
She is taking a taxi from the station
activities.answer: She gets in two and a half hours later
activities.audioTranscript: Hello, this is Basma, the visitor coming on Friday. My coach gets in at half past four, not two, because the earlier one was full. I'm free all day Saturday, but on Sunday I have to leave by four. I'd rather walk than take taxis, and I'd like to see one market and one old building. Anything else is up to you.

activities.prompt: Talk to Basma. Ask what matters most to her, compare the two places to stay, and agree what you are doing on Saturday.
activities.promptAr: تحدّث إلى بسمة. اسألها عمّا يهمها أكثر، وقارن بين مكانَي الإقامة، واتفقا على ما ستفعلانه يوم السبت.
partnerTurns: Thanks for calling. I don't need anything special; I just want to see the town on foot.
Forty dinars is fine if I can sleep. The flat above the bakery sounds loud.
Saturday is yours, then. What are we doing first?

activities.prompt: Present the finished weekend to Basma: the arrangements that are fixed, what you are going to do on each day, and one Plan B if the weather changes.
activities.promptAr: قدّم لبسمة عطلة نهاية الأسبوع في صيغتها النهائية: الترتيبات الثابتة، وما ستفعلانه في كل يوم، وخطة بديلة واحدة إذا تغيّر الطقس.

activities.prompt: The coach company sent you this notice, and Basma has not seen it. Tell her what has changed, what it means for Sunday, and what she must do before she travels.
activities.promptAr: أرسلت شركة الحافلات هذا الإشعار، ولم ترَه بسمة. أخبرها بما تغيّر، وما يعنيه ذلك ليوم الأحد، وما عليها فعله قبل السفر.
activities.sourceCard: Notice: from Sunday the four o'clock coach does not run. The last coach leaves at half past two. Passengers holding a four o'clock ticket must change it at any office before Saturday evening, or it will not be valid.

activities.prompt: Write the weekend plan for Basma. Give the times that are fixed, what you are going to do on Saturday and on Sunday, one alternative if it rains, and the new Sunday coach time.
activities.promptAr: اكتب خطة عطلة نهاية الأسبوع لبسمة. اذكر المواعيد الثابتة، وما ستفعلانه يوم السبت ويوم الأحد، وبديلاً واحداً إذا أمطرت، وموعد حافلة الأحد الجديد.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.en: You don't look well, Dalia. Are you all right?
dialogue.ar: لا تبدين على ما يرام يا داليا. هل أنتِ بخير؟

dialogue.speaker: Dalia
dialogue.en: My throat is sore and I cough all night. My shoulders ache too.
dialogue.ar: حلقي مؤلم وأسعل طوال الليل، وكتفاي يوجعانني أيضاً.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.en: You should go home early. You shouldn't sit in this cold room.
dialogue.ar: ينبغي أن تعودي إلى البيت مبكراً، ولا ينبغي أن تجلسي في هذه الغرفة الباردة.

dialogue.speaker: Dalia
dialogue.en: I have a report to finish.
dialogue.ar: لديّ تقرير عليّ إنهاؤه.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.en: The report can wait. Ask at the pharmacy, and get some rest.
dialogue.ar: التقرير يمكنه الانتظار. اسألي في الصيدلية، وخذي قسطاً من الراحة.

dialogue.speaker: Dalia
dialogue.en: Maybe you're right. I'll finish it tomorrow.
dialogue.ar: ربما أنتَ محق. سأنهيه غداً.

activities.prompt: What is Yusuf trying to persuade Dalia to do?
activities.promptAr: إلامَ يحاول يوسف إقناع داليا؟
options: Stop working and rest
Move to a warmer desk
Take the report home with her
activities.answer: Stop working and rest
activities.audioTranscript: You don't look well, Dalia. Are you all right? My throat is sore and I cough all night. My shoulders ache too. You should go home early. You shouldn't sit in this cold room. I have a report to finish. The report can wait. Ask at the pharmacy, and get some rest. Maybe you're right. I'll finish it tomorrow.

activities.prompt: One half of this advice says yes, the other says no. Choose the form that fits.
activities.promptAr: شطر من هذه النصيحة يقول نعم والآخر يقول لا. اختر الصيغة المناسبة.
activities.text: You look exhausted. You ___ sit in that cold room all afternoon.
options: shouldn't
should
don't should
activities.answer: shouldn't

activities.prompt: Match each problem with the advice that fits it.
activities.promptAr: طابق كل مشكلة بالنصيحة المناسبة لها.
pairs: Hani has a sore throat,
so he should drink something warm.
Rania sits at a desk all day,
so she should stand up and stretch.
Samir sleeps badly,
so he shouldn't drink coffee at night.

activities.prompt: Listen to Nawal's message. What does her sister advise?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة نوال. بماذا تنصحها أختها؟
options: A warm drink and another hour of sleep
A morning at the pool
A whole day in bed
activities.answer: A warm drink and another hour of sleep
activities.audioTranscript: Hi, it's Nawal. I went to bed early last night, but my shoulders still ache this morning, and my throat is a little sore. I'm not going to the gym today. My sister says I should drink something warm and sleep for another hour, and she is probably right. Don't wait for me at the pool. I'll message you tomorrow when I feel better.

activities.prompt: A friend asks how you are, and you are not well today. Say two things you feel, then give yourself the advice a sensible friend would give.
activities.promptAr: يسألكَ صديق عن حالكَ، ولستَ بخير اليوم. اذكر شيئين تشعر بهما، ثم قدّم لنفسكَ النصيحة التي يقدمها صديق عاقل.

dialogue.speaker: Kareem
dialogue.en: The doctor gave me this. Do I have to take it with food?
dialogue.ar: أعطاني الطبيب هذا. هل يجب أن أتناوله مع الطعام؟

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.en: Yes. The instructions on the label say with food.
dialogue.ar: نعم. التعليمات المكتوبة على الملصق تقول: مع الطعام.

dialogue.speaker: Kareem
dialogue.en: How often should I take it? And do I have to come back for more?
dialogue.ar: كم مرة ينبغي أن أتناوله؟ وهل عليّ أن أعود لآخذ المزيد؟

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.en: The label answers that. No, you don't have to come back; one packet is enough.
dialogue.ar: الملصق يجيب عن ذلك. لا، لستَ مضطراً للعودة؛ عبوة واحدة تكفي.

dialogue.speaker: Kareem
dialogue.en: Can I keep it in my bag at work?
dialogue.ar: هل يمكنني الاحتفاظ به في حقيبتي في العمل؟

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.en: Please don't. You have to keep it somewhere cool and dry, and read the label again before you use it.
dialogue.ar: أرجو ألا تفعل. عليكَ أن تحفظه في مكان بارد وجاف، واقرأ الملصق مرة أخرى قبل أن تستعمله.

dialogue.speaker: Kareem
dialogue.en: Thanks. I'll read it tonight.
dialogue.ar: شكراً. سأقرؤه الليلة.

activities.prompt: What is Kareem checking at the pharmacy counter?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي يتحقق منه كريم عند طاولة الصيدلية؟
options: How to take what he was given, and where to keep it
Whether the pharmacy is open on Friday
How much one packet costs
activities.answer: How to take what he was given, and where to keep it
activities.audioTranscript: The doctor gave me this. Do I have to take it with food? Yes. The instructions on the label say with food. How often should I take it? And do I have to come back for more? The label answers that. No, you don't have to come back; one packet is enough. Can I keep it in my bag at work? Please don't. You have to keep it somewhere cool and dry, and read the label again before you use it. Thanks. I'll read it tonight.

activities.prompt: Is this a rule or a free choice? Choose the form that fits.
activities.promptAr: أهذا إلزام أم اختيار؟ اختر الصيغة المناسبة.
activities.text: The label says 'with food', so you ___ take it with a meal.
options: have to
don't have to
are having to
activities.answer: have to

activities.prompt: Read the notice at the counter. What do customers have to do?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الإعلان على الطاولة. ما الذي يجب على الزبائن فعله؟
options: Bring the packet with them
Book an appointment first
Arrive before eleven on Friday
activities.answer: Bring the packet with them
activities.sourceText: Notice for customers: the pharmacist will answer any question about a label, and you don't have to make an appointment. You do have to bring the packet with you. On Fridays we open late, at eleven.

activities.prompt: Listen to the pharmacy's recorded message. What do you have to bring?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى الرسالة المسجلة للصيدلية. ما الذي يجب أن تحضره معكَ؟
options: The paper from the doctor
A booking number
The empty packet
activities.answer: The paper from the doctor
activities.audioTranscript: This is the Riverside Pharmacy. Our counter is open from eight in the morning until nine at night. You don't have to book a time to speak to a pharmacist; just come to the desk and wait. If you are collecting something the doctor ordered, you have to bring the paper with you, and the instructions will be printed on the label.

activities.prompt: You are at the pharmacy counter for the first time. Ask what you have to do and what you don't have to do, and check one thing on the label.
activities.promptAr: أنتَ عند طاولة الصيدلية لأول مرة. اسأل عمّا يجب عليكَ فعله وما لا يلزمكَ فعله، وتحقق من أمر واحد في الملصق.
partnerTurns: Good morning. Is this the first time you have collected something here?
Then I have to see the paper from the clinic, please. Ask me anything you like.
Of course. Tell me what you still need to know, and what you were worried about.

dialogue.speaker: Faris
dialogue.en: Are you ready to order?
dialogue.ar: هل أنتما مستعدان للطلب؟

dialogue.speaker: Salma
dialogue.en: Before we order, my son is allergic to nuts. Is there anything in the sauce?
dialogue.ar: قبل أن نطلب: ابني لديه حساسية من المكسّرات. هل في الصلصة شيء منها؟

dialogue.speaker: Faris
dialogue.en: I must ask the kitchen. You mustn't guess with an allergy.
dialogue.ar: يجب أن أسأل المطبخ. لا يجوز التخمين في أمر الحساسية.

dialogue.speaker: Bilal
dialogue.en: Thank you. Make sure they check the bread as well.
dialogue.ar: شكراً لكَ. تأكّد من أنهم يفحصون الخبز أيضاً.

dialogue.speaker: Faris
dialogue.en: Of course. We write every warning on the menu, but I'll ask anyway.
dialogue.ar: بالطبع. نكتب كل تحذير في قائمة الطعام، لكنني سأسأل على أي حال.

dialogue.speaker: Salma
dialogue.en: That's kind of you. He mustn't eat anything with nuts, not even a little.
dialogue.ar: هذا لطف منكَ. يجب ألا يأكل أي شيء فيه مكسّرات، ولو قليلاً.

activities.prompt: What does Salma want to know before they order?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي تريد سلمى معرفته قبل أن يطلبوا؟
options: Whether the food contains nuts
How long the food will take
Whether the cafe takes cards
activities.answer: Whether the food contains nuts
activities.audioTranscript: Are you ready to order? Before we order, my son is allergic to nuts. Is there anything in the sauce? I must ask the kitchen. You mustn't guess with an allergy. Thank you. Make sure they check the bread as well. Of course. We write every warning on the menu, but I'll ask anyway. That's kind of you. He mustn't eat anything with nuts, not even a little.

activities.prompt: This is a warning, not a suggestion. Choose the form that fits.
activities.promptAr: هذا تحذير لا اقتراح. اختر الصيغة المناسبة.
activities.text: The label says it can make you dizzy, so you ___ drive today.
options: mustn't
must
don't must
activities.answer: mustn't

activities.prompt: Read the warning printed on the box. When can the person drive again?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ التحذير المطبوع على العلبة. متى يمكن للشخص أن يقود مرة أخرى؟
options: When the sleepy feeling has gone
After six hours, whatever happens
Never, once the box is open
activities.answer: When the sleepy feeling has gone
activities.sourceText: Please read before you travel: this box may make you feel sleepy or dizzy. You must not drive until the feeling has gone. Keep the box away from children, and show the warning to anyone who shares the car with you.

activities.prompt: Listen to Nadia's message about Saturday. What mustn't Bilal do?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة نادية عن يوم السبت. ما الذي يجب ألا يفعله بلال؟
options: Buy a cake from the bakery on the corner
Tell the other guests about Yara
Bring any fruit with him
activities.answer: Buy a cake from the bakery on the corner
activities.audioTranscript: Hi Bilal, it's Nadia. About Saturday: I'm making the cake myself this year, because Yara is allergic to nuts and the shop cakes all carry a warning. You mustn't bring anything from the bakery on the corner; they use the same trays for everything. Make sure you tell the others as well. Bring fruit if you want to bring something.

activities.prompt: You are ordering food for a friend who is allergic to something. Say what your friend must not eat, ask the waiter one question about the kitchen, and make sure he checks the bread as well.
activities.promptAr: أنتَ تطلب الطعام لصديق لديه حساسية من شيء ما. قل ما الذي يجب ألا يأكله صديقكَ، واسأل النادل سؤالاً واحداً عن المطبخ، وتأكّد من أنه يفحص الخبز أيضاً.

dialogue.speaker: Iman
dialogue.en: Why does everyone look tired on Mondays?
dialogue.ar: لماذا يبدو الجميع متعبين أيام الاثنين؟

dialogue.speaker: Tarek
dialogue.en: I sit at my desk from eight until six to finish everything on time.
dialogue.ar: أجلس إلى مكتبي من الثامنة حتى السادسة لأُنهي كل شيء في وقته.

dialogue.speaker: Iman
dialogue.en: Then stand up every hour to stretch your legs. Walk to the window to get some fresh air.
dialogue.ar: إذن قف كل ساعة لتمدّ ساقيكَ، وامشِ إلى النافذة لتأخذ بعض الهواء النقي.

dialogue.speaker: Rami
dialogue.en: I drink coffee to stay awake. Is that bad?
dialogue.ar: أشرب القهوة لأبقى مستيقظاً. هل هذا سيئ؟

dialogue.speaker: Iman
dialogue.en: Drink water as well, to stay hydrated. And avoid your phone after eleven, to give your body time to sleep.
dialogue.ar: اشرب الماء أيضاً لتبقى رطباً، وتجنّب هاتفكَ بعد الحادية عشرة لتمنح جسدكَ وقتاً للنوم.

dialogue.speaker: Tarek
dialogue.en: So I should take a break to get my energy back.
dialogue.ar: إذن ينبغي أن آخذ استراحة لأستعيد طاقتي.

dialogue.speaker: Iman
dialogue.en: Exactly. A short break is not lost time.
dialogue.ar: تماماً. الاستراحة القصيرة ليست وقتاً ضائعاً.

activities.prompt: What is Iman explaining to her colleagues?
activities.promptAr: ماذا تشرح إيمان لزملائها؟
options: Small changes, and the reason for each one
A new timetable for the office
Which exercise class they should join
activities.answer: Small changes, and the reason for each one
activities.audioTranscript: Why does everyone look tired on Mondays? I sit at my desk from eight until six to finish everything on time. Then stand up every hour to stretch your legs. Walk to the window to get some fresh air. I drink coffee to stay awake. Is that bad? Drink water as well, to stay hydrated. And avoid your phone after eleven, to give your body time to sleep. So I should take a break to get my energy back. Exactly. A short break is not lost time.

activities.prompt: Why does he leave at six? Choose the word that gives the purpose.
activities.promptAr: لماذا يخرج في السادسة؟ اختر الكلمة التي تعبّر عن الغرض.
activities.text: Hasan leaves the house at six ___ avoid the traffic.
options: to
for
because
activities.answer: to

activities.prompt: Listen to the start of the session. Why should people put their phones in their bags?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى بداية الجلسة. لماذا ينبغي أن يضع الحاضرون هواتفهم في حقائبهم؟
options: To keep their hands free
To hear the speaker better
To finish the session on time
activities.answer: To keep their hands free
activities.audioTranscript: Good morning, everyone. Before we start, three things. Open a window to let some fresh air in. Put your phone in your bag to keep your hands free. And if you want to ask a question, come to the front, because the people at the back cannot hear you. We finish at four, so drink some water before then.

activities.prompt: Read the staff notice. Why does it suggest the stairs?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ إعلان الموظفين. لماذا يقترح استخدام الدرج؟
options: To add a little exercise to the day
Because the lift is broken
To save the company money
activities.answer: To add a little exercise to the day
activities.sourceText: Staff notice: the stairs at the back are open again. Use them in order to get a few extra minutes of exercise each day. The lift is still there for anyone carrying something heavy, and for anyone who needs it.

activities.prompt: Your team is starting a good-habits week at work. Write a short message to your colleagues. Suggest three small changes and give the purpose of each one with to + verb. Then say one thing nobody has to do.
activities.promptAr: يبدأ فريقكَ أسبوع العادات الطيبة في العمل. اكتب رسالة قصيرة إلى زملائكَ. اقترح ثلاثة تغييرات صغيرة، وبيّن غرض كل منها بـ to + الفعل، ثم اذكر أمراً واحداً لا يلزم أحداً أن يفعله.

dialogue.speaker: Maha
dialogue.en: Good morning. Do you have a check-up today, or is something wrong?
dialogue.ar: صباح الخير. هل لديكَ فحص دوري اليوم، أم أن هناك شكوى؟

dialogue.speaker: Adnan
dialogue.en: A check-up. But my knee hurts as well, so I'd like to mention it.
dialogue.ar: فحص دوري. لكن ركبتي تؤلمني أيضاً، وأودّ أن أذكر ذلك.

dialogue.speaker: Maha
dialogue.en: Of course. How long have you had it?
dialogue.ar: بالطبع. منذ متى تعاني منها؟

dialogue.speaker: Adnan
dialogue.en: I've had it for about two weeks. It started after a long walk.
dialogue.ar: أعاني منها منذ أسبوعين تقريباً. بدأ الأمر بعد مشي طويل.

dialogue.speaker: Maha
dialogue.en: Is it worse in the evening?
dialogue.ar: هل تزداد سوءاً في المساء؟

dialogue.speaker: Adnan
dialogue.en: A little. It wakes me at night, but it is the same as last week.
dialogue.ar: قليلاً. توقظني ليلاً، لكنها مثل الأسبوع الماضي.

dialogue.speaker: Maha
dialogue.en: Sit down over there. The doctor is running ten minutes late.
dialogue.ar: تفضّل بالجلوس هناك. الطبيب متأخر عشر دقائق.

activities.prompt: Why is Adnan at the clinic today?
activities.promptAr: لماذا جاء عدنان إلى العيادة اليوم؟
options: For a check-up, and to mention one new thing
Because he cannot walk at all
To collect something for his knee
activities.answer: For a check-up, and to mention one new thing
activities.audioTranscript: Good morning. Do you have a check-up today, or is something wrong? A check-up. But my knee hurts as well, so I'd like to mention it. Of course. How long have you had it? I've had it for about two weeks. It started after a long walk. Is it worse in the evening? A little. It wakes me at night, but it is the same as last week. Sit down over there. The doctor is running ten minutes late.

activities.prompt: One word counts the time, the other names the day it began. Choose the one that fits.
activities.promptAr: كلمة تعدّ المدة وأخرى تذكر يوم البداية. اختر المناسبة.
activities.text: Ali has had a sore knee ___ two weeks.
options: for
since
ago
activities.answer: for

activities.prompt: Read the clinic card. What should you write on the back of it?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ بطاقة العيادة. ماذا ينبغي أن تكتب على ظهرها؟
options: Anything new that has lasted more than a week
The time of your appointment
The name of the doctor you want
activities.answer: Anything new that has lasted more than a week
activities.sourceText: Riverside Clinic, before your check-up. Please arrive ten minutes early and give your card to the receptionist. If you have had a new symptom for more than a week, write it on the back of the card so the doctor can see it.

activities.prompt: Listen to Warda's call from the clinic. What does she ask the patient to do?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى اتصال وردة من العيادة. بماذا تطلب من المريض أن يقوم؟
options: Mention the shoulder at the same visit
Book a second appointment for it
Bring a different card on Thursday
activities.answer: Mention the shoulder at the same visit
activities.audioTranscript: Hello, this is Warda at the clinic, returning your call. Your check-up is on Thursday at two, and the receptionist will take your card at the desk. You said on the phone that your shoulder has been sore since the weekend. Please mention that to the doctor as well, because it is easier to look at both things in one visit.

activities.prompt: You are at the clinic. Answer the doctor: say where it hurts, how long you have had it, when it started, and whether it has changed.
activities.promptAr: أنتَ في العيادة. أجب الطبيبة: قل أين يؤلمكَ، ومنذ متى تعاني منه، ومتى بدأ، وهل تغيّر.
partnerTurns: Come in and sit down. What can I help you with today?
I see. And how long have you had it?
Has anything made it better or worse? Tell me what you have noticed.

readingText.title: Getting Back to Normal
readingText.text: Dear Ammar, I'm glad you are feeling a little better. Here is what helped me after my own week at home. Rest for the first two or three days, because the body recovers while you sleep. You don't have to stay in bed; sit in the garden, read, do something gentle. Drink water through the day to keep your energy up. Then build your old habits back one at a time. Go to work for a half day first, and a full day after that. If it gets worse, or if you feel the same on Sunday, ring the clinic instead of waiting for Monday. Take it easy, and don't compare this week with a normal one. Hind
readingText.textAr: عزيزي عمّار، يسعدني أنكَ تتحسن قليلاً. إليكَ ما نفعني بعد أسبوعي أنا في البيت. استرح في اليومين أو الثلاثة الأولى، لأن الجسد يتعافى أثناء النوم. لستَ مضطراً للبقاء في الفراش؛ اجلس في الحديقة، أو اقرأ، أو افعل شيئاً خفيفاً. اشرب الماء طوال النهار لتحافظ على طاقتك. ثم أعِد بناء عاداتك القديمة واحدة تلو الأخرى: اذهب إلى العمل نصف يوم أولاً، ثم يوماً كاملاً بعد ذلك. وإذا ساء الأمر، أو شعرتَ بالحال نفسها يوم الأحد، فاتصل بالعيادة بدل انتظار يوم الاثنين. لا ترهق نفسكَ، ولا تقارن هذا الأسبوع بأسبوع عادي. هند

activities.prompt: Read Hind's message once. What is she mainly telling Ammar?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ رسالة هند مرة واحدة. بماذا تخبر عمّاراً بشكل أساسي؟
options: How to come back to normal life step by step
That he should stay away from work for a month
That she will visit him on Sunday
activities.answer: How to come back to normal life step by step

activities.prompt: Listen to Lubna's message from the office. What has she already done?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة لبنى من المكتب. ما الذي فعلته بالفعل؟
options: Handed in his sick note for him
Cancelled the well-being session
Told him to come back on Thursday
activities.answer: Handed in his sick note for him
activities.audioTranscript: Hi Ammar, it's Lubna from the office. Don't worry about the sick note; I gave yours to Samir this morning, and he said three days is fine. Nobody needs it back. Also, the well-being session on Thursday is now online, so you can watch it later. Come back when you are ready, not before. The work will still be here.

activities.prompt: Before you write anything, say your plan aloud, the way Hind wrote hers. Give one thing your friend should do, one thing he doesn't have to do, and the reason for each.
activities.promptAr: قبل أن تكتب شيئاً، قل خطتكَ بصوت عالٍ كما كتبت هند خطتها. اذكر أمراً ينبغي لصديقكَ أن يفعله، وأمراً لا يلزمه فعله، وسبب كل منهما.

activities.prompt: Amal's mother does not read English. Tell her what the clinic wrote: what Amal doesn't have to do, the two habits she should keep, and when she must ring the desk.
activities.promptAr: والدة أمل لا تقرأ الإنجليزية. أخبرها بما كتبته العيادة: ما الذي لا يلزم أمل فعله، والعادتان اللتان ينبغي أن تحافظ عليهما، ومتى يجب عليها أن تتصل بالاستقبال.
activities.sourceCard: Note from the clinic: Amal's results are normal, so she doesn't have to come back this month. She should walk for twenty minutes most days and sleep at a regular time. If the headaches get worse, or if anything new starts, she must ring the desk the same day.

activities.prompt: Now write your own message to a friend who has been at home all week. Say what he should do and why, one thing he doesn't have to do, and what to do if it gets worse. Keep to rest, sleep, food and water, and do not add advice of your own.
activities.promptAr: اكتب الآن رسالتكَ إلى صديق بقي في البيت طوال الأسبوع. اذكر ما ينبغي أن يفعله ولماذا، وأمراً واحداً لا يلزمه فعله، وما العمل إذا ساء الأمر. اقتصر على الراحة والنوم والطعام والماء، ولا تضف نصيحة من عندكَ.

lessons.title: Mission: A Clinic Consultation
lessons.scenario: Understand a patient's symptoms and written instructions, conduct a simple consultation and relay the safe action plan.

activities.prompt: Read the volunteer card before the first visitor arrives. What must volunteers not do?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ بطاقة المتطوعين قبل وصول أول زائر. ما الذي يجب ألا يفعله المتطوعون؟
options: Give advice of their own
Write anything down
Speak to the nurse at desk three
activities.answer: Give advice of their own
activities.sourceText: Community health day, volunteer card. Listen to each visitor and write down where it hurts, how long they have had it, and whether it is worse. You must not give advice yourself. Send anyone who feels unwell to the nurse at desk three.

activities.prompt: Listen to the first visitor. What does he say about his shoulder?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى أول زائر. ماذا يقول عن كتفه؟
options: It has not changed in either direction
It is much worse than last week
It only hurts when he carries something
activities.answer: It has not changed in either direction
