activities.audioTranscript: Good morning. It's my shoulder, really. I've had it for about ten days now, and it started after I carried my grandson around the market all afternoon. It isn't worse, but it isn't better either, and it wakes me at night. I don't want to make a fuss. Should I wait another week, or should I see someone today?

activities.prompt: Talk to the visitor and fill in his card. Ask where it hurts, how long he has had it and whether it has changed, then tell him what happens next.
activities.promptAr: تحدّث إلى الزائر واملأ بطاقته. اسأله أين يؤلمه، ومنذ متى يعاني منه، وهل تغيّر، ثم أخبره بما سيحدث بعد ذلك.
partnerTurns: Good morning. Someone told me to sit here and wait. Is this the right desk?
It's my shoulder. I've had it a while now, and I'm not sure it's worth anyone's time.
Ask me whatever you need for the card, and then tell me what happens next.

activities.prompt: Now tell the nurse at desk three about the visitor, in under a minute. Say where it hurts, how long he has had it, whether it has changed, and what he asked you. Add nothing he did not say.
activities.promptAr: أخبر الممرضة في الطاولة الثالثة عن الزائر في أقل من دقيقة. قل أين يؤلمه، ومنذ متى يعاني منه، وهل تغيّر، وماذا سألكَ. ولا تضف شيئاً لم يقله.

activities.prompt: Mr Sabah left his glasses at home. Read him the nurse's card: what he should keep doing, what he doesn't have to do, when to come back, and when to ring instead.
activities.promptAr: نسي السيد صباح نظارته في البيت. اقرأ له بطاقة الممرضة: ما الذي ينبغي أن يستمر في فعله، وما الذي لا يلزمه فعله، ومتى يعود، ومتى يتصل بدل ذلك.
activities.sourceCard: Nurse's card for Mr Sabah: keep the arm moving gently through the day; you don't have to rest it completely. Something cool in the evening helps some people. Come back in two weeks if it is the same, and ring us straight away if it gets worse.

activities.prompt: Write the follow-up message to Mr Sabah's daughter. Say where the pain is and how long he has had it, what the nurse wrote on the card, what he doesn't have to do, and when the family should ring the clinic. Use only what you were told.
activities.promptAr: اكتب رسالة المتابعة إلى ابنة السيد صباح. اذكر مكان الألم ومنذ متى يعاني منه، وما كتبته الممرضة على البطاقة، وما الذي لا يلزمه فعله، ومتى ينبغي للعائلة أن تتصل بالعيادة. استخدم فقط ما قيل لكَ.

dialogue.speaker: Ghada
dialogue.en: It's my first week. Do I have to work a shift on Saturday?
dialogue.ar: هذا أسبوعي الأول. هل عليّ أن أعمل نوبة يوم السبت؟

dialogue.speaker: Tamer
dialogue.en: Every second Saturday. You're responsible for the front desk that morning.
dialogue.ar: كل سبت ثانٍ. أنتِ مسؤولة عن مكتب الاستقبال في ذلك الصباح.

dialogue.speaker: Ghada
dialogue.en: Is the reading room my duty as well?
dialogue.ar: وهل قاعة المطالعة من واجبي أيضاً؟

dialogue.speaker: Tamer
dialogue.en: No, Suha covers that. You don't have to touch it.
dialogue.ar: لا، سهى تغطّي ذلك. لا يلزمكِ الاقتراب منها.

dialogue.speaker: Ghada
dialogue.en: And the monthly list? Nobody told me the deadline.
dialogue.ar: والقائمة الشهرية؟ لم يخبرني أحد بالموعد النهائي.

dialogue.speaker: Tamer
dialogue.en: The fifteenth. Send it to the supervisor, and hand in the key at six.
dialogue.ar: الخامس عشر. أرسليها إلى المشرف، وسلّمي المفتاح في السادسة.

dialogue.speaker: Ghada
dialogue.en: So one duty on Saturday and one deadline a month.
dialogue.ar: إذن واجب واحد يوم السبت وموعد نهائي واحد في الشهر.

dialogue.speaker: Tamer
dialogue.en: That's all. Nobody has to stay late here.
dialogue.ar: هذا كل شيء. لا أحد مضطر للبقاء متأخراً هنا.

activities.prompt: What is Tamer explaining to Ghada in her first week?
activities.promptAr: ماذا يشرح تامر لغادة في أسبوعها الأول؟
options: Which jobs are hers and which are not
How to use the library computers
Why she should change her hours
activities.answer: Which jobs are hers and which are not
activities.audioTranscript: It's my first week. Do I have to work a shift on Saturday? Every second Saturday. You're responsible for the front desk that morning. Is the reading room my duty as well? No, Suha covers that. You don't have to touch it. And the monthly list? Nobody told me the deadline. The fifteenth. Send it to the supervisor, and hand in the key at six. So one duty on Saturday and one deadline a month. That's all. Nobody has to stay late here.

activities.prompt: A rule, or a free choice? Choose the form that fits.
activities.promptAr: إلزام أم اختيار حر؟ اختر الصيغة المناسبة.
activities.text: Suha covers the reading room, so you ___ open it yourself.
options: don't have to
have to
aren't having to
activities.answer: don't have to

activities.prompt: Match each person's hours with the duty that comes with them.
activities.promptAr: طابق ساعات عمل كل شخص بالواجب الذي يترتب عليها.
pairs: Rami works the late shift,
so he has to lock the building.
Hala is responsible for the accounts,
so she has to watch every deadline.
Omar only covers the desk at noon,
so he doesn't have to open the post.

activities.prompt: Listen to the message left for the new assistant. What doesn't she have to do?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى الرسالة المتروكة للمساعدة الجديدة. ما الذي لا يلزمها فعله؟
options: Count the money at the end of the day
Open the building at eight
Hand in the visitor list
activities.answer: Count the money at the end of the day
activities.audioTranscript: Hello, this is Nabila, your supervisor. About your first Saturday shift: you have to open the building at eight and stay on the front desk until one. Rami covers the afternoon, so you don't have to count the money at the end of the day. One more duty: the visitor list has a deadline of Monday morning, so please hand it in before you leave.

activities.prompt: Your cousin starts the same job as you next week. Tell her two things she has to do, one thing she doesn't have to do, and when the deadline is.
activities.promptAr: تبدأ ابنة عمّكَ العمل نفسه الأسبوع المقبل. أخبرها بأمرين عليها فعلهما، وأمرٍ واحد لا يلزمها، وبموعد التسليم النهائي.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.en: Have you ever worked with a large spreadsheet?
dialogue.ar: هل سبق أن عملتَ على جدول بيانات كبير؟

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.en: Yes, I've built a few at my old school. Never anything difficult.
dialogue.ar: نعم، سبق أن أنشأتُ بضعة جداول في مدرستي القديمة، ولا شيء صعب على الإطلاق.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.en: And the printer? Could you operate one before you came here?
dialogue.ar: وماذا عن الطابعة؟ هل كنتَ تستطيع تشغيل واحدة قبل مجيئك إلى هنا؟

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.en: No, I couldn't. I learned it on a short training course in June.
dialogue.ar: لا، لم أكن أستطيع. تعلّمتُ ذلك في دورة تدريبية قصيرة في حزيران.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.en: Have you ever taught the machine to anyone?
dialogue.ar: وهل سبق أن علّمتَ أحداً استخدام الآلة؟

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.en: I've never done that. But I'm sure I can.
dialogue.ar: لم يسبق أن فعلتُ ذلك قط، لكنني واثق أنني أستطيع.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.en: Good. Teaching is the skill this team needs most.
dialogue.ar: جيد. التعليم هو المهارة التي يحتاجها هذا الفريق أكثر من غيرها.

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.en: Then I've found the right job.
dialogue.ar: إذن وجدتُ الوظيفة المناسبة.

activities.prompt: What is Rania finding out about Sami?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي تحاول رانيا معرفته عن سامي؟
options: What he has done before, and what he learned recently
Which days of the week he is free
Why he left his old school
activities.answer: What he has done before, and what he learned recently
activities.audioTranscript: Have you ever worked with a large spreadsheet? Yes, I've built a few at my old school. Never anything difficult. And the printer? Could you operate one before you came here? No, I couldn't. I learned it on a short training course in June. Have you ever taught the machine to anyone? I've never done that. But I'm sure I can. Good. Teaching is the skill this team needs most. Then I've found the right job.

activities.prompt: This question asks about a whole life, not one fixed day. Choose the form that fits.
activities.promptAr: هذا السؤال يدور حول العمر كله لا حول يوم بعينه. اختر الصيغة المناسبة.
activities.text: ___ you ever worked in a school office?
options: Have
Did
Are
activities.answer: Have

activities.prompt: Match each question with the answer that fits it.
activities.promptAr: طابق كل سؤال بالإجابة المناسبة له.
pairs: Have you ever used a spreadsheet?
Twice, but only a very simple one.
Could you drive when you were eighteen?
No, I learned three years later.
Can you operate the printer?
Not yet, but I'll be able to after Thursday's training.

activities.prompt: Listen to the message about Dalal. Which one thing has she never done?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى الرسالة عن دلال. ما الأمر الذي لم يسبق لها أن فعلته؟
options: Worked at a reception desk
Used a spreadsheet
Taken a training course
activities.answer: Worked at a reception desk
activities.audioTranscript: Hi, it's Munir from the training centre. I'm calling about Dalal for the assistant job. She has taken two of our courses and she can use a spreadsheet well. She could already type quickly when she arrived. She has never worked at a reception desk, so she will need a week with someone patient. Otherwise, every skill on your list is there.

activities.prompt: Someone is asking about your abilities for a weekend job. Say one thing you have done before, one thing you have never done, and one thing you could do well a few years ago.
activities.promptAr: يسألكَ أحدهم عن قدراتكَ من أجل عمل في نهاية الأسبوع. اذكر أمراً سبق أن فعلته، وأمراً لم يسبق لكَ فعله، وأمراً كنتَ تُجيده قبل بضع سنوات.
partnerTurns: Thanks for coming in. Have you ever done this kind of work before?
I see. And is there anything on our list you have never tried?
One last thing: what could you do well a few years ago that you are out of practice with now?

dialogue.speaker: Maher
dialogue.en: Two things today, Lina. Answer the phone politely, and write every message clearly.
dialogue.ar: أمران اليوم يا لينا: أجيبي على الهاتف بأدب، واكتبي كل رسالة بوضوح.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.en: I wrote them quite quickly yesterday. Nobody could read my writing.
dialogue.ar: كتبتُها بسرعة كبيرة أمس، فلم يستطع أحد قراءة خطّي.

dialogue.speaker: Maher
dialogue.en: Then slow down. A slow note that works beats a fast one that doesn't.
dialogue.ar: إذن تمهّلي. ملاحظة بطيئة تؤدي الغرض خير من سريعة لا تؤديه.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.en: And the delivery forms?
dialogue.ar: وماذا عن استمارات التسليم؟

dialogue.speaker: Maher
dialogue.en: Fill them in carefully. One wrong number and the whole morning goes badly.
dialogue.ar: املئيها بعناية. رقم خاطئ واحد يفسد الصباح كله.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.en: Understood. I work well with lists, so I'll make one.
dialogue.ar: فهمت. أنا أعمل جيداً مع القوائم، لذا سأعدّ واحدة.

dialogue.speaker: Maher
dialogue.en: Good. Trainees who plan ahead work far more efficiently.
dialogue.ar: جيد. المتدربون الذين يخططون مسبقاً يعملون بكفاءة أكبر بكثير.

activities.prompt: What is Maher mainly telling Lina?
activities.promptAr: بماذا يخبر ماهر لينا بشكل أساسي؟
options: Not what to do, but how to do it
Which tasks she is allowed to skip
When the delivery is going to arrive
activities.answer: Not what to do, but how to do it
activities.audioTranscript: Two things today, Lina. Answer the phone politely, and write every message clearly. I wrote them quite quickly yesterday. Nobody could read my writing. Then slow down. A slow note that works beats a fast one that doesn't. And the delivery forms? Fill them in carefully. One wrong number and the whole morning goes badly. Understood. I work well with lists, so I'll make one. Good. Trainees who plan ahead work far more efficiently.

activities.prompt: The gap describes the action, not the person. Choose the form that fits.
activities.promptAr: الفراغ يصف الفعل لا الشخص. اختر الصيغة المناسبة.
activities.text: Please write the room number ___ so the driver can read it.
options: clearly
clear
clearness
activities.answer: clearly

activities.prompt: Read the note above the trainees' desk. How should each delivery form be filled in?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الملاحظة المعلقة فوق مكتب المتدربين. كيف ينبغي ملء كل استمارة تسليم؟
options: Carefully, and twice
Once, at the end of the day
Only when a customer asks for it
activities.answer: Carefully, and twice
activities.sourceText: Trainees, please read this before your first shift. Answer every caller politely, even when the line is busy. Write names and numbers clearly. Fill in each delivery form carefully, twice, and the afternoon will go much more efficiently.

activities.prompt: Listen to the first morning of the induction. What does the speaker ask people to do slowly?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى صباح التعريف الأول. ما الذي يطلب المتحدث فعله ببطء؟
options: Read the safety page
Walk through the store room
Answer the telephone
activities.answer: Read the safety page
activities.audioTranscript: Welcome, everyone. Three small things and then we start. Speak politely to every visitor, even the difficult ones. Fill in each form carefully; the office cannot work efficiently with half a name and no number. And please read the safety page slowly, all of it, before you sign at the bottom. Two minutes now saves an hour later.

activities.prompt: A new trainee joins your team tomorrow. Tell him three things to do, and say how to do each one — not only what, but how.
activities.promptAr: ينضم متدرب جديد إلى فريقكَ غداً. أخبره بثلاثة أمور عليه فعلها، وبيّن كيف يفعل كلاً منها — لا ماذا فقط، بل كيف.

dialogue.speaker: Basma
dialogue.en: I've decided to stop studying at night. I want to learn something practical.
dialogue.ar: قررتُ أن أتوقف عن الدراسة ليلاً. أريد أن أتعلم شيئاً عملياً.

dialogue.speaker: Idris
dialogue.en: The weekend workshop, then. It avoids exams completely.
dialogue.ar: إذن ورشة نهاية الأسبوع؛ فهي تتجنب الامتحانات تماماً.

dialogue.speaker: Basma
dialogue.en: Does it need a qualification?
dialogue.ar: هل تحتاج إلى مؤهل؟

dialogue.speaker: Idris
dialogue.en: No. They only ask you to bring some work experience, and I've got none.
dialogue.ar: لا. يطلبون منكِ فقط أن تحضري بعض الخبرة العملية، وأنا لا أملك شيئاً منها.

dialogue.speaker: Basma
dialogue.en: You've served coffee for three years. That counts.
dialogue.ar: أنتَ قدّمتَ القهوة ثلاث سنوات؛ هذا يُحتسب.

dialogue.speaker: Idris
dialogue.en: Really? Then I'd enjoy doing it with you.
dialogue.ar: حقاً؟ إذن سأستمتع بفعلها معكِ.

dialogue.speaker: Basma
dialogue.en: Good. The tutor lets people try three trades before they choose.
dialogue.ar: جيد. المدرّب يدع الناس يجربون ثلاث حِرَف قبل أن يختاروا.

activities.prompt: What are Basma and Idris deciding?
activities.promptAr: ماذا تقرر بسمة وإدريس؟
options: Which kind of learning suits them now
Where to look for an evening job
How much the weekend workshop costs
activities.answer: Which kind of learning suits them now
activities.audioTranscript: I've decided to stop studying at night. I want to learn something practical. The weekend workshop, then. It avoids exams completely. Does it need a qualification? No. They only ask you to bring some work experience, and I've got none. You've served coffee for three years. That counts. Really? Then I'd enjoy doing it with you. Good. The tutor lets people try three trades before they choose.

activities.prompt: One verb here takes -ing and the other takes to. Choose the form that fits.
activities.promptAr: أحد الفعلين هنا يأخذ ‑ing والآخر يأخذ to. اختر الصيغة المناسبة.
activities.text: She enjoys ___ with people, but she wants to work outdoors.
options: working
to work
work
activities.answer: working

activities.prompt: Listen to the start of the open evening. What does the speaker ask people to avoid?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى بداية الأمسية المفتوحة. ما الذي يطلب المتحدث تجنّبه؟
options: Choosing a course before trying one
Arriving after seven o'clock
Paying the fee on the first night
activities.answer: Choosing a course before trying one
activities.audioTranscript: Good evening, and thank you for coming. Every tutor here is happy to answer your questions, so please avoid choosing a course before you have tried one. Tonight you can sit in on three practical sessions. If you are interested in the course and hope to get a placement afterwards, tell your tutor tonight.

activities.prompt: Read the college's course page. What does it expect from its students?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ صفحة الدورة في الكلية. ما الذي تتوقعه من طلابها؟
options: Full attendance and a finished project
A qualification from a school
Six weeks of experience before they start
activities.answer: Full attendance and a finished project
activities.sourceText: Community Trades Course, Tuesdays and Thursdays. No qualification is needed, but we expect you to attend every session and to finish the practical project. Students who enjoy working with their hands do best. Six weeks of work experience follows the course.

activities.prompt: A friend has sent you two course pages and asked which one you would choose. Write your reply. Say what you enjoy doing, what you want to learn, one thing you hope to do afterwards, and why you chose that course.
activities.promptAr: أرسل إليكَ صديق صفحتَي دورتين وسألكَ أيهما تختار. اكتب ردكَ: قل ما تستمتع بفعله، وما تريد أن تتعلمه، وأمراً تأمل أن تفعله بعد ذلك، ولماذا اخترت تلك الدورة.

dialogue.speaker: Yaser
dialogue.en: Good morning. Could you tell me when the evening course starts?
dialogue.ar: صباح الخير. هل يمكنكِ إخباري متى تبدأ الدورة المسائية؟

dialogue.speaker: Hanan
dialogue.en: The fourth of March. Are you enrolling for the whole year?
dialogue.ar: في الرابع من آذار. هل تسجّل للسنة كاملة؟

dialogue.speaker: Yaser
dialogue.en: Possibly. Is it possible to pay the fee in two parts?
dialogue.ar: ربما. هل من الممكن دفع الرسم على دفعتين؟

dialogue.speaker: Hanan
dialogue.en: It is, if you ask before you enrol. Would you mind sending that in writing?
dialogue.ar: نعم، إن طلبتَ ذلك قبل التسجيل. هل تمانع في إرسال الطلب كتابةً؟

dialogue.speaker: Yaser
dialogue.en: Not at all. Could you also send me the timetable?
dialogue.ar: إطلاقاً. وهل يمكنكِ أن ترسلي لي الجدول الزمني أيضاً؟

dialogue.speaker: Hanan
dialogue.en: I'll email it today. Is there anything else you need to know?
dialogue.ar: سأرسله بالبريد الإلكتروني اليوم. هل من شيء آخر تودّ معرفته؟

dialogue.speaker: Yaser
dialogue.en: That is all the information I need. Thank you.
dialogue.ar: هذه كل المعلومات التي أحتاجها. شكراً لكِ.

activities.prompt: Why is Yaser calling the college?
activities.promptAr: لماذا يتصل ياسر بالكلية؟
options: To check dates, payment and the timetable
To complain about a class he missed
To give up his place on a course
activities.answer: To check dates, payment and the timetable
activities.audioTranscript: Good morning. Could you tell me when the evening course starts? The fourth of March. Are you enrolling for the whole year? Possibly. Is it possible to pay the fee in two parts? It is, if you ask before you enrol. Would you mind sending that in writing? Not at all. Could you also send me the timetable? I'll email it today. Is there anything else you need to know? That is all the information I need. Thank you.

activities.prompt: This is a formal enquiry, not a message to a friend. Choose the opening that fits.
activities.promptAr: هذا استفسار رسمي لا رسالة إلى صديق. اختر الافتتاحية المناسبة.
activities.text: ___ tell me whether the fee includes the materials?
options: Could you
You can
Tell me
activities.answer: Could you

activities.prompt: Read the two enquiries. Which one was written for an office, and why?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الاستفسارين. أيهما كُتب لمكتب رسمي، ولماذا؟
options: B, because it names the reader and asks in full sentences
A, because it is shorter and quicker to read
Neither, because both are far too direct
activities.answer: B, because it names the reader and asks in full sentences
activities.sourceText: A: Hi, when does the course start and how much? B: Dear Ms Farah, I am writing to ask about the spring course. Could you tell me the start date and the total fee? Is it possible to enrol online?

activities.prompt: Listen to the college's recorded line. What must an email about fees include?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى الخط المسجل للكلية. ما الذي يجب أن يتضمنه بريد إلكتروني عن الرسوم؟
options: The course name and your student number
A copy of your qualification
The name of your tutor
activities.answer: The course name and your student number
activities.audioTranscript: You have reached the enrolment office. Our lines are open from nine until four. For an enquiry about fees, please send an email and include the course name and your student number, or we cannot answer you. If you would like to enrol for the spring term, the last day is the twentieth of February. Thank you for calling.

activities.prompt: You are on the phone to a college office about a course you want to join. Ask politely for three things you still do not know, and check one thing you were told.
activities.promptAr: أنتَ على الهاتف مع مكتب الكلية بشأن دورة تريد الالتحاق بها. اطلب بأدب ثلاثة أمور ما زلتَ تجهلها، وتحقق من أمر واحد قيل لكَ.
partnerTurns: Good afternoon, enrolment office. How can I help you?
Of course. Ask me whatever you need, and I will check the file while you talk.
Let me repeat that back to you. Is there anything else before I close the call?

lessons.title: Apply for a Course or Job

readingText.title: An Application for the Saturday Vacancy
readingText.text: Dear Ms Haddad, I am writing to apply for the Saturday assistant vacancy at the community centre. I saw the notice in the library window last week. I am nineteen and I finished school in June. For two years I worked in my uncle's shop at weekends, so I am used to talking to people all day. I can use a spreadsheet, and I have never missed a shift. I could not drive when I started there; I can now. I am free every Saturday and most evenings. I would like the job to get real work experience before I apply to college next year. Ms Farah at the library has agreed to give a reference. Yours sincerely, Karim Nasser
readingText.textAr: حضرة السيدة حدّاد المحترمة، أكتب إليكِ للتقدم لوظيفة المساعد يوم السبت في المركز المجتمعي. رأيتُ الإعلان في نافذة المكتبة الأسبوع الماضي. عمري تسعة عشر عاماً، وأنهيتُ المدرسة في حزيران. عملتُ سنتين في متجر عمّي في عطلات نهاية الأسبوع، ولذلك اعتدتُ التحدث إلى الناس طوال اليوم. أستطيع استخدام جداول البيانات، ولم يسبق أن تغيّبتُ عن نوبة عمل. لم أكن أستطيع القيادة حين بدأتُ هناك، أما الآن فأستطيع. أنا متفرغ كل سبت ومعظم الأمسيات. أرغب في هذه الوظيفة لأكتسب خبرة عملية حقيقية قبل أن أتقدم إلى الكلية العام المقبل. وقد وافقت السيدة فرح من المكتبة على تزكيتي. وتفضلوا بقبول فائق الاحترام، كريم ناصر

activities.prompt: Read Karim's letter once. What is he offering the centre?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ رسالة كريم مرة واحدة. ماذا يقدّم للمركز؟
options: Weekend hours and shop experience, in return for his first real job
A college qualification and three written references
Full-time work from the middle of June
activities.answer: Weekend hours and shop experience, in return for his first real job

activities.prompt: Listen to the centre's voicemail for Karim. What does it ask him to bring?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة المركز الصوتية لكريم. بماذا تطلب منه أن يأتي؟
options: The name of one referee and a note of his free hours
A printed copy of the letter he sent
His school certificate and a photograph
activities.answer: The name of one referee and a note of his free hours
activities.audioTranscript: Hello Karim, this is the community centre, about your application. Every applicant comes in for twenty minutes before we decide, and yours is on Thursday at five. Bring the name of one referee and a note of the hours you are free; we ask for availability in writing. You don't have to bring anything else. Ring us if Thursday is difficult.

activities.prompt: Before you write anything, say your own version of Karim's letter aloud. Name the role you want, two things you can do, and your reason for wanting it.
activities.promptAr: قبل أن تكتب شيئاً، قل نسختكَ من رسالة كريم بصوت عالٍ. سمِّ الوظيفة التي تريدها، وأمرين تستطيع فعلهما، وسبب رغبتكَ فيها.

activities.prompt: Your neighbour cannot read the notice on the centre's door, and her son wants to apply. Tell her what he has to send, what he does not need, and the last day.
activities.promptAr: جارتكَ لا تستطيع قراءة الإعلان على باب المركز، وابنها يريد التقدم. أخبرها بما عليه إرساله، وبما لا يحتاج إليه، وبآخر يوم للتقديم.
activities.sourceCard: Saturday assistant vacancy. Send a short letter and the name of one referee by 9 May. Applicants do not need a qualification. Please state the hours you are available. We answer every applicant within a week.

activities.prompt: Now write your own application, the way Karim wrote his. Name the role, say two things you can do and one thing you have done before, give your free hours, and say why you want it. Keep to what a stranger needs to know.
activities.promptAr: اكتب الآن طلبكَ أنتَ، كما كتب كريم طلبه. سمِّ الوظيفة، واذكر أمرين تستطيع فعلهما وأمراً سبق أن فعلته، وساعات فراغكَ، وسبب رغبتكَ فيها. اقتصر على ما يحتاج غريب إلى معرفته.

requiredGroups: I would like the job to

lessons.title: Mission: Complete a Course or Job Application
lessons.titleAr: المهمة: أكمل طلب دورة أو عمل
lessons.scenario: Choose an unseen course or entry-level role, understand its requirements, ask for missing information and submit a short application.

activities.prompt: Read the notice on the community board before you choose. What does the museum want applicants to tell it?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الإعلان على لوحة إعلانات الحي قبل أن تختار. ما الذي يريد المتحف من المتقدمين أن يذكروه؟
options: Where they have worked before
Which school they attended
How much they expect to be paid
activities.answer: Where they have worked before
activities.sourceText: Museum Saturday Guide, six months. You will welcome visitors, answer questions politely and keep the entrance desk tidy. You do not need a qualification, but tell us clearly where you have worked before. Closing date: 3 April.

activities.prompt: Listen to the museum's recorded line. Which detail was missing from the notice?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى الخط المسجل للمتحف. أي تفصيل كان ناقصاً في الإعلان؟
options: The hours of the Saturday shift
The closing date for applications
The name of the role
activities.answer: The hours of the Saturday shift
activities.audioTranscript: Thank you for calling the museum. The Saturday guide role runs from ten until four, with an hour for lunch. Applicants should send a short letter and the name of one referee to the office by the third of April. We cannot answer questions about the fee for the training day until March. Please leave your number after the tone.

activities.prompt: Ring the museum office. Ask politely for two things neither the notice nor the recording told you, and answer what you are asked about yourself.
activities.promptAr: اتصل بمكتب المتحف. اطلب بأدب أمرين لم يخبركَ بهما الإعلان ولا التسجيل، وأجب عمّا تُسأل عنه بشأن نفسكَ.
partnerTurns: Good morning, museum office. Are you calling about the Saturday guide role?
Ask me whatever the notice didn't say, and then tell me a little about yourself.
One last question: have you ever done anything like this before?

activities.prompt: Explain to a friend why the museum role suits you. Say what the job needs, what you can do, one thing you have done before, and one thing you have never done.
activities.promptAr: اشرح لصديق لماذا تناسبكَ وظيفة المتحف. قل ما تتطلبه الوظيفة، وما تستطيع فعله، وأمراً سبق أن فعلته، وأمراً لم يسبق لكَ فعله.

activities.prompt: Your cousin does not read English and has had the same reply. Tell him the day and time, what he has to bring, what he does not have to do, and what to do if he cannot come.
activities.promptAr: ابن عمّكَ لا يقرأ الإنجليزية وقد وصله الرد نفسه. أخبره باليوم والساعة، وبما عليه إحضاره، وبما لا يلزمه فعله، وبما يفعله إن تعذّر عليه الحضور.
activities.sourceCard: Reply from the museum: we have read your letter and would like to meet you on 12 April at eleven. Please bring something with your name and photograph on it. You do not have to prepare anything. If that morning is difficult, ring the office and we will move it.

activities.prompt: Write the letter that goes with your application for the museum role. Say which role you want and where you saw it, two things you can do, one thing you have done before, your free hours, and why you want it.
activities.promptAr: اكتب الرسالة المرافقة لطلبكَ لوظيفة المتحف. قل أي وظيفة تريد وأين رأيتها، وأمرين تستطيع فعلهما، وأمراً سبق أن فعلته، وساعات فراغكَ، ولماذا تريدها.

dialogue.speaker: Basma
dialogue.en: Put it on the desk and press the top button. Hold it down — don't just tap it.
dialogue.ar: ضعه على الطاولة واضغط الزر العلوي. أبقِ إصبعك عليه ولا تنقره نقرة سريعة.

dialogue.speaker: Jamal
dialogue.en: I pressed it for a second and nothing happened. Is the screen broken?
dialogue.ar: ضغطتُه ثانية واحدة فلم يحدث شيء. هل الشاشة معطّلة؟

dialogue.speaker: Basma
dialogue.en: Press and hold it for five seconds. If it is only asleep, it wakes up.
dialogue.ar: اضغط عليه مطوّلاً خمس ثوانٍ. إذا كان نائماً فقط فإنه يستيقظ.

dialogue.speaker: Jamal
dialogue.en: Still black. Can I charge it here, or should I take it home?
dialogue.ar: ما زالت سوداء. هل يمكنني شحنه هنا، أم آخذه إلى البيت؟

dialogue.speaker: Basma
dialogue.en: Charge it here. Plug the cable in at the side, then wait two minutes before you try again.
dialogue.ar: اشحنه هنا. صِل الكابل من الجانب، ثم انتظر دقيقتين قبل أن تحاول مرة أخرى.

dialogue.speaker: Jamal
dialogue.en: There it is. So the battery was flat, not the screen.
dialogue.ar: ها هو قد عاد. إذن البطارية كانت فارغة، لا الشاشة.

dialogue.speaker: Basma
dialogue.en: It usually is. Charge it overnight and it lasts all day.
dialogue.ar: غالباً ما تكون كذلك. اشحنه ليلاً فيدوم طوال النهار.

activities.prompt: Listen once. What are Basma and Jamal working out between them?
activities.promptAr: استمع مرة واحدة. ما الذي تحاول بسمة وجمال معرفته معاً؟
options: Whether the tablet is broken or simply out of charge
Which tablet Jamal should borrow from the library
How to get the library's Wi-Fi onto the tablet
activities.answer: Whether the tablet is broken or simply out of charge
activities.audioTranscript: Put it on the desk and press the top button. Hold it down — don't just tap it. I pressed it for a second and nothing happened. Is the screen broken? Press and hold it for five seconds. If it is only asleep, it wakes up. Still black. Can I charge it here, or should I take it home? Charge it here. Plug the cable in at the side, then wait two minutes before you try again. There it is. So the battery was flat, not the screen. It usually is. Charge it overnight and it lasts all day.

activities.prompt: This line tells somebody what to do; it does not describe what happens. Choose the form that fits.
activities.promptAr: هذا السطر يأمر بفعل شيء ولا يصف ما يحدث. اختر الصيغة المناسبة.
activities.text: The screen is still dark, so ___ the cable in and wait two minutes.
options: plug
plugs
plugging
activities.answer: plug

activities.prompt: Match each problem with the instruction that answers it.
activities.promptAr: طابق كل مشكلة بالتعليمة التي تعالجها.
pairs: The screen stays black even after a long wait,
so plug the cable in and leave it a few minutes.
The tablet is only asleep,
so press and hold the top button for five seconds.
The battery is flat by lunchtime every day,
so charge it overnight instead of in the morning.

activities.prompt: Listen to Basma's message. What should Jamal do when the tablet will not wake up?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة بسمة. ماذا ينبغي أن يفعل جمال عندما لا يستيقظ اللوح؟
options: Hold the top button down until something appears
Push the small hole at the back with a pin
Change the cable in the box for a different one
activities.answer: Hold the top button down until something appears
activities.audioTranscript: Hello Jamal, it is Basma at the library. About the tablet you took home: the cable in the box belongs to a different machine, so please don't use it. Bring the tablet back to the desk tomorrow and I will give you the right one. Until then, charge it from your computer instead. And one more thing, because everybody does this. There is a small hole at the back. Don't push anything into it. People try that when the tablet will not wake up, and then the tablet forgets everything on it. Hold the top button down instead, and wait.

activities.prompt: A neighbour's phone will not switch on and he has rung you. Give him three instructions in the order he should try them, and say what to do if the screen is still dark after all three.
activities.promptAr: هاتف جاركَ لا يعمل وقد اتصل بكَ. أعطه ثلاث تعليمات بالترتيب الذي ينبغي أن يجرّبها به، وقل له ماذا يفعل إذا بقيت الشاشة مظلمة بعدها جميعاً.

dialogue.speaker: Nizar
dialogue.en: The nurse says I can fill the form in on my phone. How do I connect to the Wi-Fi here?
dialogue.ar: تقول الممرضة إن بإمكاني تعبئة الاستمارة على هاتفي. كيف أتصل بشبكة الواي فاي هنا؟

dialogue.speaker: Salwa
dialogue.en: First go to settings and turn Wi-Fi on. Next choose 'Clinic Guest' from the list.
dialogue.ar: اذهب أولاً إلى الإعدادات وشغّل الواي فاي، ثم اختر «ضيف العيادة» من القائمة.

dialogue.speaker: Nizar
dialogue.en: It is asking me for a code.
dialogue.ar: إنه يطلب منّي رمزاً.

dialogue.speaker: Salwa
dialogue.en: It is on the card by the door. Then open the message I sent you and tap the blue link.
dialogue.ar: الرمز مكتوب على البطاقة المعلّقة بجانب الباب. بعد ذلك افتح الرسالة التي أرسلتها إليكَ وانقر الرابط الأزرق.

dialogue.speaker: Nizar
dialogue.en: Done. It says I am connected.
dialogue.ar: تمّ. يقول إنني متصل.

dialogue.speaker: Salwa
dialogue.en: Finally, choose 'download'. The form opens by itself, and it stays in your downloads folder.
dialogue.ar: وأخيراً اختر «تنزيل». تُفتح الاستمارة وحدها، وتبقى في مجلد التنزيلات لديكَ.

dialogue.speaker: Nizar
dialogue.en: And if it does not open?
dialogue.ar: وإذا لم تُفتح؟

dialogue.speaker: Salwa
dialogue.en: Look in that folder. It is usually sitting there, waiting for you.
dialogue.ar: ابحث في ذلك المجلد. عادةً ما تكون موجودة هناك في انتظاركَ.

activities.prompt: Listen once. What is Salwa walking Nizar through?
activities.promptAr: استمع مرة واحدة. ما الذي ترشد سلوى نزاراً إليه؟
options: Getting onto the clinic's network and opening a form
Booking a different appointment for next week
Sending a photograph of his card to the nurse
activities.answer: Getting onto the clinic's network and opening a form
activities.audioTranscript: The nurse says I can fill the form in on my phone. How do I connect to the Wi-Fi here? First go to settings and turn Wi-Fi on. Next choose 'Clinic Guest' from the list. It is asking me for a code. It is on the card by the door. Then open the message I sent you and tap the blue link. Done. It says I am connected. Finally, choose 'download'. The form opens by itself, and it stays in your downloads folder. And if it does not open? Look in that folder. It is usually sitting there, waiting for you.

activities.prompt: Three steps, and this one is the last. Choose the word that says so.
activities.promptAr: ثلاث خطوات، وهذه آخرها. اختر الكلمة التي تدل على ذلك.
activities.text: First open the message, next tap the link, and ___ choose 'download'.
options: finally
first
next
activities.answer: finally

activities.prompt: Put Salwa's first two steps back into the order she gave them.
activities.promptAr: أعد ترتيب أولى خطوتين ذكرتهما سلوى كما قالتهما.

activities.prompt: Listen to Rida's message from the college office. What should the student sign in with?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة رضا من مكتب الكلية. بأي شيء ينبغي أن تسجّل الطالبة دخولها؟
options: The number printed on her student card
The email address she gave the office
The name of the course she is taking
activities.answer: The number printed on her student card
activities.audioTranscript: Hello, this is Rida from the college office. You asked me how to get the reading list. First, sign in to the student page with the number printed on your card, not with your email address. Next, open 'My Courses' and choose the right course. Then you will see a grey button that says 'Files'. Tap it, and the reading list is the first thing in the folder. Finally, choose 'download', so that you still have the list when you are nowhere near the college. If the grey button does nothing at all, the page has not finished loading. Wait a moment and tap it again.

activities.prompt: A cousin rings you from a clinic waiting room. Talk her through getting onto the network and opening the form, one step at a time, and answer what she asks you.
activities.promptAr: تتصل بكَ ابنة عمّكَ من قاعة انتظار في عيادة. أرشدها إلى الاتصال بالشبكة وفتح الاستمارة خطوة خطوة، وأجب عمّا تسألكَ عنه.
partnerTurns: They have told me to fill the form in on my phone, and I don't know where to start.
All right, Wi-Fi is on. There is a long list of names here, and now it is asking me for something.
It says I am connected. So where is this form, and what do I do with it?

dialogue.speaker: Rawan
dialogue.en: If the light is orange, the printer is only thinking. Give it a minute.
dialogue.ar: إذا كان الضوء برتقالياً فالطابعة تفكّر فقط. امنحها دقيقة.

dialogue.speaker: Tamer
dialogue.en: It has been orange since I arrived, and nothing comes out.
dialogue.ar: إنه برتقالي منذ أن وصلت، ولا يخرج شيء.

dialogue.speaker: Rawan
dialogue.en: Then read the small screen. If it says 'no paper', the bottom tray is empty.
dialogue.ar: إذن اقرأ الشاشة الصغيرة. إذا كُتب فيها «لا يوجد ورق» فالدرج السفلي فارغ.

dialogue.speaker: Tamer
dialogue.en: It says 'offline'.
dialogue.ar: مكتوب فيها «غير متصل».

dialogue.speaker: Rawan
dialogue.en: That one is easy. If a printer goes offline, it has lost the network. Restart it: switch it off, count to ten, and switch it on again.
dialogue.ar: هذه سهلة. إذا صارت الطابعة غير متصلة فهذا يعني أنها فقدت الشبكة. أعِد تشغيلها: أطفئها، وعُدّ إلى عشرة، ثم شغّلها من جديد.

dialogue.speaker: Tamer
dialogue.en: And if the light turns red?
dialogue.ar: وإذا تحوّل الضوء إلى الأحمر؟

dialogue.speaker: Rawan
dialogue.en: If it turns red, do not open anything. You press the red button twice and it starts again. If that does not work, we ring the shop.
dialogue.ar: إذا تحوّل إلى الأحمر فلا تفتح أي غطاء. تضغط الزر الأحمر مرتين فتبدأ من جديد. وإذا لم ينفع ذلك فنتصل بالمحل.

activities.prompt: Listen once. What is Rawan teaching Tamer?
activities.promptAr: استمع مرة واحدة. ما الذي تعلّمه روان لتامر؟
options: What each light and message on the printer means, and what to do about it
Why the office should buy a newer printer this year
How to order more paper before the office runs out
activities.answer: What each light and message on the printer means, and what to do about it
activities.audioTranscript: If the light is orange, the printer is only thinking. Give it a minute. It has been orange since I arrived, and nothing comes out. Then read the small screen. If it says 'no paper', the bottom tray is empty. It says 'offline'. That one is easy. If a printer goes offline, it has lost the network. Restart it: switch it off, count to ten, and switch it on again. And if the light turns red? If it turns red, do not open anything. You press the red button twice and it starts again. If that does not work, we ring the shop.

activities.prompt: This is what always happens, not a plan for one afternoon. Choose the form that fits.
activities.promptAr: هذا ما يحدث دائماً، لا خطة لبعد ظهر يوم بعينه. اختر الصيغة المناسبة.
activities.text: If the light ___ red, the printer stops and waits for you.
options: turns
will turn
turned
activities.answer: turns

activities.prompt: Read the card taped inside meeting room two. What does it say about the sound?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ البطاقة الملصقة داخل قاعة الاجتماعات الثانية. ماذا تقول عن الصوت؟
options: The cable is in the wrong socket
The laptop has not finished starting
Somebody has changed a setting
activities.answer: The cable is in the wrong socket
activities.sourceText: Meeting room two, please read before you start. If the screen shows a blue box, the laptop is still starting; give it a minute. If the sound does not work, the cable is in the wrong socket at the back. If you change any setting, put it back before you leave the room.

activities.prompt: Listen to Hazem's message. What should his aunt do if the picture stops but the sound carries on?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة حازم. ماذا ينبغي أن تفعل خالته إذا توقفت الصورة واستمر الصوت؟
options: Press the round button on the small remote
Pull the cable out of the wall and count to ten
Type in the password from the book by the phone
activities.answer: Press the round button on the small remote
activities.audioTranscript: Auntie, it is Hazem. I am sorry I could not come on Friday, so here is what I do when the television box stops. If the picture stops but the sound carries on, nothing is broken: press the round button on the small remote and the picture catches up. If both of them stop, restart the box. Pull the cable out of the wall, count to ten, and put it back in. If it asks for the password after that, the password is written inside the cover of the book by the phone. If none of that works, leave it and I will look on Friday.

activities.prompt: A friend's laptop will not reach her home network. Say what she should check, in the order you would check it yourself, and start each step with 'if'.
activities.promptAr: حاسوب صديقتكَ لا يصل إلى شبكة بيتها. قل ما الذي ينبغي أن تتحقق منه، بالترتيب الذي كنتَ ستتبعه بنفسكَ، وابدأ كل خطوة بـ if.

dialogue.speaker: Dina
dialogue.en: Ghassan, the letter for the parents — have you finished it?
dialogue.ar: غسّان، رسالة أولياء الأمور، هل أنهيتها؟

dialogue.speaker: Ghassan
dialogue.en: It is in the shared folder. I put it there this morning.
dialogue.ar: إنها في المجلد المشترك. وضعتها هناك هذا الصباح.

dialogue.speaker: Dina
dialogue.en: I can see two letters. Which one do I send?
dialogue.ar: أرى رسالتين. أيّهما أُرسل؟

dialogue.speaker: Ghassan
dialogue.en: The one with today's date. Open that, and leave the other; it is last year's.
dialogue.ar: تلك التي تحمل تاريخ اليوم. افتحي تلك واتركي الأخرى، فهي رسالة العام الماضي.

dialogue.speaker: Dina
dialogue.en: And the photographs from the trip — where are they?
dialogue.ar: وصور الرحلة، أين هي؟

dialogue.speaker: Ghassan
dialogue.en: They are in the same folder. Do not send them as an attachment; the message becomes too heavy. Copy the link and send that instead.
dialogue.ar: هي في المجلد نفسه. لا ترسليها كمرفق، فالرسالة تصبح ثقيلة جداً. انسخي الرابط وأرسليه بدلاً منها.

dialogue.speaker: Dina
dialogue.en: So the letter is attached to the message, and the photographs stay behind the link.
dialogue.ar: إذن الخطاب يُرفق بالرسالة، والصور تبقى خلف الرابط.

dialogue.speaker: Ghassan
dialogue.en: Exactly. That is the safe way round.
dialogue.ar: بالضبط. هذه هي الطريقة الآمنة.

activities.prompt: Listen once. What are Dina and Ghassan sorting out?
activities.promptAr: استمع مرة واحدة. ما الذي ترتّبه دينا وغسّان؟
options: How to send one document and a set of photographs
Whether the school trip should be cancelled
Who is going to write the letter for the parents
activities.answer: How to send one document and a set of photographs
activities.audioTranscript: Ghassan, the letter for the parents — have you finished it? It is in the shared folder. I put it there this morning. I can see two letters. Which one do I send? The one with today's date. Open that, and leave the other; it is last year's. And the photographs from the trip — where are they? They are in the same folder. Do not send them as an attachment; the message becomes too heavy. Copy the link and send that instead. So the letter is attached to the message, and the photographs stay behind the link. Exactly. That is the safe way round.

activities.prompt: Each line comes from a message about the shared folder. Match the word in quotation marks to the thing it points back to.
activities.promptAr: كل سطر مأخوذ من رسالة عن المجلد المشترك. طابق الكلمة الموضوعة بين علامتي تنصيص بما تعود إليه.
pairs: Open the letter and print 'it' before the meeting starts.
the letter
The photographs are large, so do not send 'them' by email.
the photographs
We moved the trip to Thursday, and 'that' surprised the parents.
moving the trip to Thursday

activities.prompt: Listen to Warda's message from the school office. What is she asking people to stop doing?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة وردة من مكتب المدرسة. ما الذي تطلب من الناس التوقف عنه؟
options: Putting photographs into the class-list folder
Sending the class list out by email
Signing in on the computers in the office
activities.answer: Putting photographs into the class-list folder
activities.audioTranscript: Hello everyone, it is Warda in the office. Two small things this week. The new class list is in the shared folder; please look at it today and tell me straight away if a name is missing. The second thing is this. Somebody is uploading photographs into the same folder from a personal account, and I would rather they did not. Put them in the 'Trips' folder instead, then copy the link into your message. That keeps the class list where people can find it. If you cannot open the folder at all, you are probably signed in to the wrong account.

activities.prompt: Read the message Dina finally sent. What does 'they' refer to?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الرسالة التي أرسلتها دينا في النهاية. إلى ماذا تعود كلمة they؟
options: The photographs from last year
The parents who are reading the message
The pages at the end of the letter
activities.answer: The photographs from last year
activities.sourceText: Dear parents, the letter about the trip is attached to this message. Please read it and sign the last page. The photographs from last year are behind the link below; they are very large, so open them at home and not on a phone.

activities.prompt: Your study group cannot find last week's notes. Write them a short message saying where everything is: send the notes with the message, put the photographs behind a link, and use 'it', 'them' and 'that' so that nobody has to guess what each step points to.
activities.promptAr: مجموعة دراستكَ لا تجد ملاحظات الأسبوع الماضي. اكتب لهم رسالة قصيرة توضح أين كل شيء: أرسل الملاحظات مع الرسالة، وضع الصور خلف رابط، واستخدم it وthem وthat حتى لا يضطر أحد إلى التخمين.

dialogue.speaker: Maysoon
dialogue.en: Thank you for waiting. What happens when you open the app?
dialogue.ar: شكراً على انتظاركَ. ماذا يحدث عندما تفتح التطبيق؟

dialogue.speaker: Adel
dialogue.en: It opens, I sign in, and then the screen freezes and goes white.
dialogue.ar: يُفتح، وأسجّل الدخول، ثم تتجمّد الشاشة وتصير بيضاء.

dialogue.speaker: Maysoon
dialogue.en: Does it do that every time, or only on Wi-Fi?
dialogue.ar: هل يحدث ذلك في كل مرة، أم على الواي فاي فقط؟

dialogue.speaker: Adel
dialogue.en: Every time. I have tried my tablet as well, and it does the same.
dialogue.ar: في كل مرة. جرّبتُ لوحي أيضاً، فحدث الأمر نفسه.

dialogue.speaker: Maysoon
dialogue.en: Have you closed the app and opened it again?
dialogue.ar: هل أغلقتَ التطبيق ثم فتحته من جديد؟

dialogue.speaker: Adel
dialogue.en: I've tried that already, twice. Nothing changed.
dialogue.ar: جرّبتُ ذلك بالفعل مرّتين، ولم يتغيّر شيء.

dialogue.speaker: Maysoon
dialogue.en: Then it is not your phone. What error message do you see before the screen turns white?
dialogue.ar: إذن المشكلة ليست في هاتفكَ. ما رسالة الخطأ التي تظهر لكَ قبل أن تبيضّ الشاشة؟

dialogue.speaker: Adel
dialogue.en: A small grey line at the bottom. It says error 204. Shall I send you a screenshot?
dialogue.ar: سطر رمادي صغير في الأسفل، مكتوب فيه: خطأ 204. هل أرسل لكِ صورة للشاشة؟

activities.prompt: Listen once. What is Maysoon trying to establish?
activities.promptAr: استمع مرة واحدة. ما الذي تحاول ميسون التوصل إليه؟
options: What the app does before it fails, and what Adel has already tried
Which phone Adel ought to buy to replace this one
Whether Adel's home internet is fast enough for the app
activities.answer: What the app does before it fails, and what Adel has already tried
activities.audioTranscript: Thank you for waiting. What happens when you open the app? It opens, I sign in, and then the screen freezes and goes white. Does it do that every time, or only on Wi-Fi? Every time. I have tried my tablet as well, and it does the same. Have you closed the app and opened it again? I've tried that already, twice. Nothing changed. Then it is not your phone. What error message do you see before the screen turns white? A small grey line at the bottom. It says error 204. Shall I send you a screenshot?

activities.prompt: The desk is asking what the app does every time, not what it did once. Choose the form that fits.
activities.promptAr: يسأل مكتب الدعم عمّا يفعله التطبيق في كل مرة، لا عمّا فعله مرة واحدة. اختر الصيغة المناسبة.
activities.text: What ___ when you tap the blue button at the bottom?
options: happens
happen
is happen
activities.answer: happens

activities.prompt: Match each help-desk question with the answer that actually answers it.
activities.promptAr: طابق كل سؤال من مكتب الدعم بالجواب الذي يجيب عنه فعلاً.
pairs: What happens when you sign in?
The screen freezes and then goes white.
Does it happen on Wi-Fi as well?
Yes, on Wi-Fi and away from the house.
Have you tried it on another machine?
I've tried that already, on my tablet.
What error message do you see?
A grey line at the bottom saying error 204.

activities.prompt: Listen to Ghada's message from the support team. What does she ask Mr Adel not to do?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة غادة من فريق الدعم. ما الذي تطلب من السيد عادل ألا يفعله؟
options: Install the app on his phone again
Open his account in a browser
Send the support team another screenshot
activities.answer: Install the app on his phone again
activities.audioTranscript: Good afternoon, this is Ghada from the support team, returning Mr Adel's call. Thank you for the screenshot. Error 204 means the app cannot reach our machines, so the problem is on our side and not on your phone. We do have a solution, but it arrives with the update on Thursday. Until then, please do not install the app again; it will not help, and you will lose the pages you saved. If you need the account today, open it in a browser instead. What happens there is exactly the same, only a little slower.

activities.prompt: Ring a help desk about an app that fails on your phone. Say what happens when you open it, what you have already tried, and read out the exact message you can see.
activities.promptAr: اتصل بمكتب الدعم بشأن تطبيق لا يعمل على هاتفكَ. قل ماذا يحدث عندما تفتحه، وما الذي جرّبته بالفعل، واقرأ الرسالة التي تظهر لكَ نصّاً.
partnerTurns: Support desk, good morning. Tell me what the app is doing.
I see. And what happens when you sign in — does it stop straight away, or after a moment?
Right. Have you tried anything yourself before you rang us?

readingText.title: A Short Guide for Khalid
readingText.text: Khalid, here are the four things I promised to write down for you, step by step. First, give every important account its own password. If you use one password everywhere and somebody learns it, that person has all of them. Keep the list in the little book in your drawer, not in a note on the phone. Second, turn the screen lock on. It costs you four seconds each time you pick the phone up, and it keeps a lost phone secure. Third, make a backup once a week to protect the photographs. If the phone falls in the sea on a Thursday, you lose four days, not four years. Finally, and this is the one that matters: never share your password, and never read a code out to anyone who rings you. A real bank never asks for either of them. If a message asks you, it is not from the bank. Ring me instead and we will look at it together. Rania
readingText.textAr: خالد، إليكَ الأمور الأربعة التي وعدتكَ بأن أكتبها لكَ، خطوة خطوة. أولاً، اجعل لكل حساب مهم كلمة مرور خاصة به. فإذا استعملتَ كلمة مرور واحدة في كل مكان وعرفها أحد، صارت في يده حساباتكَ كلها. احتفظ بالقائمة في الدفتر الصغير الذي في الدرج، لا في ملاحظة على الهاتف. ثانياً، شغّل قفل الشاشة. إنه يكلّفكَ أربع ثوانٍ كلما رفعتَ الهاتف، ويُبقي الهاتف الضائع آمناً. ثالثاً، اعمل نسخة احتياطية مرة كل أسبوع لتحمي الصور. فإذا سقط الهاتف في البحر يوم الخميس، خسرتَ أربعة أيام لا أربع سنوات. وأخيراً، وهذا هو الأهم: لا تشارك كلمة مرورك أبداً، ولا تقرأ رمزاً لأي شخص يتصل بكَ. المصرف الحقيقي لا يطلب أياً منهما أبداً، وإذا طلبت منكَ رسالة ذلك فهي ليست من المصرف. اتصل بي بدل ذلك وننظر فيها معاً. رانيا

activities.prompt: Read Rania's guide once. What is she mainly giving Khalid?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ دليل رانيا مرة واحدة. ما الذي تقدمه لخالد بشكل أساسي؟
options: Four habits that keep his phone and his accounts safe
A list of the phones she thinks he should look at
Instructions for sending photographs to the family
activities.answer: Four habits that keep his phone and his accounts safe

activities.prompt: Listen to Rania's next message. Why did her neighbour lose the money?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة رانيا التالية. لماذا خسرت جارتها المال؟
options: She read out the numbers the message asked for
She used the same password on two accounts
She had not made a backup of her phone
activities.answer: She read out the numbers the message asked for
activities.audioTranscript: Khalid, it is Rania again. Something happened to my neighbour this week, so I am adding it to the guide. She had a message that looked exactly like the bank's: the same name, the same colours, everything. It said her account was locked, and it asked her to read out the six numbers they had just sent to her phone. She read them out, and by the evening the money had gone. Nobody from a bank will ever ask you for those numbers. Nobody. If a message asks you, put the phone down and ring the number printed on your own card.

activities.prompt: Before you write anything, say your own version aloud, the way Rania wrote hers. Give two steps, the purpose of each one, and the single thing the reader must never do.
activities.promptAr: قبل أن تكتب شيئاً، قل نسختكَ بصوت عالٍ كما كتبت رانيا نسختها. اذكر خطوتين وغرض كل منهما، والأمر الوحيد الذي يجب ألا يفعله القارئ أبداً.

activities.prompt: Your mother does not read English. She has photographed a warning on her screen and wants to know what it says. Tell her what has happened, what she does not have to do if it was her, and the two things to do if it was not.
activities.promptAr: والدتكَ لا تقرأ الإنجليزية. صوّرت تحذيراً ظهر على شاشتها وتريد أن تعرف ما فيه. أخبرها بما حدث، وبما لا يلزمها فعله إن كانت هي، وبالأمرين اللذين تفعلهما إن لم تكن هي.
activities.sourceCard: Security warning: somebody signed in to your account from a new device in another city. If this was you, no action is needed. If it was not you, change your password now and sign out of every device. We will never ask you for your password in a message.

activities.prompt: Write your own guide for somebody who has just been given a first smartphone. Give three steps in order with the purpose of each, one 'if' sentence for the moment something goes wrong, and one clear warning about what never to share. Keep to the advice in Rania's guide.
activities.promptAr: اكتب دليلكَ الخاص لشخص حصل للتو على أول هاتف ذكي. اذكر ثلاث خطوات مرتبة مع غرض كل منها، وجملة واحدة بـ if لما يحدث عند حصول خلل، وتحذيراً واضحاً بشأن ما لا يُشارَك أبداً. التزم بما ورد في دليل رانيا.

lessons.title: Mission: Help Someone Complete an Online Task
lessons.titleAr: المهمة: ساعد شخصاً على إكمال مهمة عبر الإنترنت
lessons.scenario: Help a classmate join an online session, share a document and resolve one connection problem without requesting private credentials.

activities.prompt: Read the note the tutor pinned to the class page. What must nobody ever be asked for?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الملاحظة التي ثبّتها المعلّم على صفحة الصف. ما الشيء الذي يجب ألا يُطلب من أحد أبداً؟
options: A classmate's password
The number of the room
The name on the college account
activities.answer: A classmate's password
activities.sourceText: Wednesday's session, please read this before you join. Open the invitation link, sign in with your own college account and wait in room 18. The worksheet is in the shared folder; download it before five o'clock. If you help a classmate, never ask for their password.

activities.prompt: Listen to Nour's message. What exactly stops working?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة نور. ما الذي يتوقف بالضبط؟
options: Her picture, while the sound carries on
The sound, while the picture carries on
The invitation link, before the meeting opens
activities.answer: Her picture, while the sound carries on
activities.audioTranscript: Hello, it is Nour. I am sorry to ask, but I cannot stay in Wednesday's session and the worksheet is due on Friday. When I tap the invitation link the meeting opens, I can see everybody, and then after about ten seconds my picture freezes. The sound carries on, so they can still hear me talking. I have tried that already on my sister's phone and it does exactly the same, so I do not think the phone is the problem. There is a small message at the top that says 'weak connection'. Ring me tonight if you can.

activities.prompt: Nour rings you back. Talk her into the session step by step, ask the questions you need in order to find the cause, and get the worksheet to her — without taking anything private from her.
activities.promptAr: تعاود نور الاتصال بكَ. أدخلها إلى الجلسة خطوة خطوة، واسأل الأسئلة التي تحتاجها لمعرفة السبب، وأوصل إليها ورقة العمل من دون أن تأخذ منها أي شيء خاص.
partnerTurns: Thanks for ringing me back. I am looking at the class page now. Where do I even start?
All right, I am in room 18 and I can see everyone. Oh — it has frozen again. Shall I just tell you my password and you do it from your side?
Fine, no password. So what do I do about the picture, and where is this worksheet?

activities.prompt: Now say the whole procedure aloud, so that Nour can follow it on her own next week: the steps in order, and one 'if' sentence for the moment the picture freezes. Add nothing she has not already agreed to.
activities.promptAr: قل الآن الإجراء كاملاً بصوت عالٍ لتتمكن نور من اتباعه وحدها الأسبوع المقبل: الخطوات مرتبة، وجملة واحدة بـ if للحظة تجمّد الصورة. ولا تضف شيئاً لم توافق عليه.

activities.prompt: Nour's mother wants to know what the class page says, and she does not read English. Tell her where and when the session is, what Nour has to do before Friday, and the one rule about passwords.
activities.promptAr: تريد والدة نور أن تعرف ما في صفحة الصف، وهي لا تقرأ الإنجليزية. أخبرها بموعد الجلسة ومكانها، وبما على نور فعله قبل الجمعة، وبالقاعدة الوحيدة الخاصة بكلمات المرور.
activities.sourceCard: Wednesday at six in the evening, room 18. Bring nothing with you; everything is on the class page. Download the worksheet before five o'clock on Friday, because the folder closes at five. Tutors and classmates will never ask you for a password, and you should never give one.

activities.prompt: Write Nour the guide she can keep. Cover how to get in, where the worksheet is and when the folder closes, what to do if the picture freezes, and the rule about passwords. Use 'it', 'them' and 'that' so that she knows what each step points to.
activities.promptAr: اكتب لنور الدليل الذي تحتفظ به. غطِّ كيفية الدخول، وأين ورقة العمل ومتى يُغلق المجلد، وماذا تفعل إذا تجمّدت الصورة، وقاعدة كلمات المرور. استخدم it وthem وthat لتعرف إلامَ تشير كل خطوة.

dialogue.speaker: Munir
dialogue.en: You look tired this morning, Rana. Were you working late?
dialogue.ar: تبدين متعبة هذا الصباح يا رنا. هل كنتِ تعملين حتى وقت متأخر؟

dialogue.speaker: Rana
dialogue.en: No. I was sitting in a café in Karrada until midnight, listening to a storyteller.
dialogue.ar: لا. كنتُ جالسة في مقهى في الكرادة حتى منتصف الليل أستمع إلى حكواتي.

dialogue.speaker: Munir
dialogue.en: A storyteller? In a café?
dialogue.ar: حكواتي؟ في مقهى؟

dialogue.speaker: Rana
dialogue.en: Every Thursday. At the beginning he described the scene: a family was living above a bakery, and the youngest son was working at the port.
dialogue.ar: كل خميس. في البداية وصف المشهد: كانت عائلة تسكن فوق مخبز، وكان الابن الأصغر يعمل في الميناء.

dialogue.speaker: Munir
dialogue.en: And the crowd? Was anybody listening, or were they all on their phones?
dialogue.ar: وماذا عن الحشد؟ هل كان أحد يصغي، أم كانوا جميعاً منشغلين بهواتفهم؟

dialogue.speaker: Rana
dialogue.en: Nobody moved. Even the waiters were standing at the back, holding empty trays.
dialogue.ar: لم يتحرك أحد. حتى النُّدُل كانوا واقفين في الخلف ممسكين بصوانٍ فارغة.

activities.prompt: What are Munir and Rana talking about?
activities.promptAr: عمَّ يتحدث منير ورنا؟
options: A night Rana spent listening to a storyteller
A late shift at Rana's office
A bakery that opened near the port
activities.answer: A night Rana spent listening to a storyteller
activities.audioTranscript: You look tired this morning, Rana. Were you working late? No. I was sitting in a café in Karrada until midnight, listening to a storyteller. A storyteller? In a café? Every Thursday. At the beginning he described the scene: a family was living above a bakery, and the youngest son was working at the port. And the crowd? Was anybody listening, or were they all on their phones? Nobody moved. Even the waiters were standing at the back, holding empty trays.

activities.prompt: Build the sentence. In the past continuous, was or were comes before the -ing verb.
activities.promptAr: كوّن الجملة. في الماضي المستمر تأتي was أو were قبل الفعل المنتهي بـ -ing.

activities.prompt: Read the café's notice. What is different this month?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ إعلان المقهى. ما الذي يختلف هذا الشهر؟
activities.sourceText: Notice at Café Al Rasheed: Our storyteller was performing here every Thursday for eleven years. He is ill this month, so his daughter will take his chair. The plot changes every week, but the main character never does.
options: His daughter will tell the stories
The stories will stop for a month
The café will close on Thursdays
activities.answer: His daughter will tell the stories

activities.prompt: Listen to the opening of a radio story. What made the children sit up?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى بداية قصة إذاعية. ما الذي جعل الأطفال يعتدلون في جلستهم؟
options: The grandmother stopped in the middle of a sentence
Jasim shouted to them from his roof
The story finally reached its last night
activities.answer: The grandmother stopped in the middle of a sentence
activities.audioTranscript: Here is the first scene of tonight's story. It was the summer of nineteen seventy, and the whole street was sleeping on the roofs. A boy called Jasim was lying under a blanket, counting the stars, while his grandmother was telling the same story she told every night. At the beginning nobody was listening. Then she stopped in the middle of a sentence, and suddenly every child on every roof was sitting up. That silence is where our plot really starts.

activities.prompt: Set the scene of a story you know. Say where it was happening, and what two different people were doing before anything went wrong.
activities.promptAr: هيّئ مشهد البداية لقصة تعرفها. قل أين كان الحدث يجري، وماذا كان شخصان مختلفان يفعلان قبل أن يسوء أي شيء.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.en: You were at Lamia's wedding on Friday. Is it true about the lights?
dialogue.ar: كنتِ في عرس لمياء يوم الجمعة. هل ما يُقال عن الأضواء صحيح؟

dialogue.speaker: Suha
dialogue.en: Every word. The singer was starting the second song when the whole hall went dark.
dialogue.ar: كل كلمة منه. كان المغني يبدأ الأغنية الثانية عندما أظلمت القاعة كلها.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.en: What did people do?
dialogue.ar: ماذا فعل الناس؟

dialogue.speaker: Suha
dialogue.en: Nothing, for ten seconds. Then a cousin opened his phone light, and four hundred phones appeared at the same moment.
dialogue.ar: لا شيء، لعشر ثوانٍ. ثم أضاء أحد أبناء العم مصباح هاتفه، فظهرت أربعمئة هاتف في اللحظة نفسها.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.en: So the party stopped?
dialogue.ar: إذن توقف الحفل؟

dialogue.speaker: Suha
dialogue.en: It got better! The band was playing without microphones when the bride discovered she could hear her own guests singing. Nobody wanted the electricity back.
dialogue.ar: بل صار أجمل! كانت الفرقة تعزف بلا مكبرات صوت عندما اكتشفت العروس أنها تسمع ضيوفها يغنّون. لم يعد أحد يريد عودة الكهرباء.

activities.prompt: What are Karim and Suha talking about?
activities.promptAr: عمَّ يتحدث كريم وسهى؟
options: A power cut in the middle of a wedding party
A singer who lost his voice on stage
A wedding that finished much too early
activities.answer: A power cut in the middle of a wedding party
activities.audioTranscript: You were at Lamia's wedding on Friday. Is it true about the lights? Every word. The singer was starting the second song when the whole hall went dark. What did people do? Nothing, for ten seconds. Then a cousin opened his phone light, and four hundred phones appeared at the same moment. So the party stopped? It got better! The band was playing without microphones when the bride discovered she could hear her own guests singing. Nobody wanted the electricity back.

activities.prompt: The long action takes the past continuous; the short one that cuts it takes the past simple. Choose the second verb.
activities.promptAr: الحدث الطويل يأخذ الماضي المستمر، والحدث القصير الذي يقطعه يأخذ الماضي البسيط. اختر الفعل الثاني.
activities.text: The cook was carrying the cake when a waiter ___ the door.
options: opened
was opening
opens
activities.answer: opened

activities.prompt: Read the manager's message. What caused the power cut?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ رسالة مدير القاعة. ما سبب انقطاع الكهرباء؟
activities.sourceText: Message from the hall manager: We are sorry. A driver hit a cable outside while your guests were eating, and the lights disappeared for eleven minutes. Nothing was damaged, and we did not interrupt the music for long.
options: A driver hit a cable outside the hall
The hall was using too much electricity
The band's equipment failed during a song
activities.answer: A driver hit a cable outside the hall

activities.prompt: Listen to a man telling a story about his car. What did the bus driver do?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رجل يحكي قصة عن سيارته. ماذا فعل سائق الحافلة؟
options: He took the girl to her exam
He repaired the car on the bridge
He called a mechanic for the family
activities.answer: He took the girl to her exam
activities.audioTranscript: Two summers ago I was driving my daughter to her exam when the car stopped on the bridge. I was looking for a mechanic's number when a bus stopped behind us. The driver did not ask anything. He opened his door, my daughter climbed in, and he took her to the school gate. I was still standing beside the car when she called me. She was laughing. The whole bus waited for her, nobody complained, and she discovered later that she finished first in her class.

activities.prompt: Your neighbour is describing the day her plans were interrupted. Tell her about a time something interrupted you, and ask her two questions about her day.
activities.promptAr: جارتكَ تصف اليوم الذي تعطلت فيه خططها. أخبرها عن مرة قاطع فيها شيءٌ ما يومك، واسألها سؤالين عن يومها.
partnerTurns: I will never forget last Eid. I was cooking for fifteen people when the water stopped.
I was carrying pots to my sister's kitchen when it started to rain, and I lost half the rice on the stairs.
We ate at ten at night in the end. Now tell me about your day, and ask me whatever you like.

dialogue.speaker: Nabil
dialogue.en: I opened the hall at six. What was happening in here while I was outside?
dialogue.ar: فتحتُ القاعة في السادسة. ماذا كان يحدث هنا بينما كنتُ في الخارج؟

dialogue.speaker: Widad
dialogue.en: Everything at once. While the little ones were practising on the stage, the mothers were arranging chairs at the back.
dialogue.ar: كل شيء في وقت واحد. بينما كان الصغار يتدربون على المسرح، كانت الأمهات ينظّمن الكراسي في الخلف.

dialogue.speaker: Salma
dialogue.en: And I was looking for my shoes for twenty minutes!
dialogue.ar: وأنا كنتُ أبحث عن حذائي عشرين دقيقة!

dialogue.speaker: Widad
dialogue.en: While Salma was crying in the corridor, her brother was quietly putting the shoes in her bag.
dialogue.ar: بينما كانت سلمى تبكي في الممر، كان أخوها يضع الحذاء في حقيبتها بهدوء.

dialogue.speaker: Nabil
dialogue.en: So the audience arrived, and nothing was ready.
dialogue.ar: إذن وصل الجمهور ولم يكن شيء جاهزاً.

dialogue.speaker: Salma
dialogue.en: It was ready. While the crowd was still coming in, we were already standing behind the curtain, counting.
dialogue.ar: بل كان جاهزاً. بينما كان الحشد ما يزال يدخل، كنا نقف خلف الستارة ونعدّ.

activities.prompt: What are the three of them describing?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي يصفه الثلاثة؟
options: The hour before a school concert
A concert that had to be cancelled
A bag that was lost at the school
activities.answer: The hour before a school concert
activities.audioTranscript: I opened the hall at six. What was happening in here while I was outside? Everything at once. While the little ones were practising on the stage, the mothers were arranging chairs at the back. And I was looking for my shoes for twenty minutes! While Salma was crying in the corridor, her brother was quietly putting the shoes in her bag. So the audience arrived, and nothing was ready. It was ready. While the crowd was still coming in, we were already standing behind the curtain, counting.

activities.prompt: Build the sentence so that while introduces the longer action.
activities.promptAr: كوّن الجملة بحيث تقدّم while الحدثَ الأطول.

activities.prompt: Read the school newsletter. Where was class five during class four's turn?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ نشرة المدرسة. أين كان الصف الخامس أثناء دور الصف الرابع؟
activities.sourceText: From the school newsletter: Our concert worked because three groups were working at the same time. While class four was performing, class five was waiting in the library, and six parents were selling tea in the yard. Nobody was standing in the wrong place.
options: In the library
In the yard with the parents
Behind the curtain with class four
activities.answer: In the library

activities.prompt: Listen to a woman describing a street festival. What was happening while the drummers were moving down the road?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى امرأة تصف مهرجاناً في الشارع. ماذا كان يحدث بينما كان الطبّالون يسيرون في الطريق؟
options: Women were laying cloths and boys were carrying chairs
The square was still completely empty
The food was being cooked in the houses
activities.answer: Women were laying cloths and boys were carrying chairs
activities.audioTranscript: Our street festival looks like chaos, but every year it works. While the drummers were moving down the main road, the older women were laying cloths in the square and the boys were carrying chairs from the mosque. I was filming from a balcony. At seven the drummers reached the square, and everything was finished at exactly the same minute: the food was hot, the chairs were straight, and nine hundred people were already sitting down. We were not lucky. We were counting.

activities.prompt: Describe a busy scene you remember - a market, a wedding, a match. Say what three different people or groups were doing at the same time, and what you were doing.
activities.promptAr: صف مشهداً مزدحماً تتذكره: سوقاً أو عرساً أو مباراة. قل ماذا كان ثلاثة أشخاص أو ثلاث مجموعات يفعلون في الوقت نفسه، وماذا كنتَ تفعل أنت.

dialogue.speaker: Zaid
dialogue.en: My sister keeps sending me one series. Is it the one which is about a bus driver?
dialogue.ar: أختي تبعث لي مسلسلاً واحداً باستمرار. هل هو ذاك الذي يدور حول سائق حافلة؟

dialogue.speaker: Hala
dialogue.en: No, that's the comedy. She means the documentary that follows four families in Basra for a year.
dialogue.ar: لا، تلك هي الكوميديا. هي تقصد الفيلم الوثائقي الذي يتابع أربع عائلات في البصرة مدة سنة.

dialogue.speaker: Zaid
dialogue.en: A documentary? My Arabic is fine, but my English is slow.
dialogue.ar: فيلم وثائقي؟ عربيتي جيدة، لكن إنجليزيتي بطيئة.

dialogue.speaker: Hala
dialogue.en: It has subtitles. And the actor who narrates it speaks very clearly.
dialogue.ar: فيه ترجمة مكتوبة. والممثل الذي يروي أحداثه يتحدث بوضوح شديد.

dialogue.speaker: Zaid
dialogue.en: How many episodes?
dialogue.ar: كم حلقة فيه؟

dialogue.speaker: Hala
dialogue.en: Six. Each one ends with a question which the next episode answers. The ending is the best part, and I won't say more.
dialogue.ar: ست حلقات. كل حلقة تنتهي بسؤال تجيب عنه الحلقة التالية. النهاية هي أفضل جزء، ولن أقول أكثر.

activities.prompt: What are Hala and Zaid working out?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي يحاول هالة وزيد تحديده؟
options: Which programme Zaid's sister means
Where Hala's sister lives now
How to turn the subtitles off
activities.answer: Which programme Zaid's sister means
activities.audioTranscript: My sister keeps sending me one series. Is it the one which is about a bus driver? No, that's the comedy. She means the documentary that follows four families in Basra for a year. A documentary? My Arabic is fine, but my English is slow. It has subtitles. And the actor who narrates it speaks very clearly. How many episodes? Six. Each one ends with a question which the next episode answers. The ending is the best part, and I won't say more.

activities.prompt: Use who for people and which for things. Choose the word that fits a person.
activities.promptAr: استخدم who للأشخاص وwhich للأشياء. اختر الكلمة التي تناسب شخصاً.
activities.text: The main character is a teacher ___ writes letters for her neighbours.
options: who
which
where
activities.answer: who

activities.prompt: Listen to the evening announcement. What is The Long Road?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى إعلان برامج المساء. ما هو عمل «الطريق الطويل»؟
options: A comedy taken from a novel
A documentary about bakers
A programme about old bridges
activities.answer: A comedy taken from a novel
activities.audioTranscript: Good evening. Tonight at nine we have The Long Road, a comedy about two brothers who open a bakery in a town that has four bakeries already. It is the novel which every student read at school, and the actor who plays the older brother has not acted for eleven years. After that, at ten, a documentary that follows the men who repair the old bridges of Mosul. Both programmes have Arabic subtitles. The last episode of The Long Road is next Thursday.

activities.prompt: Read the back cover. Who is the book for?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الغلاف الخلفي. لمن هذا الكتاب؟
activities.sourceText: Back cover of The Salt House: This is a novel which is based on a true story. The main character is a fisherman who loses his boat and walks home along the coast for nine days. Readers who like quiet books will finish it in one evening.
options: Readers who enjoy quiet books
Readers who want a long series
Readers who dislike true stories
activities.answer: Readers who enjoy quiet books

activities.prompt: A friend asks you to describe a film, series or book without naming it. Write your description: what kind it is, who the main character is, and what happens. Use who, which or that at least twice.
activities.promptAr: يطلب منكَ صديق أن تصف فيلماً أو مسلسلاً أو كتاباً من دون تسميته. اكتب وصفك: ما نوعه، ومن الشخصية الرئيسية، وماذا يحدث. استخدم who أو which أو that مرتين على الأقل.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.en: Have you seen The Salt House? Everybody at work is talking about it.
dialogue.ar: هل شاهدتِ «بيت الملح»؟ الجميع في العمل يتحدث عنه.

dialogue.speaker: Ruqayya
dialogue.en: I have seen it twice. Although the first hour is slow, I would watch it again tomorrow.
dialogue.ar: شاهدته مرتين. مع أن الساعة الأولى بطيئة، فإني مستعدة لمشاهدته غداً مرة أخرى.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.en: Twice? My brother said it was confusing.
dialogue.ar: مرتين؟ قال أخي إنه مربك.

dialogue.speaker: Ruqayya
dialogue.en: It is confusing at the start, because nobody explains who the old woman is. Then it becomes very moving.
dialogue.ar: هو مربك في البداية لأن لا أحد يوضّح من تكون المرأة العجوز. ثم يصبح مؤثراً جداً.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.en: Is it entertaining, though? I have never enjoyed sad films.
dialogue.ar: لكن هل هو مسلٍّ؟ أنا لم أستمتع يوماً بالأفلام الحزينة.

dialogue.speaker: Ruqayya
dialogue.en: The best part was the ending, and it is not sad. But don't let anyone spoil it for you, because that ruins the whole thing.
dialogue.ar: أفضل جزء كان النهاية، وهي ليست حزينة. لكن لا تدع أحداً يفسدها عليك، فذلك يخرّب كل شيء.

activities.prompt: What are Omar and Ruqayya discussing?
activities.promptAr: عمَّ يتحدث عمر ورقية؟
options: Whether Omar should watch a film
A film they both disliked
A book Ruqayya is writing
activities.answer: Whether Omar should watch a film
activities.audioTranscript: Have you seen The Salt House? Everybody at work is talking about it. I have seen it twice. Although the first hour is slow, I would watch it again tomorrow. Twice? My brother said it was confusing. It is confusing at the start, because nobody explains who the old woman is. Then it becomes very moving. Is it entertaining, though? I have never enjoyed sad films. The best part was the ending, and it is not sad. But don't let anyone spoil it for you, because that ruins the whole thing.

activities.prompt: Although joins two facts that do not fit together. Choose the word that fits.
activities.promptAr: تربط although حقيقتين لا تتفقان معاً. اختر الكلمة المناسبة.
activities.text: ___ the story was predictable, the acting kept me in my chair.
options: Although
Because
So
activities.answer: Although

activities.prompt: Read the comment under the trailer. What does the writer think in the end?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ التعليق تحت المقطع الدعائي. ما رأي الكاتبة في النهاية؟
activities.sourceText: Comment under the trailer: I watched this with my mother, who never finishes a film. In my opinion the middle is too long, and the second half is predictable. Although I complained for two hours, I am still thinking about it a week later.
options: The film stayed with her although she criticised it
She regrets the two hours she spent on it
Her mother enjoyed it far more than she did
activities.answer: The film stayed with her although she criticised it

activities.prompt: Listen to a review of a theatre season. What is the speaker's problem with the first play?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى مراجعة لموسم مسرحي. ما مشكلة المتحدثة مع المسرحية الأولى؟
options: She guessed the ending very early
It was far too short for the ticket
She could not hear the actors at all
activities.answer: She guessed the ending very early
activities.audioTranscript: I will give you my honest opinion of the new theatre season. What I liked was the second play, about a family who lose their shop. Although it was only forty minutes, three people near me were crying at the end. The first play was entertaining but completely predictable, and I knew the ending after five minutes. In my opinion the season is worth the ticket, and the best part was that nobody tried to explain anything to the audience.

activities.prompt: A colleague wants to know whether a film is worth her evening. Give a balanced opinion: one thing you liked, one limitation with although, and a clear recommendation.
activities.promptAr: تريد زميلة أن تعرف إن كان الفيلم يستحق أمسيتها. قدّم رأياً متوازناً: شيئاً أعجبك، وقيداً واحداً باستخدام although، وتوصية واضحة.
partnerTurns: Have you seen the one everybody is talking about? I have three free hours tonight.
