My sister says the first hour is slow. Is that true, or was she asleep?
So should I watch it tonight, or should I choose something else? Tell me honestly.

readingText.title: The Night Bus - a review
readingText.text: The Night Bus is a six-episode comedy that follows a driver called Munther on the last bus out of Baghdad every night. I watched all six episodes in two evenings, which is not something I usually do. The plot is small and that is its strength. Nothing large happens: a woman loses a ring, two students argue about football, an old man falls asleep and misses his stop. The actor who plays Munther says very little, and the best part was watching his face while other people talked. Although the fourth episode is weak, because the writers try too hard to be funny, the ending of the series is genuinely moving. The English is clear and the Arabic subtitles are good. I recommend it to anyone who enjoys quiet stories, and to learners who want listening practice. It is worth watching twice. Four out of five.
readingText.textAr: «حافلة الليل» مسلسل كوميدي من ست حلقات يتابع سائقاً اسمه منذر في آخر حافلة تخرج من بغداد كل ليلة. شاهدتُ الحلقات الست في مساءين، وهذا ليس ما أفعله عادةً. الحبكة صغيرة، وهنا تكمن قوتها. لا يحدث شيء كبير: امرأة تفقد خاتمها، وطالبان يتجادلان حول كرة القدم، ورجل مسنّ ينام فيفوته موقفه. الممثل الذي يؤدي دور منذر يقول القليل جداً، وأفضل جزء كان مراقبة وجهه بينما يتحدث الآخرون. ومع أن الحلقة الرابعة ضعيفة لأن الكتّاب يبالغون في محاولة الإضحاك، فإن نهاية المسلسل مؤثرة حقاً. الإنجليزية فيه واضحة، والترجمة العربية المكتوبة جيدة. أوصي به لكل من يحب القصص الهادئة، وللمتعلمين الذين يريدون تدريباً على الاستماع. إنه يستحق المشاهدة مرتين. أربعة من خمسة.

activities.prompt: Read the review once. What is the writer's overall message?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ المراجعة مرة واحدة. ما الرسالة العامة التي يقدمها الكاتب؟
options: Watch it, because the small story is its strength
Skip it unless you like loud comedies
Wait for the second series before you start
activities.answer: Watch it, because the small story is its strength

activities.prompt: Listen to the voice message. Why does the speaker advise using subtitles?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى الرسالة الصوتية. لماذا ينصح المتحدث باستخدام الترجمة المكتوبة؟
options: The driver speaks very quietly
The Arabic is better than the English
The first minutes have no sound
activities.answer: The driver speaks very quietly
activities.audioTranscript: You asked me for a recommendation, so here is my short review. Do not start The Night Bus if you only have one free evening, because you will not stop at one episode. My rating is four out of five, and I took one star away for the fourth episode. Two warnings. First, do not read the comments online, because somebody always spoils the ending. Second, watch it with the subtitles on, even if your English is good, because the driver speaks very quietly and half the jokes are in what he does not say.

activities.prompt: Before you write anything, say your own review aloud the way the model says it: what it is, one strength, one limitation with although, and who it is for.
activities.promptAr: قبل أن تكتب شيئاً، قل مراجعتكَ بصوت عالٍ كما يقولها النموذج: ما هو العمل، ونقطة قوة، وقيد واحد باستخدام although، ولمن هو.

activities.prompt: Your aunt does not read English and is choosing a film for her grandchildren. Tell her what it is about, what the warning says, and which showing she should book.
activities.promptAr: عمتكَ لا تقرأ الإنجليزية، وهي تختار فيلماً لأحفادها. أخبرها بموضوعه، وبما يقوله التنبيه، وبأي عرض ينبغي أن تحجز.
activities.sourceCard: Cinema listing: Paper Boats. A ninety-minute film about a girl who builds a radio. Warning: one long scene shows a storm at sea and may frighten young children. Rating: suitable from ten years. Arabic subtitles at the three o'clock showing only.

activities.prompt: Now write your own review of a film, series or book. Say what kind it is and who is in it, give one strength and one limitation with although, say who it is for, and finish with a rating.
activities.promptAr: اكتب الآن مراجعتكَ لفيلم أو مسلسل أو كتاب. قل ما نوعه ومن فيه، واذكر نقطة قوة وقيداً باستخدام although، وقل لمن هو، واختم بتقييم.

lessons.title: Mission: A Short Review and Recommendation
lessons.scenario: Understand an unseen story and audience comments, discuss it, then create a spoiler-light review for a particular audience.

activities.prompt: Read the festival programme. What surprises the writer about the film?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ برنامج المهرجان. ما الذي يثير دهشة الكاتب في الفيلم؟
activities.sourceText: From the festival programme: The Ninth Floor. A woman who repairs lifts is trapped in her own building during a storm. Although almost the whole film happens in one small space, it never feels slow. Ninety-four minutes. No interval.
options: It never feels slow although it stays in one place
It is much longer than the other festival films
It was filmed during a real storm in the city
activities.answer: It never feels slow although it stays in one place

activities.prompt: Listen to three people leaving the cinema. What does the third speaker advise?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى ثلاثة أشخاص يغادرون السينما. بماذا ينصح المتحدث الثالث؟
options: Bring your mother rather than your children
Wait until it comes to television
Read the book before you watch it
activities.answer: Bring your mother rather than your children
activities.audioTranscript: Three people left the cinema, and this is what they said. The first: I was checking my phone in the first ten minutes, and then I did not move for an hour. The second: I liked it, although the ending was too quick for me, and I wanted one more scene. The third, a woman of about seventy: My husband repaired lifts for thirty years, and while I was watching I was hearing his voice. I have never cried at a film before. Take your mother, not your children.

activities.prompt: Discuss the film with a friend who has also seen it. Say what worked and what did not, and agree together who should watch it.
activities.promptAr: ناقش الفيلم مع صديق شاهده أيضاً. قل ما الذي نجح وما الذي لم ينجح، واتفقا معاً على من ينبغي أن يشاهده.
partnerTurns: I have seen it twice now. For me the strongest part was the hour with almost no words at all.
My cousin was bored, although she watches everything. Do you think it is only for older people?
So who do we tell to watch it, and who do we warn? Give me one sentence I can send.

activities.prompt: Give your own short spoken review of the film. Describe it with who, which or that, give a balanced opinion with although, and recommend it without revealing the ending.
activities.promptAr: قدّم مراجعتكَ المنطوقة القصيرة للفيلم. صفه مستخدماً who أو which أو that، وقدّم رأياً متوازناً باستخدام although، وأوصِ به من دون كشف النهاية.

activities.prompt: Your uncle does not read English and is choosing a film for Friday. Relay what the board says about the film, what the audience wrote, and which showing suits him.
activities.promptAr: عمّكَ لا يقرأ الإنجليزية وهو يختار فيلماً ليوم الجمعة. انقل له ما تقوله اللوحة عن الفيلم، وما كتبه الجمهور، وأي عرض يناسبه.
activities.sourceCard: Festival board, The Ninth Floor: Best First Film. Audience score four out of five. Comments on the board read moving, slow at the start and not for small children. Two showings left: Friday at four with Arabic subtitles, Saturday at nine without.

activities.prompt: Write the review your friends will read before they book. Summarise the story without the ending, give a balanced opinion, name the audience it suits, and add your rating.
activities.promptAr: اكتب المراجعة التي سيقرؤها أصدقاؤك قبل الحجز. لخّص القصة من دون النهاية، وقدّم رأياً متوازناً، وحدّد الجمهور الذي يناسبه، وأضف تقييمك.

dialogue.speaker: Kamal
dialogue.en: The lift isn't working, Nadia. Did something happen last night?
dialogue.ar: المصعد لا يعمل يا نادية. هل حدث شيء الليلة الماضية؟

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.en: A branch fell on the line in the storm, so half the street had a power cut.
dialogue.ar: سقط غصن على خط الكهرباء أثناء العاصفة، فانقطع التيار عن نصف الشارع.

dialogue.speaker: Kamal
dialogue.en: That explains the dark stairs. Is the water off as well because of the storm?
dialogue.ar: هذا يفسّر عتمة الدرج. وهل الماء مقطوع أيضاً بسبب العاصفة؟

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.en: No, the water is fine. The lift is off because the engineer hasn't come yet.
dialogue.ar: لا، الماء بخير. المصعد متوقف لأن الفنّي لم يأتِ بعد.

dialogue.speaker: Kamal
dialogue.en: So we carry everything up four floors today.
dialogue.ar: إذن سنحمل كل شيء إلى الطابق الرابع اليوم.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.en: For today only. The council will repair the line this afternoon, so the lift should start again tonight.
dialogue.ar: اليوم فقط. ستصلح البلدية الخط بعد الظهر، فيُفترض أن يعود المصعد للعمل الليلة.

activities.prompt: Kamal and Nadia meet on the stairs. What are the two of them working out?
activities.promptAr: يلتقي كمال ونادية على الدرج. ما الذي يحاولان معرفته؟
options: Why the lift is off, and when it will work again
Whether the storm will come back tonight
Who should pay for the fallen branch
activities.answer: Why the lift is off, and when it will work again
activities.audioTranscript: The lift isn't working, Nadia. Did something happen last night? A branch fell on the line in the storm, so half the street had a power cut. That explains the dark stairs. Is the water off as well because of the storm? No, the water is fine. The lift is off because the engineer hasn't come yet. So we carry everything up four floors today. For today only. The council will repair the line this afternoon, so the lift should start again tonight.

activities.prompt: One half of this sentence is the reason and the other is the result. Choose the word that fits.
activities.promptAr: شطر من هذه الجملة هو السبب والآخر هو النتيجة. اختر الكلمة المناسبة.
activities.text: The stairs were completely dark last night ___ the power was off.
options: because
so
but
activities.answer: because

activities.prompt: Each cause had one result. Match them.
activities.promptAr: لكل سبب نتيجة واحدة. طابق بينهما.
pairs: A branch fell on the power line,
so the whole street lost its electricity.
The engineer has not arrived yet,
so the lift is still out of use.
The pavement is wet this morning,
because it rained hard all night.

activities.prompt: Listen to the caretaker's message. Why can the box at the gate not be repaired yet?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة الحارس. لماذا لا يمكن إصلاح الصندوق عند البوابة بعد؟
options: Rain got into it, and the council cannot come before Thursday
The engineer says the line itself is not safe
The residents have to pay for it before any work starts
activities.answer: Rain got into it, and the council cannot come before Thursday
activities.audioTranscript: Hello, this is Samir, the caretaker at Block C. I'm leaving the same message for every flat. We still have no power on floors three and four, because a second branch came down in the storm. The council says the line itself is safe, but the box at the gate has water damage because of the rain, so they cannot repair it before Thursday. Please don't use the lift, even if it starts. And if you see water near the stairs, ring me first, not the office — the office is closed until Monday.

activities.prompt: Something in your street stopped working after bad weather. Say what happened, what caused it, and two results the people there are living with today.
activities.promptAr: توقّف شيء في شارعكَ عن العمل بعد طقس سيئ. قل ماذا حدث وما سببه، ونتيجتين يعيشهما الناس هناك اليوم.

dialogue.speaker: Fouad
dialogue.en: The drain at the corner is blocked again, Rania. Someone pushed a bag of rubbish into it.
dialogue.ar: البالوعة عند الزاوية مسدودة من جديد يا رانية. دفع أحدهم كيس نفايات داخلها.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.en: If nobody clears it before Thursday, the water will come into the basement.
dialogue.ar: إذا لم ينظّفها أحد قبل الخميس فسيدخل الماء إلى القبو.

dialogue.speaker: Fouad
dialogue.en: It already did last winter. There is still a leak in the ceiling down there.
dialogue.ar: وقد دخل فعلاً الشتاء الماضي. ما زال هناك تسرّب في سقف القبو.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.en: I know. If the river rises as well, the whole car park will flood.
dialogue.ar: أعرف. وإذا ارتفع النهر أيضاً فسيغرق موقف السيارات كله.

dialogue.speaker: Fouad
dialogue.en: Then let's not wait. I'll send photos to the council tonight.
dialogue.ar: إذن لا ننتظر. سأرسل صوراً إلى البلدية الليلة.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.en: Good. If we send photos, they will come faster than if we only telephone.
dialogue.ar: جيد. إذا أرسلنا صوراً فسيأتون أسرع مما لو اكتفينا بالاتصال.

activities.prompt: Fouad and Rania are standing over a blocked drain. What do they decide to do about it?
activities.promptAr: يقف فؤاد ورانية عند بالوعة مسدودة. ماذا يقرران أن يفعلا؟
options: Send photographs to the council tonight
Clear the drain themselves before Thursday
Move their cars out of the lower car park
activities.answer: Send photographs to the council tonight
activities.audioTranscript: The drain at the corner is blocked again, Rania. Someone pushed a bag of rubbish into it. If nobody clears it before Thursday, the water will come into the basement. It already did last winter. There is still a leak in the ceiling down there. I know. If the river rises as well, the whole car park will flood. Then let's not wait. I'll send photos to the council tonight. Good. If we send photos, they will come faster than if we only telephone.

activities.prompt: This is a real possibility for next week, not an imaginary one. Choose the form that fits.
activities.promptAr: هذا احتمال حقيقي للأسبوع القادم لا أمر متخيَّل. اختر الصيغة المناسبة.
activities.text: If the rain continues all night, the basement ___ flood again.
options: will
would
is
activities.answer: will

activities.prompt: Read the notice on the building door. What happens to a car that is still in the lower car park on Friday?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الإعلان على باب البناية. ماذا يحدث لسيارة تبقى في الموقف السفلي يوم الجمعة؟
options: The ground under it stays dirty until the next visit
The crew moves it out to the street
The council charges the owner for the visit
activities.answer: The ground under it stays dirty until the next visit
activities.sourceText: Notice to residents: the council will clean the drains on Friday morning. If you leave a car in the lower car park after eight, the crew will not clean underneath it, and the water will stand there until the next visit.

activities.prompt: Listen to the water company's recorded line. When should a caller press one?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى خط شركة المياه المسجَّل. متى ينبغي للمتصل أن يضغط رقم واحد؟
options: When the water is above the pavement, or inside a building
Whenever there is any water at all in the street
When the basement has a leak and no standing water
activities.answer: When the water is above the pavement, or inside a building
activities.audioTranscript: This is the water company's recorded line. Because of the heavy rain we have more calls than usual, so please listen before you speak. If the water in your street is below the pavement, do not report it tonight; the drains will clear by themselves. If the water is above the pavement, or if it is inside a building, press one now and a team will come within four hours. If your basement has a leak but no standing water, press two and we will call you back tomorrow.

activities.prompt: Your neighbour would rather wait and see. Tell her what will happen if nobody reports the drain, and agree between you who does what before Thursday.
activities.promptAr: تفضّل جارتكَ أن تنتظر وترى. أخبرها بما سيحدث إذا لم يبلّغ أحد عن البالوعة، واتفقا على من يفعل ماذا قبل الخميس.
partnerTurns: It always looks bad after rain, and it always goes away by itself. Do we really need to ring anyone?
All right, say it does happen. What actually goes wrong if we leave it another week?
Fine. Tell me exactly what you will do, and what you want me to do.

dialogue.speaker: Marwan
dialogue.en: Have you seen the warning on the radio? There may be thick fog before seven.
dialogue.ar: هل رأيتِ التحذير في الإذاعة؟ قد يكون هناك ضباب كثيف قبل السابعة.

dialogue.speaker: Suha
dialogue.en: Then the ring road will be slow. It might even close if the fog gets worse.
dialogue.ar: إذن سيكون الطريق الدائري بطيئاً. وقد يُغلق إن اشتدّ الضباب.

dialogue.speaker: Marwan
dialogue.en: It will probably clear by nine, but we can't promise the customer nine.
dialogue.ar: على الأرجح سينقشع بحلول التاسعة، لكننا لا نستطيع أن نعِد الزبون بالتاسعة.

dialogue.speaker: Suha
dialogue.en: No. And the old road is still blocked, so there is no second route this week.
dialogue.ar: لا. والطريق القديم ما زال مسدوداً، فلا يوجد مسار بديل هذا الأسبوع.

dialogue.speaker: Marwan
dialogue.en: Then we won't deliver in the morning. We'll start after lunch.
dialogue.ar: إذن لن نوصل الطلبية صباحاً. سنبدأ بعد الغداء.

dialogue.speaker: Suha
dialogue.en: Agreed. I'll warn the customer now, because a late van with no message is worse than a late van.
dialogue.ar: متفقة. سأحذّر الزبون الآن، لأن شاحنة متأخرة بلا إشعار أسوأ من شاحنة متأخرة.

activities.prompt: Marwan and Suha are planning tomorrow's delivery. What do they change in the end?
activities.promptAr: يخطط مروان وسهى لتوصيل الغد. ما الذي يغيّرانه في النهاية؟
options: The time of the delivery, not the day
The route, from the ring road to the old road
The customer, to one nearer the depot
activities.answer: The time of the delivery, not the day
activities.audioTranscript: Have you seen the warning on the radio? There may be thick fog before seven. Then the ring road will be slow. It might even close if the fog gets worse. It will probably clear by nine, but we can't promise the customer nine. No. And the old road is still blocked, so there is no second route this week. Then we won't deliver in the morning. We'll start after lunch. Agreed. I'll warn the customer now, because a late van with no message is worse than a late van.

activities.prompt: Nothing about this afternoon is settled. Choose the form that keeps it open.
activities.promptAr: لا شيء محسوم بشأن بعد الظهر. اختر الصيغة التي تبقي الأمر مفتوحاً.
activities.text: The radio is not sure about this afternoon. It ___ rain, or it may stay dry.
options: might
will
is going to
activities.answer: might

activities.prompt: Read the depot's board for tomorrow. Which of these is the forecast most sure about?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ لوحة المستودع للغد. أي هذه الأمور أكثر ما تجزم به التوقعات؟
options: Fog early in the morning
Thunder after four
A completely dry afternoon
activities.answer: Fog early in the morning
activities.sourceText: Tomorrow, for all drivers. Fog is likely before seven and will probably lift by nine. Thunder is possible after four, but the afternoon may stay completely dry. Nobody leaves the depot before the seven o’clock call.

activities.prompt: Listen to the depot briefing. What is certain about the bridge on the east road?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى إحاطة المستودع. ما المؤكد بشأن جسر الطريق الشرقي؟
options: Its surface will stay wet until the sun reaches it
It will be closed until ten in the morning
The wind will make it dangerous all day
activities.answer: Its surface will stay wet until the sun reaches it
activities.audioTranscript: Morning, everyone. Two things before you take the keys. The yard is slippery after last night's rain, so walk between the vans, don't run. And the bridge on the east road may be slippery too — the wind is dropping, but the surface will stay wet until the sun reaches it, probably after ten. If you take that bridge before ten, go slowly and warn anyone travelling behind you. Everything else is normal today, and the fog cleared an hour ago.

activities.prompt: A friend asks about tomorrow before a long journey. Say one thing the weather will almost certainly do, two things it may or might do, and what you will change because of them.
activities.promptAr: يسألكَ صديق عن الغد قبل رحلة طويلة. قل أمراً سيفعله الطقس بشبه تأكيد، وأمرين قد يفعلهما، وما ستغيّره بسببهما.

dialogue.speaker: Basel
dialogue.en: Nobody collected the rubbish on our street this week, Hind.
dialogue.ar: لم يرفع أحد النفايات في شارعنا هذا الأسبوع يا هند.

dialogue.speaker: Hind
dialogue.en: Something is blocking the lane as well — a broken fence, I think.
dialogue.ar: وهناك شيء ما يسد الزقاق أيضاً — سياج مكسور على ما أظن.

dialogue.speaker: Basel
dialogue.en: I rang the council twice and knocked at their door. Is anyone there at all?
dialogue.ar: اتصلت بالبلدية مرتين وطرقت بابهم. هل من أحد هناك أصلاً؟

dialogue.speaker: Hind
dialogue.en: Someone told me they only answer before ten now.
dialogue.ar: أخبرني أحدهم أنهم لا يجيبون الآن إلا قبل العاشرة.

dialogue.speaker: Basel
dialogue.en: Then there is nowhere to report it during the day?
dialogue.ar: إذن لا يوجد مكان للإبلاغ خلال النهار؟

dialogue.speaker: Hind
dialogue.en: There is. You can report it on their website, and anything with a photo moves faster.
dialogue.ar: بل يوجد. يمكنكَ الإبلاغ عبر موقعهم، وكل بلاغ معه صورة يُعالَج أسرع.

dialogue.speaker: Basel
dialogue.en: Good. I'll send everything tonight — the bags, the fence, the dates.
dialogue.ar: جيد. سأرسل كل شيء الليلة: الأكياس والسياج والتواريخ.

activities.prompt: Basel and Hind have two problems and no answer from the council. What is their way round it?
activities.promptAr: لدى باسل وهند مشكلتان ولا جواب من البلدية. ما مخرجهما من ذلك؟
options: Reporting both problems on the council's website, with a photo
Ringing the council again before ten in the morning
Moving the broken fence out of the lane themselves
activities.answer: Reporting both problems on the council's website, with a photo
activities.audioTranscript: Nobody collected the rubbish on our street this week, Hind. Something is blocking the lane as well — a broken fence, I think. I rang the council twice and knocked at their door. Is anyone there at all? Someone told me they only answer before ten now. Then there is nowhere to report it during the day? There is. You can report it on their website, and anything with a photo moves faster. Good. I'll send everything tonight — the bags, the fence, the dates.

activities.prompt: The sentence itself is positive, so the pronoun has to carry the negative. Choose it.
activities.promptAr: الجملة نفسها مثبتة، فالضمير هو الذي يحمل النفي. اختره.
activities.text: I knocked at the office for five minutes, but there was ___ inside.
options: nobody
anybody
everywhere
activities.answer: nobody

activities.prompt: Listen to the council's recorded line. Which problem does it send you to the website for?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى خط البلدية المسجَّل. لأي مشكلة يحيلكَ إلى الموقع الإلكتروني؟
options: A damaged fence, gate or light
Rubbish that has not been collected
Something blocking a road where people could be hurt
activities.answer: A damaged fence, gate or light
activities.audioTranscript: Thank you for calling the city council's street team. Nobody can take your call at the moment; the desk is open from eight until ten only. If something is blocking a road or a path, and anyone could be hurt by it, press one and stay on the line. For rubbish that nobody has collected, press two and leave the street name after the tone. For damage to a fence, a gate or a light, use the website instead — there is nothing the desk can do with those until a photograph arrives.

activities.prompt: Read the council's reporting page. What can they not act on without a photograph?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ صفحة الإبلاغ لدى البلدية. ما الذي لا يمكنهم التصرف بشأنه من دون صورة؟
options: Damage
A blocked road where somebody is in danger
The date the problem started
activities.answer: Damage
activities.sourceText: Report a street problem. Tell us the street name, the date and what you can see. Anything you photograph is dealt with faster, and we cannot act on damage without a photograph. If something is blocking a road and anyone is in danger, do not use this form — ring the emergency desk.

activities.prompt: Fill in the reporting form for a problem in your own street. Say where it is, what you can see, how long nothing has happened, and what you have already tried. Use someone, something, anyone and nobody where they fit, and add nothing you have not seen yourself.
activities.promptAr: املأ استمارة الإبلاغ عن مشكلة في شارعكَ. اذكر أين هي، وما الذي تراه، ومنذ متى لم يحدث شيء، وما الذي جرّبته بالفعل. استعمل someone و something و anyone و nobody في مواضعها، ولا تضف شيئاً لم ترَه بنفسكَ.

dialogue.speaker: Samah
dialogue.en: Your neighbour's tree is over our wall again, Ghassan. Two branches nearly hit the car.
dialogue.ar: شجرة جاركَ فوق سورنا من جديد يا غسان. كاد غصنان يصيبان السيارة.

dialogue.speaker: Ghassan
dialogue.en: I know. Why don't we talk to him together, to keep it friendly?
dialogue.ar: أعرف. لماذا لا نتحدث إليه معاً حتى يبقى الأمر ودياً؟

dialogue.speaker: Samah
dialogue.en: We could, but he is away until Sunday.
dialogue.ar: يمكننا ذلك، لكنه مسافر حتى الأحد.

dialogue.speaker: Ghassan
dialogue.en: Then let's move the car to the front for a week. It's the safest option until he is back.
dialogue.ar: إذن لننقل السيارة إلى الواجهة لأسبوع. هذا هو الخيار الأكثر أماناً حتى يعود.

dialogue.speaker: Samah
dialogue.en: Or we could ask the council to cut the branches, to finish it quickly.
dialogue.ar: أو يمكننا أن نطلب من البلدية قصّ الأغصان، لننتهي من الأمر بسرعة.

dialogue.speaker: Ghassan
dialogue.en: That costs money, and it costs a neighbour. Let's knock on Sunday first.
dialogue.ar: هذا يكلّف مالاً، ويكلّف جاراً. لنطرق بابه يوم الأحد أولاً.

dialogue.speaker: Samah
dialogue.en: Fine. Sunday, and the front space until then.
dialogue.ar: حسناً. الأحد، والموقف الأمامي حتى ذلك الحين.

activities.prompt: Samah and Ghassan weigh up three ways of dealing with the tree. Which do they settle on?
activities.promptAr: يوازن سماح وغسان بين ثلاث طرق للتعامل مع الشجرة. على أيها يستقران؟
options: Speaking to the neighbour on Sunday, and parking at the front until then
Asking the council to cut the branches this week
Leaving the car where it is until the wind drops
activities.answer: Speaking to the neighbour on Sunday, and parking at the front until then
activities.audioTranscript: Your neighbour's tree is over our wall again, Ghassan. Two branches nearly hit the car. I know. Why don't we talk to him together, to keep it friendly? We could, but he is away until Sunday. Then let's move the car to the front for a week. It's the safest option until he is back. Or we could ask the council to cut the branches, to finish it quickly. That costs money, and it costs a neighbour. Let's knock on Sunday first. Fine. Sunday, and the front space until then.

activities.prompt: Make this a suggestion, not a complaint. Choose the opening that fits.
activities.promptAr: اجعل هذا اقتراحاً لا شكوى. اختر الافتتاحية المناسبة.
activities.text: ___ we ask the council first, before we knock on his door?
options: Why don't
Why we don't
Why not we
activities.answer: Why don't

activities.prompt: Read the walking group's message. Which option does the writer prefer herself?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ رسالة مجموعة المشي. أي خيار تفضّله الكاتبة هي نفسها؟
options: Keeping Saturday and finishing the walk inside
Postponing the walk to another weekend
Meeting at the old station instead of the hill
activities.answer: Keeping Saturday and finishing the walk inside
activities.sourceText: Message from the walking group: the hill path will be wet on Saturday. We could postpone the whole walk, or we could keep it short and eat in the shelter by the old station. I would rather finish indoors than lose the day, but tell me what you prefer.

activities.prompt: Listen to Rana's message. What is her objection to postponing the class?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة رنا. ما اعتراضها على تأجيل الحصة؟
options: Half the group has already told her next week is difficult
The hall behind the library is booked next Thursday
The grass will still be soft next Thursday
activities.answer: Half the group has already told her next week is difficult
activities.audioTranscript: Hello, it's Rana from the community centre, about Thursday's outdoor class. The grass will still be soft after all this rain, so here are two ideas. We could postpone it to next Thursday, when the ground should be dry — but half of you have told me next week is difficult. Or we could keep Thursday and hold the class indoors, in the hall behind the library. There is no shelter on the field if it rains again, and I don't want fifteen people standing under one tree. Tell me which you prefer before tomorrow evening.

activities.prompt: A shared path in your building is blocked, and the person who caused it is away. Offer two different ways forward, say what each one is for, and agree on one with your neighbour.
activities.promptAr: ممر مشترك في بنايتكَ مسدود، والشخص الذي تسبّب في ذلك مسافر. اعرض طريقتين مختلفتين للتصرف، وبيّن الغرض من كل منهما، واتفق مع جاركَ على واحدة.
partnerTurns: I saw it this morning. We cannot leave it there, but I do not want an argument with him either.
That is one idea. What else could we do, and what would it cost us?
All right. Say which one you want, and I will go along with it.

readingText.title: Before the Storm Arrives
readingText.text: Dear neighbours, Thursday and Friday will be bad, so here is the plan for our building. Strong wind is likely on Thursday night. If the power goes off, the lift will stop between floors, so please use the stairs after eight. There may be no light on the stairs, so keep a torch and spare batteries in the flat. The drain at the gate is still blocked and the council will not come before Monday. If the rain is heavy, water will reach the basement, so move anything valuable off the floor down there this week, just in case. There is a box under the stairs with a supply of water, a lamp and a radio. In an emergency, ring the number on the door, not me. Why don't we also share one list of phone numbers? Send me yours and I will put the list up on Wednesday. Keep the emergency exit clear. It may be the safest option on Friday night, and it is nobody's private store. Salwa, Flat 12
readingText.textAr: إلى جيراننا الكرام، سيكون الخميس والجمعة سيّئين، وهذه خطتنا للبناية. الرياح القوية مرجّحة ليلة الخميس. إذا انقطع التيار فسيتوقف المصعد بين الطوابق، لذا استخدموا الدرج بعد الثامنة. وقد لا يكون هناك ضوء على الدرج، فاحتفظوا بمصباح يدوي وبطاريات احتياطية في الشقة. البالوعة عند البوابة ما زالت مسدودة، ولن تأتي البلدية قبل الاثنين. وإذا كان المطر غزيراً فسيصل الماء إلى القبو، فارفعوا كل شيء ثمين عن الأرض هناك هذا الأسبوع، تحسّباً. وتحت الدرج صندوق فيه مؤونة من الماء ومصباح ومذياع. وفي حالة طوارئ اتصلوا بالرقم المعلَّق على الباب، لا بي. ولماذا لا نتشارك قائمة واحدة بأرقام الهواتف؟ أرسلوا لي أرقامكم وسأعلّق القائمة يوم الأربعاء. أبقوا مخرج الطوارئ خالياً؛ فقد يكون الخيار الأكثر أماناً ليلة الجمعة، وهو ليس مستودعاً خاصاً لأحد. سلوى، الشقة ١٢

activities.prompt: Read Salwa's message once. What is it mainly doing?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ رسالة سلوى مرة واحدة. ما غرضها الأساسي؟
options: Telling the building what will happen and what each person should do
Complaining to the council about the blocked drain
Asking the neighbours to pay for repairs before Thursday
activities.answer: Telling the building what will happen and what each person should do

activities.prompt: Listen to the caretaker's reply. Which job does he say is not his?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رد الحارس. أي عمل يقول إنه ليس من مسؤوليته؟
options: The drain at the gate
The small drain by the bins
The emergency light on the stairs
activities.answer: The drain at the gate
activities.audioTranscript: Salwa, it's Adel, the caretaker. I read your note and I'll do three things before Thursday. I'll clear the leaves off the small drain by the bins, because that one is mine, not the council's. I'll test the emergency light on the stairs tomorrow morning; if the battery is dead, I'll put a new one in on Wednesday. And I'll leave the basement door unlocked, because if water does come in, nobody should be looking for a key. I can't touch the drain at the gate — that one is still the council's.

activities.prompt: Before you write anything, say your own plan aloud the way Salwa wrote hers. Give one thing that is likely, one thing that may happen, and what people should do about each.
activities.promptAr: قبل أن تكتب شيئاً، قل خطتكَ بصوت عالٍ كما كتبت سلوى خطتها. اذكر أمراً مرجّحاً، وأمراً قد يحدث، وما ينبغي للناس فعله تجاه كلٍّ منهما.

activities.prompt: Your neighbour does not read English, and the park notice is in English only. Tell her what has closed and why, what may happen on Sunday, which way in to use, and what the park says it is not responsible for.
activities.promptAr: جارتكَ لا تقرأ الإنجليزية، وإعلان الحديقة بالإنجليزية وحدها. أخبرها بما أُغلق ولماذا، وما قد يحدث يوم الأحد، وأي مدخل تستعمل، وما الذي تقول الحديقة إنها غير مسؤولة عنه.
activities.sourceCard: City Parks notice: the riverside path is closed until further notice after flood damage. Sunday may be wet again, and the lower gate might not open. Use the east gate and the hard path. Anything left on the grass is not our responsibility.

activities.prompt: Now write your own message to your building before a bad-weather weekend. Say what is likely and what may happen, give two instructions with a reason for each, and make one suggestion the neighbours can agree to. Keep to what Salwa covers, and invent no new services.
activities.promptAr: اكتب الآن رسالتكَ إلى سكان بنايتكَ قبل عطلة نهاية أسبوع سيئة الطقس. اذكر ما هو مرجّح وما قد يحدث، وأعطِ تعليمتين مع سبب لكل منهما، وقدّم اقتراحاً واحداً يمكن للجيران الموافقة عليه. اقتصر على ما تناولته سلوى، ولا تخترع خدمات جديدة.

lessons.title: Mission: A Bad-Weather Action Plan
lessons.scenario: An outdoor community event faces changing weather. Interpret the notice and forecast, agree on changes and communicate a safe plan.

activities.prompt: Read the park's notice before the stalls arrive. Where may no stall stand?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ إعلان الحديقة قبل وصول الأكشاك. أين لا يجوز لأي كشك أن يقف؟
options: On the grass beside the water
On the top field
On the hard path near the east gate
activities.answer: On the grass beside the water
activities.sourceText: Community day, Riverside Park. The grass by the water is soft after the rain, so no stall may stand there. Use the hard path and the top field. If anyone sees a fallen branch, report it to the desk by the east gate.

activities.prompt: Listen to the park office. What happens automatically if thunder begins?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى مكتب الحديقة. ماذا يحدث تلقائياً إذا بدأ الرعد؟
options: Everything moves into the sports hall
The small tents come down
The office rings every stallholder
activities.answer: Everything moves into the sports hall
activities.audioTranscript: Good morning, this is the park office with Saturday's outlook for the community day. The morning will be dry and still — that much we are sure of. From about two o’clock showers are likely, and there may be thunder later in the afternoon. If thunder starts, everything moves into the sports hall; that is not a choice, it is the rule. The wind should stay light, so the small tents are fine, but nobody should put a tent on the soft grass. Ring the office if you want the latest before you leave home.

activities.prompt: You and the other organiser have twenty minutes to change the plan. Say what is likely and what may happen, suggest two changes, and agree which one you will announce.
activities.promptAr: أمامكَ والمنظِّم الآخر عشرون دقيقة لتغيير الخطة. قل ما هو مرجّح وما قد يحدث، واقترح تغييرين، واتفقا على أيهما ستعلنان.
partnerTurns: So, we open in an hour. Tell me what the forecast actually says, in plain words.
Both of those cost us something. Which would you choose, and why?
Fine — say it clearly, because I am going to repeat it to forty people.

activities.prompt: Stand in front of the stallholders and give them the plan. Say what will happen, what might happen, what each person should do, and the reason behind it.
activities.promptAr: قف أمام أصحاب الأكشاك وقدّم لهم الخطة. قل ما سيحدث وما قد يحدث وما ينبغي لكل شخص فعله والسبب وراء ذلك.

activities.prompt: Umm Zaid runs the food stall and does not read English. Tell her what the safety card says: where she may set up, what to do if thunder starts, two things she must not do, and who to call. Add no advice of your own.
activities.promptAr: تدير أم زيد كشك الطعام ولا تقرأ الإنجليزية. أخبرها بما تقوله بطاقة السلامة: أين يجوز لها أن تنصب الكشك، وماذا تفعل إذا بدأ الرعد، وأمرين يجب ألا تفعلهما، وبمن تتصل. ولا تضف نصيحة من عندكَ.
activities.sourceCard: Stallholder safety card: set up on the hard path only. If thunder starts, close the stall and go to the sports hall. Do not move the barriers by the water, and do not use a gas ring under a tent. Any problem, call the desk on two-two-one.

activities.prompt: Write the message that goes out to everyone who booked a place. Say what has changed and why, what may still happen, what people should do, and one thing they do not need to worry about. Use only what the notice, the forecast and the safety card told you.
activities.promptAr: اكتب الرسالة التي سترسَل إلى كل من حجز مكاناً. اذكر ما الذي تغيّر ولماذا، وما قد يحدث بعد، وما ينبغي للناس فعله، وأمراً واحداً لا داعي لقلقهم بشأنه. استخدم فقط ما ورد في الإعلان والتوقعات وبطاقة السلامة.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.en: Are you free on the last Saturday of the month? We're having a small celebration for Amina.
dialogue.ar: هل أنتما متفرغان السبت الأخير من الشهر؟ سنقيم احتفالاً صغيراً لأمينة.

dialogue.speaker: Tawfiq
dialogue.en: What's the occasion? She didn't tell me anything.
dialogue.ar: ما المناسبة؟ لم تخبرني بشيء.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.en: Ten years at the school. I'm the host, so I'm sending the invitations myself.
dialogue.ar: عشر سنوات في المدرسة. أنا المضيفة، لذا أرسل الدعوات بنفسي.

dialogue.speaker: Suha
dialogue.en: Would you like us to join you early and help?
dialogue.ar: هل تودّين أن ننضم إليكِ مبكراً ونساعد؟

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.en: Please. If the weather is good, we'll eat in the garden, so we'll need the long tables.
dialogue.ar: أرجوكما. إذا كان الجو جميلاً فسنأكل في الحديقة، ولذلك سنحتاج إلى الطاولات الطويلة.

dialogue.speaker: Tawfiq
dialogue.en: And if it rains?
dialogue.ar: وإذا أمطرت؟

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.en: Then we move inside, and nobody carries anything. Save the date and tell Hasan.
dialogue.ar: عندها ننتقل إلى الداخل ولا يحمل أحد شيئاً. احفظا التاريخ وأخبرا حسناً.

activities.prompt: Listen once. What are the three of them arranging?
activities.promptAr: استمع مرة واحدة. ما الذي يرتبه الثلاثة؟
options: A celebration for a colleague, and who will help before it starts
A school meeting about next year's timetable
A trip to the garden centre on Saturday morning
activities.answer: A celebration for a colleague, and who will help before it starts
activities.audioTranscript: Are you free on the last Saturday of the month? We're having a small celebration for Amina. What's the occasion? She didn't tell me anything. Ten years at the school. I'm the host, so I'm sending the invitations myself. Would you like us to join you early and help? Please. If the weather is good, we'll eat in the garden, so we'll need the long tables. And if it rains? Then we move inside, and nobody carries anything. Save the date and tell Hasan.

activities.prompt: All three words make a question. Only one of them makes an invitation. Choose it.
activities.promptAr: الكلمات الثلاث تصنع سؤالاً، لكن واحدة منها فقط تصنع دعوة. اخترها.
activities.text: ___ you like to join us for the meal on the thirtieth?
options: Would
Do
Will
activities.answer: Would

activities.prompt: Read the notice from Green Street. What does it ask you to do before you bring food?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ إعلان شارع غرين. ماذا يطلب منك أن تفعل قبل أن تحضر طعاماً؟
options: Tell Munira first
Pay at the gate
Arrive before five
activities.answer: Tell Munira first
activities.sourceText: Green Street neighbours: we are opening the new garden on Friday at five. There will be tea, music and a short talk from the people who built it. Everyone is welcome, children too. If you would like to bring something sweet, please tell Munira first.

activities.prompt: Listen to Ghassan's message. What does he want Munir to do this week?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة غسان. ماذا يريد من منير أن يفعل هذا الأسبوع؟
options: Say whether he is coming
Book a table at the cafe
Collect Nadia from her course
activities.answer: Say whether he is coming
activities.audioTranscript: Hi Munir, it's Ghassan. I'm the host this year, and I'd like you to come. Nadia finishes her course on the fourteenth, so we're having a small celebration at my brother's flat on the Friday after, at one o'clock. It isn't a big occasion: twelve people, lunch, nothing formal. Would you like to join us? If you can't come at one, come later; we'll still be there at four. Save the date and let me know this week, because I have to tell the cafe our numbers on Monday.

activities.prompt: Invite a friend to something you are organising. Say what the occasion is, when and where it is, why you are having it, and what will happen if the weather turns bad.
activities.promptAr: ادعُ صديقاً إلى شيء تنظّمه. قل ما المناسبة، ومتى وأين، ولماذا تقيمها، وماذا سيحدث إذا ساء الطقس.

dialogue.speaker: Basma
dialogue.en: The venue opens at six, so we have an hour to set up.
dialogue.ar: يفتح مكان الفعالية في السادسة، فأمامنا ساعة للتجهيز.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.en: Could you bring the decorations from the office? They're in two boxes.
dialogue.ar: هل يمكنكِ إحضار الزينة من المكتب؟ إنها في صندوقين.

dialogue.speaker: Basma
dialogue.en: I can take one. Would you ask Idris to carry the other?
dialogue.ar: أستطيع حمل واحد. هل تطلب من إدريس أن يحمل الآخر؟

dialogue.speaker: Idris
dialogue.en: I'm here. I'll take both, but could someone book the lift in advance?
dialogue.ar: أنا هنا. سآخذ الصندوقين، لكن هل يحجز أحدكم المصعد مسبقاً؟

dialogue.speaker: Basma
dialogue.en: I'll do that now. Karim, would you organise the tables along the wall?
dialogue.ar: سأفعل ذلك الآن. يا كريم، هل ترتّب الطاولات بمحاذاة الجدار؟

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.en: Of course. Do we have spare chairs if more people come?
dialogue.ar: بالطبع. هل لدينا كراسٍ إضافية إن جاء عدد أكبر؟

dialogue.speaker: Basma
dialogue.en: Ten in the store room. Could you count them before you sit down?
dialogue.ar: عشرة في غرفة المخزن. هل يمكنك عدّها قبل أن تجلس؟

activities.prompt: Listen once. What is happening in this conversation?
activities.promptAr: استمع مرة واحدة. ماذا يجري في هذه المحادثة؟
options: Three people are dividing the jobs before an event
Three people are complaining about a venue
Three people are deciding what time to invite the guests
activities.answer: Three people are dividing the jobs before an event
activities.audioTranscript: The venue opens at six, so we have an hour to set up. Could you bring the decorations from the office? They're in two boxes. I can take one. Would you ask Idris to carry the other? I'm here. I'll take both, but could someone book the lift in advance? I'll do that now. Karim, would you organise the tables along the wall? Of course. Do we have spare chairs if more people come? Ten in the store room. Could you count them before you sit down?

activities.prompt: Build the polite request. Could is followed by the base verb, with no to.
activities.promptAr: كوّن الطلب المهذب. بعد could يأتي الفعل في صيغته الأساسية بلا to.

activities.prompt: Read the job list for the open evening. Ziad has two jobs. What are they?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ قائمة المهام لأمسية الأبواب المفتوحة. لزياد مهمتان. ما هما؟
options: Spare chairs, and a table for the name cards
The sound, and the front door
Decorations, and the store room
activities.answer: Spare chairs, and a table for the name cards
activities.sourceText: Open evening, jobs before six. Munir: unlock the venue and set up the sound. Hana: put the decorations on the door and along the stairs. Ziad: bring the spare chairs from the store room, and organise a table by the entrance for the name cards.

activities.prompt: Listen to Wafa's message. What does she ask the group to do at the end of the evening?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة وفاء. ماذا تطلب من المجموعة في نهاية الأمسية؟
options: Clear the decorations away the same night
Leave the key with the woman at the desk
Move everything into the big hall
activities.answer: Clear the decorations away the same night
activities.audioTranscript: Hello, this is Wafa from the community centre. I'm the caretaker, and I've left the key with the woman at the desk. Two things before Thursday. Could you set up in the small hall, not the big one? The big one is being painted. And would you take the decorations down the same night? The morning class starts at eight, so the room has to be empty. There are spare tables behind the stage if you need them. Ring me in advance if anything changes.

activities.prompt: You and a neighbour are sharing out the jobs for Saturday. Ask her for three things politely, say which job you will do yourself, and agree a time to meet at the venue.
activities.promptAr: أنتَ وجارتكَ توزّعان مهام السبت. اطلب منها ثلاثة أشياء بأدب، وقل أي مهمة ستؤديها بنفسكَ، واتفقا على وقت اللقاء في مكان الفعالية.
partnerTurns: Right, Saturday. Tell me what you still need doing and I'll write it down.
I can manage two of those, but not the heavy box on my own.
Fine. So what are you doing yourself, and what time do you want me there?

dialogue.speaker: Nawal
dialogue.en: The chairs have just arrived. Has anyone counted the guests yet?
dialogue.ar: وصلت الكراسي للتو. هل عدّ أحدٌ الضيوف بعد؟

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.en: I've already checked the attendance list. Forty-one people are coming.
dialogue.ar: راجعتُ قائمة الحضور بالفعل. سيأتي واحد وأربعون شخصاً.

dialogue.speaker: Bushra
dialogue.en: Four of them can only attend after four o'clock. Is that a problem?
dialogue.ar: أربعة منهم لا يستطيعون الحضور إلا بعد الرابعة. هل في ذلك مشكلة؟

dialogue.speaker: Nawal
dialogue.en: No. But I haven't printed the name cards yet, and the speaker is arriving at one.
dialogue.ar: لا. لكنني لم أطبع بطاقات الأسماء بعد، والمتحدثة تصل في الواحدة.

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.en: I'll remind her about the parking. She hasn't driven here before.
dialogue.ar: سأذكّرها بموقف السيارات؛ فهي لم تقد إلى هنا من قبل.

dialogue.speaker: Bushra
dialogue.en: Has Munir opened the hall yet?
dialogue.ar: هل فتح منير القاعة بعد؟

dialogue.speaker: Nawal
dialogue.en: He's already opened it, so every arrangement is finished. We're all set.
dialogue.ar: فتحها بالفعل، فكل الترتيبات انتهت. كل شيء جاهز.

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.en: Good. I'm looking forward to this one.
dialogue.ar: جيد. أتطلع إلى هذه المرة.

activities.prompt: Listen once. Where are the three of them in their preparations?
activities.promptAr: استمع مرة واحدة. إلى أين وصلوا في تحضيراتهم؟
options: Almost everything is done, with one job left
They have only just started and nothing is ready
They have run out of time and want to cancel
activities.answer: Almost everything is done, with one job left
activities.audioTranscript: The chairs have just arrived. Has anyone counted the guests yet? I've already checked the attendance list. Forty-one people are coming. Four of them can only attend after four o'clock. Is that a problem? No. But I haven't printed the name cards yet, and the speaker is arriving at one. I'll remind her about the parking. She hasn't driven here before. Has Munir opened the hall yet? He's already opened it, so every arrangement is finished. We're all set. Good. I'm looking forward to this one.

activities.prompt: The sentence is negative, and the news is still waiting. Choose the word that fits.
activities.promptAr: الجملة منفية والخبر ما زال منتظراً. اختر الكلمة المناسبة.
activities.text: I've sent forty invitations, but nine people haven't replied ___.
options: yet
already
just
activities.answer: yet

activities.prompt: Match each piece of news to the job it describes.
activities.promptAr: طابق كل خبر بالمهمة التي يصفها.
pairs: The flowers have just arrived,
so somebody should put them on the tables.
Suad has already paid the hall,
so nobody has to bring money today.
No one has rung the kitchen yet,
so we still do not know about the tea.

activities.prompt: Listen to Fouad's message from the hall. What does he ask you to bring?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة فؤاد من القاعة. ماذا يطلب منك أن تحضر؟
options: A sign for the front door
Flowers from the shop
Paper for the printer
activities.answer: A sign for the front door
activities.audioTranscript: Hello, it's Fouad at the office. I've just come back from the hall, and I wanted to give you the news before you set off. The tables have already arrived, and I've put them along the two long walls. The man from the sound company has been and gone. Two things are not finished yet: nobody has collected the flowers, and the front door still needs a sign. I haven't printed one because the printer is out of paper. Could you bring a sign with you? Everything else is ready.

activities.prompt: It is the morning of an event you are running. Tell the team where things stand: one thing that has just happened, two that are already done, and one that has not happened yet.
activities.promptAr: إنه صباح يوم فعالية تديرها. أخبر الفريق أين وصلت الأمور: شيء حدث للتو، وشيئان تمّا بالفعل، وشيء لم يحدث بعد.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.en: Did you both get Maha's message about Thursday?
dialogue.ar: هل وصلتكما رسالة مها عن يوم الخميس؟

dialogue.speaker: Rashid
dialogue.en: I did. Count me in; I'll finish work at five and come straight there.
dialogue.ar: وصلتني. اعتبريني معكم؛ سأنهي عملي في الخامسة وآتي مباشرة.

dialogue.speaker: Dalal
dialogue.en: I'd love to, but my sister arrives from Basra that evening.
dialogue.ar: يسعدني ذلك، لكن أختي تصل من البصرة في ذلك المساء.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.en: So you're going to decline?
dialogue.ar: إذن ستعتذرين عن الحضور؟

dialogue.speaker: Dalal
dialogue.en: Not completely. I'll accept for the second half and bring her with me, if Maha doesn't mind.
dialogue.ar: ليس تماماً. سأقبل الدعوة للنصف الثاني وآتي بها معي، إن لم تمانع مها.

dialogue.speaker: Rashid
dialogue.en: She won't. She'll be disappointed if you don't come at all.
dialogue.ar: لن تمانع. ستشعر بخيبة أمل إن لم تأتي أصلاً.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.en: Then say yes now, because she has to tell the restaurant by tonight.
dialogue.ar: إذن قولي نعم الآن، لأن عليها أن تخبر المطعم الليلة.

dialogue.speaker: Dalal
dialogue.en: I'm writing to her now. Sorry, I can't make it at seven, but eight is fine.
dialogue.ar: أكتب إليها الآن. آسفة، لا أستطيع الحضور في السابعة، لكن الثامنة مناسبة.

activities.prompt: Listen once. What are the three of them doing?
activities.promptAr: استمع مرة واحدة. ماذا يفعل الثلاثة؟
options: Working out how to answer an invitation
Choosing a restaurant for Thursday
Planning a journey to Basra
activities.answer: Working out how to answer an invitation
activities.audioTranscript: Did you both get Maha's message about Thursday? I did. Count me in; I'll finish work at five and come straight there. I'd love to, but my sister arrives from Basra that evening. So you're going to decline? Not completely. I'll accept for the second half and bring her with me, if Maha doesn't mind. She won't. She'll be disappointed if you don't come at all. Then say yes now, because she has to tell the restaurant by tonight. I'm writing to her now. Sorry, I can't make it at seven, but eight is fine.

activities.prompt: Build the polite refusal. The warm half comes first, the reason last.
activities.promptAr: كوّن الاعتذار المهذب: الشطر الودود أولاً والسبب أخيراً.

activities.prompt: Listen to Sabah's reply. Why can't she come?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رد صباح. لماذا لا تستطيع الحضور؟
options: She is away on a course that week
She has already promised to see her mother
She was told about it too late
activities.answer: She is away on a course that week
activities.audioTranscript: Hi Maha, it's Sabah. Thank you for the invitation; that's really kind of you. I'd love to come on Thursday, but I'm away that week. My course finishes on the Friday and I don't get back until late. I'm disappointed, honestly, because I haven't seen everybody since the spring. Please don't keep a seat for me. If you do the same thing in August, I'll be the first to accept. Say hello to your mother from me, and I hope it goes well.

activities.prompt: Read the reply card. What should somebody do if they say yes and then cannot come?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ بطاقة الرد. ماذا يفعل من يوافق ثم لا يستطيع الحضور؟
options: Ring the office
Send the card back a second time
Send something instead
activities.answer: Ring the office
activities.sourceText: Reply card: please tick one line and return it by Monday. I will attend, and I am bringing one guest. I will attend alone. Unfortunately I must decline, and I will send something instead. If you accept and then cannot come, ring the office, because we pay for the food on Tuesday.

activities.prompt: Two invitations have arrived for the same evening. Write both replies: accept the first warmly and say what time you will arrive, then decline the second politely with a real reason and an offer for another time.
activities.promptAr: وصلتكَ دعوتان لليلة نفسها. اكتب الردّين: اقبل الأولى بحفاوة مع ذكر وقت وصولكَ، ثم اعتذر عن الثانية بأدب مع سبب حقيقي واقتراح موعد آخر.

dialogue.speaker: Widad
dialogue.en: There's a change of plan. Unfortunately the hall has no heating.
dialogue.ar: هناك تغيير في الخطة. للأسف لا توجد تدفئة في القاعة.

dialogue.speaker: Jalal
dialogue.en: At this time of year? We can't ask sixty people to sit in the cold.
dialogue.ar: في هذا الوقت من السنة؟ لا يمكننا أن نطلب من ستين شخصاً الجلوس في البرد.

dialogue.speaker: Widad
dialogue.en: I know. So we'll use the library room instead, and start half an hour later.
dialogue.ar: أعرف. لذلك سنستخدم غرفة المكتبة بدلاً منها، ونبدأ متأخرين نصف ساعة.

dialogue.speaker: Amjad
dialogue.en: Or we postpone it to next Saturday and keep the hall.
dialogue.ar: أو نؤجّلها إلى السبت المقبل ونحتفظ بالقاعة.

dialogue.speaker: Widad
dialogue.en: Next Saturday is the exam week. I'd rather not postpone at short notice.
dialogue.ar: السبت المقبل أسبوع الامتحانات. أفضّل ألا نؤجّل في مهلة قصيرة كهذه.

dialogue.speaker: Jalal
dialogue.en: Then the library room. I'll pass it on to the choir tonight.
dialogue.ar: إذن غرفة المكتبة. سأبلّغ الجوقة الليلة.

dialogue.speaker: Amjad
dialogue.en: And I'll ring the six people who never read messages.
dialogue.ar: وسأتصل بالستة الذين لا يقرؤون الرسائل أبداً.

dialogue.speaker: Widad
dialogue.en: Thank you. The date, the food and the price are all the same; only the room and the time have changed.
dialogue.ar: شكراً لكما. التاريخ والطعام والسعر كما هي؛ الغرفة والوقت وحدهما تغيّرا.

activities.prompt: Listen once. What do the three of them decide in the end?
activities.promptAr: استمع مرة واحدة. ما الذي يقرره الثلاثة في النهاية؟
options: To keep the day and move to a different room
To postpone everything until the exam week is over
To ask the sixty guests to bring warm clothes
activities.answer: To keep the day and move to a different room
activities.audioTranscript: There's a change of plan. Unfortunately the hall has no heating. At this time of year? We can't ask sixty people to sit in the cold. I know. So we'll use the library room instead, and start half an hour later. Or we postpone it to next Saturday and keep the hall. Next Saturday is the exam week. I'd rather not postpone at short notice. Then the library room. I'll pass it on to the choir tonight. And I'll ring the six people who never read messages. Thank you. The date, the food and the price are all the same; only the room and the time have changed.

activities.prompt: This is the first line of the message, and it brings bad news. Choose the word that fits.
activities.promptAr: هذا أول سطر في الرسالة وهو يحمل خبراً سيئاً. اختر الكلمة المناسبة.
activities.text: Dear all: ___, the boat is not running on Sunday. We will take the bus instead.
options: Unfortunately
Instead
However
activities.answer: Unfortunately

activities.prompt: Read the notice on the door. What stays the same after the change?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الإعلان على الباب. ما الذي يبقى كما هو بعد التغيير؟
options: The hour, and what you have already paid
The day, and the room
Nothing at all this month
activities.answer: The hour, and what you have already paid
activities.sourceText: Notice on the door: this week's class is postponed. Unfortunately the teacher is ill. There is no class on Wednesday; we will meet on Saturday at the same hour instead. Your card is still valid, and nobody has to pay twice.

activities.prompt: Listen to Rabab's message from the swimming club. What still happens tomorrow?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة رباب من نادي السباحة. ما الذي سيحدث غداً رغم كل شيء؟
options: The children's session, in the small pool
Saturday's lesson, at the usual time
Nothing at all until Friday
activities.answer: The children's session, in the small pool
activities.audioTranscript: Good evening, this is Rabab from the swimming club. I'm sorry to ring at short notice. Unfortunately the pool is closed tomorrow; something broke in the heating last night, and the engineer cannot come until Friday. So Saturday's lesson is postponed to the week after, at the same time. The children's session tomorrow will run in the small pool instead, but only for the under nines. Please pass it on to the other parents; I have not reached everybody yet. Nobody needs to pay again.

activities.prompt: A friend has heard that Saturday is cancelled, which is not quite right. Tell him what has really changed, what has not, and why, then say whether you are still going yourself.
activities.promptAr: سمع صديقكَ أن السبت أُلغي، وهذا ليس دقيقاً. أخبره بما تغيّر فعلاً وما لم يتغيّر ولماذا، ثم قل له إن كنتَ ستذهب أنتَ أم لا.
partnerTurns: Someone told me Saturday is off. Is that right? I've already told my brother.
So what has actually changed, and what stays the same?
All right. And are you still going yourself?

readingText.title: The Street Lunch at Number Twelve
readingText.text: Dear neighbours, you are invited to the street lunch at number twelve on Saturday the sixth of June, from one o'clock until five. It is ten years since the first one, so we would like everybody to come, old neighbours and new. All the event details are on the card in your letterbox. We have already booked the tables and the tea urn. However, we have not found anybody to carry the chairs up from the basement yet, so please tell us if you have an hour free on Saturday morning. Bring a dish if you would like to. Please let us know about any dietary needs when you reply, and tell us how many are coming with you. Two families have not sent a reply yet; the rest of you have been very quick, thank you. If it rains we will eat in the hall instead. Contact Faiza on the number below with any question. We are looking forward to seeing you all.
readingText.textAr: أعزاءنا الجيران، ندعوكم إلى غداء الشارع في المنزل رقم اثني عشر يوم السبت السادس من حزيران، من الواحدة ظهراً حتى الخامسة. مرّت عشر سنوات على أول غداء، ونودّ أن يأتي الجميع، القدامى منكم والجدد. تفاصيل الفعالية كلها في البطاقة التي وضعناها في صندوق بريدكم. لقد حجزنا الطاولات وإبريق الشاي الكبير بالفعل، غير أننا لم نجد بعد من يحمل الكراسي من القبو، فأخبرونا إن كانت لديكم ساعة فارغة صباح السبت. أحضروا طبقاً إن أحببتم. أرجو أن تخبرونا بأي احتياجات غذائية حين تردّون، وأن تذكروا كم شخصاً سيأتي معكم. عائلتان لم ترسلا رداً بعد، أما بقيتكم فكانوا سريعين جداً، ولكم الشكر. وإذا أمطرت فسنتناول الغداء في القاعة بدلاً من الشارع. تواصلوا مع فائزة على الرقم أدناه لأي سؤال. نتطلع إلى رؤيتكم جميعاً.

activities.prompt: Read Faiza and Nabil's message once. What are they mainly asking the street to do?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ رسالة فائزة ونبيل مرة واحدة. ما الذي يطلبانه من أهل الشارع أساساً؟
options: Come, reply with their numbers, and say if they can help
Pay a share of the tables and the tea urn
Move the lunch indoors because of the weather
activities.answer: Come, reply with their numbers, and say if they can help

activities.prompt: Listen to Nabil's message. What three things does he need from each family?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة نبيل. ما الأشياء الثلاثة التي يحتاجها من كل عائلة؟
options: Numbers, dietary needs and a phone number
Money, a dish and a chair
A card, an address and a signature
activities.answer: Numbers, dietary needs and a phone number
activities.audioTranscript: Hello, this is Nabil from number twelve, leaving a message for the people who haven't replied. Don't worry, there's nothing to pay. We only need three things from you: how many are coming, whether anybody has a dietary need, and a phone number we can contact on the day. The card came through your door on Monday. However, if you have lost it, everything is also on the noticeboard by the shop. Please let us know by Wednesday, because we order the bread on Thursday morning. Thank you.

activities.prompt: Before you write anything, say your own message aloud the way Faiza wrote hers: the occasion, when and where, one thing already arranged, one thing still missing, and what to do if it rains.
activities.promptAr: قبل أن تكتب شيئاً، قل رسالتكَ بصوت عالٍ كما كتبت فائزة رسالتها: المناسبة، ومتى وأين، وأمر رُتّب بالفعل، وأمر ما زال ناقصاً، وماذا تفعلون إن أمطرت.

activities.prompt: Your neighbour does not read English. Tell her what the hall has written: the hours the room is theirs, what is already in the room, the one thing that does not work, and what has to happen at the end of the day.
activities.promptAr: جارتكِ لا تقرأ الإنجليزية. أخبريها بما كتبته إدارة القاعة: ساعات استخدام الغرفة، وما الموجود فيها أصلاً، والشيء الوحيد المعطّل، وما يجب فعله في نهاية اليوم.
activities.sourceCard: Note from the hall: you may use the room from twelve until six on Saturday. The kitchen is included, however the big oven is broken. Tables and sixty chairs are already there. Please leave the room as you found it, and return the key to the shop next door.

activities.prompt: Now write your own event message to a group you belong to. Give the occasion, the date, the time and the place, one thing that is already arranged and one that is not arranged yet, what you need in the reply, and how to contact you.
activities.promptAr: اكتب الآن رسالة فعاليتكَ إلى مجموعة تنتمي إليها. اذكر المناسبة والتاريخ والوقت والمكان، وأمراً رُتّب بالفعل وأمراً لم يُرتّب بعد، وما تحتاجه في الرد، وكيف يتواصلون معكَ.

lessons.title: Mission: Organise an Event After Changes
lessons.scenario: Organise a small event, invite people, distribute tasks, then respond to an unseen venue or schedule change and update everyone.

activities.prompt: Read the council's notice before you ring anybody. What has not changed about Saturday?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ إعلان المجلس البلدي قبل أن تتصل بأحد. ما الذي لم يتغيّر في يوم السبت؟
options: The cooking activity and the price
The building and the street
The hour the evening starts
activities.answer: The cooking activity and the price
activities.sourceText: From the council office: River Hall is closed for repairs until the autumn, so Saturday's welcome evening moves to the Oak Centre on Mill Road. The start is now five o'clock, not four. The cooking activity and the price are unchanged. Confirm your numbers by Thursday.

activities.prompt: Listen to Thurayya's reply. What does she need somebody else to do?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رد ثريا. ما الذي تحتاج أن يقوم به شخص آخر؟
options: Collect the key at four
Tell Munir about the new place
Bring knives for the cooking
activities.answer: Collect the key at four
activities.audioTranscript: Hi, it's Thurayya. I've just read the notice about the Oak Centre. Count me in for the evening; I'd love to help with the cooking, and I'll bring my own knives. However, I can't collect the key at four, because I don't finish my shift until half past. Could somebody else do that? I've already told Munir and the two families on my landing, so you don't have to contact them again. One more thing: my neighbour is coming, and she can't eat anything with nuts.

activities.prompt: Ring a guest who has not replied. Invite her to the new time and place, explain why it moved, and ask her to take one job. Answer what she says.
activities.promptAr: اتصل بضيفة لم تردّ بعد. ادعُها إلى الموعد والمكان الجديدين، واشرح سبب التغيير، واطلب منها أن تتولى مهمة واحدة. وأجب عما تقوله.
partnerTurns: Hello? Sorry, I've been away. I haven't read anything all week.
The Oak Centre? I thought it was at River Hall at four. What happened?
I can come, but not for the whole evening. Tell me what you still need, and I'll say what I can do.

activities.prompt: Present the final plan to the team in under a minute: the new place and time, what has already been arranged, what is not arranged yet, and who is doing each job.
activities.promptAr: قدّم الخطة النهائية للفريق في أقل من دقيقة: المكان والوقت الجديدين، وما رُتّب بالفعل، وما لم يُرتّب بعد، ومن يتولى كل مهمة.

activities.prompt: Umm Zahra does not read English. Tell her what the Oak Centre has written: when she can come in and how long the room is yours, where to leave the car, what is included, and the one thing nobody may do.
activities.promptAr: أم زهراء لا تقرأ الإنجليزية. أخبرها بما كتبه مركز أوك: متى يمكنها الدخول وكم من الوقت الغرفة لكم، وأين تترك السيارة، وما المشمول، والشيء الوحيد الممنوع.
activities.sourceCard: Oak Centre, note for the organiser: doors open at half past four, and the room is yours until nine. There is no parking on Mill Road, so use the school car park opposite. Tea and coffee are included. Please do not move the piano.

activities.prompt: The invitation you sent last week is now wrong. Write the message that replaces it: apologise for the change, say why it happened, give the new place and time, say what has not changed, name the two jobs you still need, and ask for a reply by Thursday.
activities.promptAr: الدعوة التي أرسلتها الأسبوع الماضي صارت خاطئة. اكتب الرسالة التي تحل محلها: اعتذر عن التغيير، واذكر سببه، وأعطِ المكان والوقت الجديدين، وقل ما لم يتغيّر، وسمِّ المهمتين اللتين ما زلت تحتاجهما، واطلب الرد قبل الخميس.

audio-a2-u1-l1-a01.transcript: I normally get up at seven on weekdays. I take the bus to work and play football on Thursday.

audio-a2-u1-l1-a04.transcript: Karim works in a shop from Sunday to Thursday. On Friday, he visits his parents.

audio-a2-u1-l2-a01.transcript: I usually live in Mosul, but this month I am staying with my brother in Erbil. I am taking an evening course there.

audio-a2-u1-l2-a04.transcript: Lina normally teaches children. This week, she is helping at a sports camp.

audio-a2-u1-l4-a01.transcript: A: I am working on a new project. B: That sounds interesting. Are you enjoying it? A: Yes, very much.

audio-a2-u1-l4-a04.transcript: A: My sister is opening a café. B: Really? Tell me more. Where is it?

audio-a2-u1-l7-a02.transcript: I normally study engineering, but I am working in my uncle's shop during the holiday.

audio-a2-u2-l1-a01.transcript: Last weekend, I was in Najaf with my cousins. The streets were busy, but the visit was memorable.

audio-a2-u2-l1-a04.transcript: Rita was at a family party yesterday. Her parents were there too.

audio-a2-u2-l2-a01.transcript: We arrived early, visited the castle and decided to eat near the river.

audio-a2-u2-l2-a04.transcript: Ali planned a picnic, packed lunch and walked to the park. Rain started at noon.

audio-a2-u2-l4-a01.transcript: A: How was the concert? B: Great. A: Who did you go with? B: My sister. We didn't stay for the last song.

audio-a2-u2-l4-a04.transcript: A: What happened yesterday? B: I missed the bus. A: Did you arrive late? B: No, I took a taxi.

audio-a2-u2-l7-a02.transcript: First we visited the market. Then we ate by the river. Suddenly it rained, so we ran into a small café.

audio-a2-u3-l1-a01.transcript: My cousin is tall and has short curly hair. He wears glasses.

audio-a2-u3-l1-a04.transcript: The new manager is medium height with long dark hair. She usually wears a blue jacket.

audio-a2-u3-l2-a01.transcript: A: What is Dalia like? B: She is outgoing and kind. She talks to everyone, but she is also a patient listener.

audio-a2-u3-l2-a04.transcript: Fadi is reliable. When he says he will help, he always comes on time.

audio-a2-u3-l7-a02.transcript: Bilal is quieter than the other candidates, but he is the most organised and always finishes tasks on time.

audio-a2-u4-l1-a01.transcript: Our old flat was small. There was one bedroom and there wasn't a balcony. We moved because the heating was unreliable.

audio-a2-u4-l1-a04.transcript: The building was quiet, and there were two parks nearby. There wasn't a lift.

audio-a2-u4-l2-a01.transcript: The area is convenient. There are a lot of cafés and some small shops. There isn't much traffic at night.

audio-a2-u4-l2-a04.transcript: There aren't many buses after ten, but the station is within walking distance.

audio-a2-u4-l4-a01.transcript: The living room is bright enough, but the kitchen is too small for a family of five. The street is also too noisy at night.

audio-a2-u4-l4-a04.transcript: The flat is close enough to work, but it is too expensive and there isn't enough storage space.

audio-a2-u4-l7-a02.transcript: The studio is convenient, but it is too small for two people who work from home. The riverside flat is larger and quiet enough for online meetings.

audio-a2-u5-l1-a01.transcript: For the bread, we need 500 grams of flour, a lot of water and two small spoons of salt.

audio-a2-u5-l1-a04.transcript: The salad needs many tomatoes but not much oil. It also needs 100 grams of cheese.

audio-a2-u5-l2-a01.transcript: First, boil the water. Then add the pasta. Stir it twice and cook for ten minutes.

audio-a2-u5-l2-a04.transcript: Heat the oil, add the vegetables and stir for five minutes. Finally, add the cooked rice.

audio-a2-u5-l4-a01.transcript: Customer: Excuse me, this isn't what I ordered. I asked for vegetable soup, but this has chicken in it. Server: I'm sorry. I'll change it.

audio-a2-u5-l4-a04.transcript: Customer: One dessert is missing, and you brought us three coffees instead of two. Server: I'll correct the order now.

audio-a2-u5-l7-a02.transcript: We ordered three vegetable meals, but only two arrived, and one of them has meat. Please send two correct vegetable meals.

audio-a2-u6-l1-a01.transcript: We are going to spend the weekend in Aqaba. We plan to see the fort and take a boat trip.

audio-a2-u6-l1-a04.transcript: Mira is going to visit Cairo for three days. She plans to see the museum and walk by the river.

audio-a2-u6-l2-a01.transcript: Guest: Do you have a double room available for Friday? Clerk: Yes. What time are you arriving? Guest: We're arriving at six.

audio-a2-u6-l2-a04.transcript: Caller: I'm travelling alone and need a room for two nights. Reception: A single room is available, and breakfast is included.

audio-a2-u6-l4-a01.transcript: If the boat trip is cancelled, we'll visit the aquarium. If there is a train delay, we'll call the hotel.

audio-a2-u6-l4-a04.transcript: If the road is closed, the bus will use another route and arrive twenty minutes late.

audio-a2-u6-l7-a02.transcript: The 8:15 train is cancelled. Your ticket is valid on the direct train at 9:05, which arrives at 11:20.

audio-a2-u7-l1-a01.transcript: I have a sore throat and a cough. You should drink warm water and rest, but you shouldn't go to work today.

audio-a2-u7-l1-a04.transcript: My back hurts after sitting all day. You should walk for a few minutes and change your chair position.

audio-a2-u7-l2-a01.transcript: Take one dose twice a day with food. You don't have to take it at an exact minute, but leave about twelve hours between doses.

audio-a2-u7-l2-a04.transcript: Your appointment is at four. You have to arrive ten minutes early, but you don't have to bring the medicine box.

audio-a2-u7-l4-a01.transcript: Drink water to stay hydrated. Stand up every hour to stretch your legs, and avoid screens late at night to sleep better.

audio-a2-u7-l4-a04.transcript: Use a smaller bag to reduce shoulder pain, and take short breaks to relax your eyes.

audio-a2-u7-l7-a02.transcript: I've had a sore back since Tuesday. It started after moving furniture, and today the pain is worse when I sit.

audio-a2-u8-l1-a01.transcript: I work the morning shift. I have to open the shop, check deliveries and send the daily report before three.

audio-a2-u8-l1-a04.transcript: Nadia is responsible for the reception desk. She has to answer calls, but she doesn't have to manage payments.

audio-a2-u8-l2-a01.transcript: I can use spreadsheets and operate the printer. At my previous job, I could also speak to customers in two languages.

audio-a2-u8-l2-a04.transcript: Hassan can design simple posters, but he can't edit video yet. He could draw well before he learned digital design.

audio-a2-u8-l7-a02.transcript: The evening course begins on 6 October and runs twice a week. The fee is ninety dollars, including materials. Enrolment closes this Friday.

audio-a2-u9-l1-a01.transcript: Press and hold the side button for three seconds. If the screen stays dark, connect the charger.

audio-a2-u9-l1-a04.transcript: Tap the green button to answer. To end the call, tap the red button once.

audio-a2-u9-l2-a01.transcript: First go to settings. Next choose Wi-Fi and select the library network. Then enter the code and finally download the file.

audio-a2-u9-l2-a04.transcript: Open the message, tap the document name and choose ‘save’. Finally, check the downloads folder.

audio-a2-u9-l5-a01.transcript: Support: What happens when you open the app? User: It freezes after I sign in. Support: Do you see an error message? User: Yes, code 204.

audio-a2-u9-l5-a04.transcript: User: The sound works in music apps, but not during video calls. Support: Does the microphone icon show a line across it?

audio-a2-u9-l7-a02.transcript: If the video freezes, turn the camera off for ten seconds. If the sound continues, stay in the meeting and switch the camera on again.

audio-a2-u10-l1-a01.transcript: At the beginning, the main character was living in a small village and working at a train station.

audio-a2-u10-l1-a04.transcript: The opening scene showed a family who were preparing for a long journey. The children were packing while their father was checking tickets.

audio-a2-u10-l2-a01.transcript: I was watching the final scene when the electricity went off. When it returned, I discovered that the film had finished.

audio-a2-u10-l2-a04.transcript: The actor was speaking when a dog ran onto the stage. The audience laughed and the actor stopped.

audio-a2-u10-l5-a01.transcript: In my opinion, the film was entertaining because the characters were warm. Although the middle was confusing, the ending was moving.

audio-a2-u10-l5-a04.transcript: What I liked was the music, but the story was too long. I still recommend it because the final scene was excellent.

audio-a2-u10-l7-a02.transcript: I was enjoying the play when the sound suddenly stopped. While the actors were waiting, the audience began to sing. It became the funniest part of the evening.

audio-a2-u11-l1-a01.transcript: The forecast says a storm is coming, so the outdoor market will close early. Some roads are wet because of last night's rain.

audio-a2-u11-l1-a04.transcript: A tree fell because the wind was strong, so buses are using another road.

audio-a2-u11-l2-a01.transcript: If the river rises another twenty centimetres, the park will close. Visitors will use the higher road because it is safer.

audio-a2-u11-l2-a04.transcript: If temperatures fall tonight, the bridge will be icy in the morning. Drivers will need to slow down.

audio-a2-u11-l5-a01.transcript: A: The picnic area is flooded. B: We could use the shelter near the café. A: It might be crowded. Let's move the lunch indoors instead.

audio-a2-u11-l5-a04.transcript: The path is too muddy. We should choose the paved route, or we could visit the nature centre until it dries.

audio-a2-u11-l7-a02.transcript: Heavy rain may begin after three, and there might be thunder at five. If thunder starts, all activities will move into the sports hall.

audio-a2-u12-l1-a01.transcript: A: Are you free on Friday evening? We're having a small celebration. Would you like to join us? B: Yes, thank you.

audio-a2-u12-l1-a04.transcript: We're meeting at the park on Sunday at eleven. Would you like to come for a picnic?

audio-a2-u12-l2-a01.transcript: A: Could you bring the decorations to the venue at four? B: Sure. Would you send me the address?

audio-a2-u12-l2-a04.transcript: Could you collect the key at noon? I will prepare the food, and Dana will bring extra chairs.

audio-a2-u12-l4-a01.transcript: A: Would you like to come on Saturday? B: I'd love to, but I'm working until seven. Could I join later?

audio-a2-u12-l4-a04.transcript: Thanks for inviting me. Unfortunately, I can't make it because I am travelling that day. I hope you have a great time.

audio-a2-u12-l7-a02.transcript: I can come at five and bring the drinks, but I can't collect the key because I am working until four thirty. Could someone else do that?

audio-a2-final-mission-a03.transcript: Your train is delayed by twenty-five minutes and will now arrive at eighteen oh five. The platform is unchanged.

audio-a2-final-mission-a04.transcript: The café can prepare the vegetable dish without nuts, but you must order it before noon because the evening kitchen is very busy.

audio-a2-fa-listen-01.transcript: The 12:20 train now leaves at 12:50 from platform four.

audio-a2-fa-listen-02.transcript: Take one tablet after dinner. Do not take a second tablet before morning.

audio-a2-fa-listen-03.transcript: If the screen freezes, save your work before you restart the computer.

audio-a2-fa-listen-04.transcript: Rain is likely after five, so the football game will begin an hour earlier at three.

audio-a2-fa-listen-05.transcript: I'd love to come, but I finish work at eight. Could I join for the last hour?

audio-a2-fa-listen-06.transcript: We ordered four soups, but only three arrived, and the bill lists five.

audio-a2-fa-listen-07.transcript: The flat is cheaper and closer to work, but the house is quieter and has more space.

audio-a2-fa-listen-08.transcript: Leila is less experienced than Samir, but she is the most organised candidate.

audio-a2-fa-listen-09.transcript: We were walking to the station when a neighbour offered us a lift.

audio-a2-fa-listen-10.transcript: I normally work mornings, but this month I am taking the evening shift.

audio-a2-fa-listen-11.transcript: The course meets Tuesday and Thursday. Materials are included, but transport is not.

audio-a2-fa-listen-12.transcript: Although the plot was simple, the characters were moving and the ending was excellent.

audio-a2-fa-listen-13.transcript: If the boat is cancelled, meet the guide at the museum entrance at ten.

audio-a2-fa-listen-14.transcript: Open settings, choose notifications, and turn off the sound for this app only.

audio-a2-fa-listen-15.transcript: I've had the cough since Friday, and it became worse last night.

audio-a2-fa-listen-16.transcript: Because the hall is unavailable, the workshop will take place online. The date and time are unchanged.

audio-a2-fa-listen-17.transcript: There might be fog early, but it should clear before the buses leave at nine.
