audio-a2-fa-listen-18.transcript: First chop the vegetables. Then heat the oil, and add the vegetables only when it is hot.

finalMission.title: Host a Visitor
finalMission.sourcePolicy: Sabri, Sefton Court, Meadow Lane, Ashfield, the Harbour line, Old Mill Kitchen, Willow Gardens and the evening clinic are fictional. Every message, notice, recording and card in this mission is written for it alone and appears in no A1 or A2 lesson.
finalMission.scenario: An old friend comes for two nights. Read his message and the building's notice, take in two recordings that change the plan, welcome him and solve the problem that appears, present the visit and the neighbourhood, relay two cards he cannot read for himself, then write the plan and, a week later, the thank-you.

activities.prompt: Read Sabri's message before you decide anything. He says that one thing matters to him more than the rest. Which room do you give him?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ رسالة صبري قبل أن تقرر أي شيء. يقول إن أمراً واحداً يهمّه أكثر من غيره. أي غرفة تعطيه؟
options: The small room at the back, because the internet reaches it best
The big room at the front, because the bed there is more comfortable
The room beside the kitchen, because of the food he cannot eat
activities.answer: The small room at the back, because the internet reaches it best
activities.sourceText: From Sabri: I get in on Friday evening and leave on Sunday after lunch. Please don't cook anything with nuts for me, because I have been ill twice from them. I don't mind a small room, but I have to join a meeting online at nine on Saturday, so good internet matters more than a big bed.

activities.prompt: Your building has put this notice by the door, and Sabri arrives on Friday evening. What do you have to do so that he can get in?
activities.promptAr: علّقت إدارة البناية هذا الإعلان عند الباب، وصبري يصل مساء الجمعة. ماذا عليكَ أن تفعل كي يتمكن من الدخول؟
options: Meet him at the back gate yourself, because the bells are not working
Tell him to ring the bell at the front entrance when the painters have gone
Ask him to wait until Monday, when the front entrance opens again
activities.answer: Meet him at the back gate yourself, because the bells are not working
activities.sourceText: Sefton Court, to all residents: the painters start work on the front entrance on Friday morning and finish on Monday. Until then, please use the back gate on Meadow Lane. The door bells do not work while the painting goes on, so if you are expecting anybody this weekend, meet them at the gate or give them your number.

activities.prompt: Listen to the message Sabri leaves from the station. What has changed for you?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى الرسالة التي تركها صبري من المحطة. ما الذي تغيّر بالنسبة إليكَ؟
options: He now reaches you about eight, and he is bringing nothing with him
He now reaches you at a quarter past seven, and he wants you at the station
He now reaches you about eight, and he has already bought something for your family
activities.answer: He now reaches you about eight, and he is bringing nothing with him
activities.audioTranscript: Hi, it's Sabri. I'm at Ashfield already, but there is a problem on the Harbour line, so my train is leaving at a quarter past seven now instead of a quarter past six. They say it will still take fifty minutes, so I should reach you at about eight. Please don't stand out in the cold waiting for me. One more thing: I've just seen that the station shop is closed, so I haven't bought anything for your family after all. I'll find something near you on Saturday morning instead. Ring me if anything changes at your end.

activities.prompt: You ring the kitchen about Saturday's meal and hear its recorded line. What do you have to do to get Sabri a meal he can safely eat?
activities.promptAr: تتصل بالمطبخ بشأن وجبة السبت فتسمع خطه المسجل. ماذا عليكَ أن تفعل كي تحصل لصبري على وجبة يستطيع تناولها بأمان؟
options: Order before twelve on Friday and collect it at the side door
Order on Saturday evening and collect it at the front counter
Order before twelve on Friday and ask them to bring it to the flat
activities.answer: Order before twelve on Friday and collect it at the side door
activities.audioTranscript: Old Mill Kitchen, thank you for holding. We can cook the rice and vegetable dish without any nuts, and we will prepare it on a clean board, but we need the order by twelve o'clock on Friday, because Saturday is our busiest evening of the year. We cannot promise anything after that, and we do not bring food to people's homes. If you order in time, collect it from the side door between six and seven, not from the front counter, because the queue there is very long. Please tell us the name of the person who cannot eat nuts.

activities.prompt: Sabri is at the back gate at last. Welcome him, explain why the front entrance is shut and how he gets in tomorrow while you are at work, and settle two things for the morning: his meeting at nine and what the two of you are eating. Answer everything he says.
activities.promptAr: وصل صبري إلى البوابة الخلفية أخيراً. رحّب به، واشرح له لماذا المدخل الأمامي مغلق وكيف يدخل غداً بينما تكون في عملكَ، واحسم أمرين للصباح: اجتماعه في التاسعة وما ستأكلانه. وأجب عن كل ما يقوله.
partnerTurns: Finally! Sorry, that journey was terrible. Why is everybody coming round the back?
And if I go out tomorrow while you're at work, how do I get in again?
Fine, fine. Tell me about the morning, then. What time do you need me up, and what are we eating?

activities.prompt: Ten minutes before Sabri's meeting the internet stops. Tell him what has happened, say what you have already tried, offer him two ways of getting online in time, and agree together on one of them.
activities.promptAr: قبل اجتماع صبري بعشر دقائق ينقطع الإنترنت. أخبره بما حدث، وقل له ما جرّبته بالفعل، واعرض عليه طريقتين للاتصال في الوقت المناسب، واتفق معه على إحداهما.
partnerTurns: The page won't load. Is it my laptop, or is it the whole flat?
I can't miss this one. Have you already tried turning the box off and on?
All right, I'll take whichever is faster. Which one shall I try?

activities.prompt: Present the whole visit to Sabri in one go and in order: Friday evening, Saturday morning, Saturday afternoon, and Sunday before he travels. Say what you have already arranged, what is not arranged yet, and what you will do if it rains.
activities.promptAr: قدّم لصبري برنامج الزيارة كاملاً دفعة واحدة وبالترتيب: مساء الجمعة، وصباح السبت، وبعد ظهر السبت، والأحد قبل سفره. قل ما سبق أن رتّبته، وما لم يُرتَّب بعد، وما ستفعله إن أمطرت.

activities.prompt: Sabri wants to walk on his own while you finish your work. Describe the neighbourhood to him: compare the two ends of your street, say where four useful places are, and warn him about the one thing he should not do.
activities.promptAr: يريد صبري أن يتمشّى وحده بينما تنهي عملكَ. صف له الحي: قارن بين طرفَي شارعكَ، وقل أين تقع أربعة أماكن مفيدة، ونبّهه إلى الأمر الوحيد الذي ينبغي ألا يفعله.

activities.prompt: Sabri is going to the gardens on his own and cannot read the notice at the ticket desk. Tell him when they open and when the last tickets are sold, what is free and what he pays for, what he has to do with his bag, and the two things visitors must not do.
activities.promptAr: سيذهب صبري إلى الحدائق وحده، وهو لا يستطيع قراءة الإعلان عند مكتب التذاكر. أخبره متى تفتح ومتى تُباع آخر التذاكر، وما المجاني وما الذي يدفع مقابله، وماذا عليه أن يفعل بحقيبته، والأمرين الممنوعين على الزوار.
activities.sourceCard: Willow Gardens, ticket desk notice: we open at ten and close at six, and the last tickets are sold at half past five. Entry is free on Saturday, but the flower house costs two dinars. Large bags must be left at the desk. Please do not pick the flowers, and keep off the grass near the pond.

activities.prompt: Sabri feels ill on Saturday evening and hands you the clinic's card. Tell him what it says: how late he can go and which night it is closed, what he does not have to do, what he must take with him, and the one thing he must say at the desk. Add nothing the card does not say.
activities.promptAr: يشعر صبري بالتوعك مساء السبت ويناولكَ بطاقة العيادة. أخبره بما فيها: إلى أي ساعة يستطيع الذهاب وفي أي ليلة تكون مغلقة، وما لا يلزمه فعله، وما عليه أخذه معه، والأمر الوحيد الذي عليه قوله عند المكتب. لا تضف شيئاً ليس في البطاقة.
activities.sourceCard: Evening clinic card: we are open until half past ten every night except Sunday. You do not need an appointment, but bring your passport or another paper that shows your name. Tell the nurse at the desk about any allergy before the doctor calls you in. Do not take other medicine on the same evening.

activities.prompt: Sabri would rather have the plan in writing than try to remember it. Write him the message: how he gets into the building on Friday evening, what is already arranged for his meeting at nine, the food and where you collect it from, what you will do on Saturday afternoon and what it costs, and what time you both have to leave on Sunday.
activities.promptAr: يفضّل صبري أن تكون الخطة مكتوبة على أن يحاول حفظها. اكتب له الرسالة: كيف يدخل البناية مساء الجمعة، وما رُتّب بالفعل لاجتماعه في التاسعة، والطعام ومن أين تستلمه، وما ستفعلانه بعد ظهر السبت وكم يكلّف، والساعة التي عليكما المغادرة فيها يوم الأحد.

activities.prompt: A week after the visit, write the message you send Sabri. Mention two things the two of you did that you still remember, say what you thought of one of them, thank him for something he brought or did, tell him one thing that has changed since he left, and invite him back for a particular weekend.
activities.promptAr: بعد الزيارة بأسبوع، اكتب الرسالة التي سترسلها إلى صبري. اذكر أمرين فعلتماهما معاً وما زلتَ تتذكرهما، وقل رأيكَ في أحدهما، واشكره على شيء أحضره أو فعله، وأخبره بأمر واحد تغيّر منذ أن سافر، وادعُه للعودة في عطلة أسبوع محددة.

finalAssessment.title: A2 Independent Final Assessment
finalAssessment.sourcePolicy: Secure unseen inputs; every transcript, text and source card is new to this assessment and appears in no unit and in no capstone.

activities.audioTranscript: Hello, this is Bilal from the delivery office. I tried to bring your parcel yesterday afternoon, but nobody answered the door. While I was waiting outside, your neighbour came out and told me that you work until six. I didn't want to leave a box in the rain, so I took it back with me. We are open from eight until four on weekdays, and you can collect it with any card that shows your name. If coming here is difficult, ring us before Thursday and we will try your door again on Friday morning.
activities.prompt: Why did the driver take the parcel back to the office?
activities.promptAr: لماذا أعاد السائق الطرد إلى المكتب؟
options: Nobody was at home and it was raining
The name on the box was wrong
The office closes early on Fridays
activities.answer: Nobody was at home and it was raining

activities.audioTranscript: Hi Rana, it's Dunya. I looked at both evening courses for you. The one at the college is cheaper and the room is bigger, but it finishes at nine, which is later than you wanted. The class at the community centre costs more, although it is the closest one to your flat and the group is much smaller — only eight people. Honestly, I think the small group is better for you, because you told me you never ask questions in a big room. The college course is easier to pay for, so it depends what matters most.
activities.prompt: Which course does Dunya recommend, and why?
activities.promptAr: أي دورة توصي بها دنيا؟ ولماذا؟
options: The community centre one, because the group is smaller
The college one, because the room is bigger
Neither one, because both finish too late
activities.answer: The community centre one, because the group is smaller

activities.audioTranscript: Good morning, everyone. This is Sawsan from the river clean-up. We have plenty of gloves now, so please don't buy any more. We still need a few large bags, and we have very little drinking water, which worries me because the forecast is warm. There isn't much shade near the bridge either. If each of you brings one bottle and one bag, that will be enough for the whole group. A lot of new people joined us this week, so please arrive early and leave enough space in the car park for them.
activities.prompt: What does the group still need?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي لا تزال المجموعة بحاجة إليه؟
options: A few bags and more drinking water
More gloves and more shade
More cars and a later start
activities.answer: A few bags and more drinking water

activities.audioTranscript: Hi Tarek, it's Widad. We're moving on the twenty-first, so I'm writing to the landlord this evening. The van is arriving at nine, and my brother is going to help us with the heavy furniture. I think it will take most of the day, honestly. I'm not going to pack the kitchen until the night before, because we still have to cook. If you're free on the Saturday after that, we'll have a small lunch in the new place — nothing formal. I'll send you the address as soon as the keys are ours.
activities.prompt: What is already arranged for the twenty-first?
activities.promptAr: ما المرتّب فعلاً ليوم الحادي والعشرين؟
options: A van at nine and her brother's help
A lunch for all of their friends
A meeting with the new landlord
activities.answer: A van at nine and her brother's help

activities.audioTranscript: Welcome to the sports centre. Before you use the pool, you have to leave your bag in a locker, because bags are not allowed beside the water. You must shower first; that is a rule, not a request. You don't have to bring your own towel, because we lend them at the desk for nothing. Children under eight have to swim with an adult. The last swim is at half past nine, and everyone must leave the water when the whistle goes. If you need help, our staff in the red shirts are here all evening.
activities.prompt: Which one of these is NOT necessary?
activities.promptAr: أي من هذه الأمور غير ضروري؟
options: Bringing your own towel
Showering before you swim
Leaving your bag in a locker
activities.answer: Bringing your own towel

activities.audioTranscript: You asked me about cycling to work, so here is what I think. You should try the river path first; it is longer, but you don't share it with buses. You shouldn't start with five days a week — begin with two and see how your legs feel. I'd buy a good light before anything else, because the mornings are dark now. It might be a good idea to keep a spare shirt at the office too. And if it rains hard, take the bus. There is no prize for arriving wet and angry.
activities.prompt: What does the speaker advise about the first weeks?
activities.promptAr: بماذا ينصح المتحدث بشأن الأسابيع الأولى؟
options: Cycle two days a week, not five
Cycle every day along the main road
Wait until the mornings are lighter
activities.answer: Cycle two days a week, not five

activities.audioTranscript: This is a message for all the parents. If the rain continues tonight, Saturday's match will move to the indoor hall. We will decide at eight on Friday evening and I'll send one message to everybody, so please don't ring the club. If we play indoors, your child will need clean shoes, because the floor is new and the school is strict about it. If the weather clears, we'll play on the usual field and start at ten as normal. Either way, the coach would like everyone there twenty minutes early.
activities.prompt: When will the club make its decision?
activities.promptAr: متى سيتخذ النادي قراره؟
options: At eight on Friday evening
On Saturday morning at ten
Twenty minutes before the match
activities.answer: At eight on Friday evening

activities.audioTranscript: Here is how the machine in the basement works. First, put your coins in the slot at the top; if you press the button before you pay, nothing happens. Then choose a programme — the short one takes forty minutes and the long one takes an hour and a half. When the light turns green, the door opens. If the light stays red, the machine is still full of water, so wait; don't pull the handle. Finally, take your clothes out the same day. If people leave washing overnight, the caretaker puts it in a box by the stairs.
activities.prompt: What does a red light mean?
activities.promptAr: ماذا يعني الضوء الأحمر؟
options: There is still water inside the machine
The programme has finished
The machine needs more coins
activities.answer: There is still water inside the machine

activities.audioTranscript: Hello, my name is Hanan and I'd like to join the reading group at the library. I've worked with children before — I spent two years at a primary school in my own country — but I've never taught an adult. I have read to my nieces every week since they were small, so I'm not nervous about reading aloud. I haven't used your booking system yet, and I've never been to the Thursday session, so I'd like somebody to show me the room first. Have you ever had a volunteer who speaks two languages?
activities.prompt: What has Hanan never done?
activities.promptAr: ما الشيء الذي لم تفعله حنان قط؟
options: Taught an adult
Worked with children
Read aloud to anybody
activities.answer: Taught an adult

activities.audioTranscript: Hi, I've just got home and the kitchen was a disaster, so don't worry — I've already washed the plates and put the bins out. The delivery man has been twice, but he hasn't left the box yet, because somebody has to sign for it. I haven't paid the electricity bill yet; it's on the table and the date on it is the ninth, so please don't move it anywhere. Oh, and Munther has already taken his bicycle out of the hall, so you can reach the cupboard now. See you tonight.
activities.prompt: What still has to be done?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي لا يزال يجب فعله؟
options: Paying the electricity bill
Washing the plates
Moving the bicycle out of the hall
activities.answer: Paying the electricity bill

activities.audioTranscript: Good afternoon. I usually stand at the other end of the market, near the fish, but this month I'm working from this corner because workers are repairing the roof. I sell honey and dried fruit all year, and in winter I also bring olives from my brother's farm. At the moment I'm only taking cash, I'm afraid — the card machine is broken and I'm waiting for a new one. I open at seven every day except Sunday. If you come early, the bread next door is still warm.
activities.prompt: Why is the stall in a different place this month?
activities.promptAr: لماذا يقع كشك البائع في مكان مختلف هذا الشهر؟
options: Workers are repairing the roof
The card machine is broken
He sells olives only in winter
activities.answer: Workers are repairing the roof

activities.audioTranscript: I want to tell you what happened to me on Tuesday. I left my wallet on the counter of a small shop near the station and I didn't notice for two hours. First I searched my bag three times, then I rang my bank, and finally I went back to the shop without much hope. The woman behind the counter smiled and gave it to me — everything was still inside, even the photographs. She refused any money, so I bought a box of sweets for the staff instead. It was a very good day after a bad start.
activities.prompt: What did the speaker do last?
activities.promptAr: ما آخر شيء فعله المتحدث؟
options: Bought sweets for the shop staff
Telephoned the bank
Searched through the bag
activities.answer: Bought sweets for the shop staff

activities.audioTranscript: Hello, this is the repair office returning your call about the heating. I'm sorry nobody came on Monday; the engineer was ill and the message didn't reach you, which isn't good enough. Could you tell us whether the noise happens only when the water is hot, or all the time? We'd like to send somebody on Wednesday between eleven and one. If that doesn't suit you, would Thursday morning be better? Please don't turn the system off completely in this weather. Ring us back today if you can, and ask for Ghada.
activities.prompt: What does the office want the customer to do?
activities.promptAr: ماذا يريد المكتب من الزبون أن يفعل؟
options: Say when the noise happens and agree a time
Turn the heating off until Wednesday
Pay for the visit that did not happen
activities.answer: Say when the noise happens and agree a time

activities.audioTranscript: A short update about the museum trip. Although the tickets are booked, we are changing the day, because the museum is closed for cleaning on the fourteenth. So the trip is now on the twenty-first, with the same bus at the same time, and the cost has not changed. Although lunch isn't included, there is a big room where the children can eat their own food, so please send them with something simple. We still need two more adults with us; if nobody offers by Friday, we will take one class instead of two.
activities.prompt: Why has the trip moved to another day?
activities.promptAr: لماذا انتقلت الرحلة إلى يوم آخر؟
options: The museum is closed for cleaning that day
The bus company has raised its prices
Too few children have paid for tickets
activities.answer: The museum is closed for cleaning that day

activities.audioTranscript: Here is the travel picture for tomorrow. The first part of the day will be dry and rather cold, and there may be fog in the valley before nine. Buses will run normally, but the early train to the coast might be late, because engineers are working on the line near the bridge. In the afternoon it will get warmer, and I think most people will be comfortable without a heavy coat. There might be rain after six, so if you are walking home late, take something for it. I'll be back with more at midday.
activities.prompt: Which thing is the speaker sure about?
activities.promptAr: ما الأمر الذي يتأكد منه المتحدث؟
options: The early part of the day will be dry and cold
The early train will be late
It will rain in the evening
activities.answer: The early part of the day will be dry and cold

activities.audioTranscript: We interviewed four people, and I want to tell you about the one who impressed me most. She is the woman who worked in the hospital kitchen for six years, which is exactly the experience we need here. She is also the only applicant who can start in April, and she brought a reference from a manager who trusts her completely. The man who came second is friendlier, honestly, but he can only work at weekends, which doesn't help us at all. So the person I would choose is the one with the kitchen years behind her.
activities.prompt: Why does the speaker prefer the first candidate?
activities.promptAr: لماذا يفضّل المتحدث المتقدمة الأولى؟
options: Her experience, and she can start in April
She is the friendliest of the four
She is free only at the weekend
activities.answer: Her experience, and she can start in April

activities.audioTranscript: This is the simplest soup I know, and my grandmother made it every winter. Chop one large onion and four carrots, and heat a little oil in a big pot. Cook the onion gently for five minutes — don't let it turn brown. Add the carrots, half a spoon of salt and a litre of water, then boil it for twenty minutes. Take the pot off the heat before you mix it, or you will burn your hands. Serve it with warm bread. If you like it thicker, use less water next time.
activities.prompt: What must you do before you mix the soup?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي يجب فعله قبل خلط الحساء؟
options: Take the pot off the heat
Add another litre of water
Let the onion turn brown
activities.answer: Take the pot off the heat

activities.audioTranscript: Hi Saleem, it's Aisha. I'd like to invite you and your family to our new flat on the last Friday of the month, at about one o'clock. It is not a big occasion at all — only lunch and plenty of talking. My sister is coming from the coast, and she has never met you. Would you like me to cook the fish you enjoyed last year? If Friday is difficult, we are free on the Sunday too, so tell me which one suits you. Please don't bring anything; the kitchen is full already. Let me know this week.
activities.prompt: What does Aisha ask Saleem to do?
activities.promptAr: ماذا تطلب عائشة من سليم أن يفعل؟
options: Choose between two days and reply this week
Bring food for everybody
Collect her sister from the coast
activities.answer: Choose between two days and reply this week

activities.sourceText: Weekend helper wanted at the community garden. You must be over sixteen and you have to work outside in all weather. You don't need any experience, because we train everybody on the first morning. Tools are provided. Write to Rida before the twelfth of May.
activities.prompt: Which of these does the garden require?
activities.promptAr: ما الشرط الذي تطلبه الحديقة؟
options: Being over sixteen
Two years of experience
Bringing your own tools
activities.answer: Being over sixteen

activities.sourceText: Flat one: two rooms on the third floor, no lift, but the rent is lower and the street is quiet. Flat two: one room on the ground floor, more expensive, and the buses are noisy until midnight. Both flats are furnished and both are fifteen minutes from the college.
activities.prompt: Which flat suits somebody who cannot use stairs?
activities.promptAr: أي شقة تناسب من لا يستطيع صعود الدرج؟
options: Flat two, although it costs more
Flat one, because the rent is lower
Neither flat, because both have stairs
activities.answer: Flat two, although it costs more

activities.sourceText: Passengers for the coast: the eleven o'clock boat will not run today because of the wind. If you have a ticket for it, take the bus from stand six instead. The bus leaves at half past eleven and arrives an hour later. The desk cannot return money for today's tickets.
activities.prompt: What should a passenger with a boat ticket do?
activities.promptAr: ماذا ينبغي لراكب يحمل تذكرة القارب أن يفعل؟
options: Take the half past eleven bus from stand six
Ask the desk to return the money
Wait for a later boat this evening
activities.answer: Take the half past eleven bus from stand six

activities.sourceText: After the treatment you should rest for two days and drink plenty of water. You must not lift anything heavy for a week. A short walk each day is good for you. If the pain becomes worse at night, or you have a temperature, ring the nurse on the number below.
activities.prompt: What is forbidden for a week?
activities.promptAr: ما الممنوع لمدة أسبوع؟
options: Lifting heavy things
Walking every day
Drinking a lot of water
activities.answer: Lifting heavy things

activities.sourceText: To share the file: open the folder, choose the file, then press Share. If the button is grey, you are not signed in. Copy the link and send it to one person at a time. If you send it to a whole group, everybody can change the file and nobody knows who did it.
activities.prompt: What does a grey Share button mean?
activities.promptAr: ماذا يعني أن يكون زر المشاركة رمادياً؟
options: You have not signed in
The file is too large to share
Somebody else has changed the file
activities.answer: You have not signed in

activities.sourceText: I watched this film on a cold evening and I did not expect to enjoy it. The beginning was slow and the music was far too loud, but the last twenty minutes were excellent. In my opinion the older actor saved it. I would watch it again, although not with small children.
activities.prompt: What is the writer's opinion of the film overall?
activities.promptAr: ما رأي الكاتب في الفيلم عموماً؟
options: Good in the end, in spite of a weak start
Bad from the beginning to the end
Perfect for a family with small children
activities.answer: Good in the end, in spite of a weak start

activities.sourceText: Dear neighbours, we would like to invite you to tea in the courtyard on Saturday at four, to meet the new family in flat nine. Children are welcome. Please tell Suad by Thursday whether you are coming, so that we know how many chairs to carry down.
activities.prompt: What must neighbours do before Thursday?
activities.promptAr: ما الواجب على الجيران قبل يوم الخميس؟
options: Say whether they will come
Carry the chairs to the courtyard
Bring something to eat with the tea
activities.answer: Say whether they will come

activities.sourceText: The coastal path is open, but the wind may be strong after midday. Walkers must stay behind the fence near the cliff, and must not use the lower steps, which are wet and slippery. Dogs have to be kept on a lead. The cafe at the halfway point closes at four.
activities.prompt: Which part of the walk is closed to people?
activities.promptAr: أي جزء من الممشى مغلق أمام الناس؟
options: The lower steps
The whole coastal path
The cafe at the halfway point
activities.answer: The lower steps

activities.sourceText: Lentil soup for six people: 400 grams of lentils, two onions, a little oil and one spoon of cumin. Wash the lentils twice. Cook the onions until they are soft, then add everything else with a litre and a half of water and boil it for half an hour.
activities.prompt: How much water does the recipe need?
activities.promptAr: كم من الماء تحتاج الوصفة؟
options: A litre and a half
Half a litre
Three litres
activities.answer: A litre and a half

activities.sourceText: Three people applied for the job. Hala has the most experience, but she can work only in the mornings. Nizar is the quickest learner and is free every day except Sunday. Rawan, who worked here last summer, knows the machines best, but she can only work three days a week. The job is full time, Monday to Friday.
activities.prompt: Which applicant can work the hours of the job?
activities.promptAr: أي متقدّم يستطيع العمل في ساعات الوظيفة؟
options: Nizar
Hala
Nobody can
activities.answer: Nizar

activities.sourceText: Last winter our street had no electricity for two days. While we were looking for candles, a neighbour knocked and brought us a small gas cooker. We cooked together in her kitchen for two evenings, and afterwards nobody on the street forgot what she did.
activities.prompt: What were the writer's family doing when the neighbour arrived?
activities.promptAr: ماذا كانت عائلة الكاتب تفعل عندما وصلت الجارة؟
options: Looking for candles
Cooking on a gas cooker
Writing to the electricity office
activities.answer: Looking for candles

activities.sourceText: I still work at the same school, but this term I am teaching the youngest class, because their usual teacher is ill. These days I leave home an hour earlier and I am learning a great deal from them. It is only until March, and honestly I will be glad to go back.
activities.prompt: Which part of the writer's life is temporary?
activities.promptAr: أي جزء من حياة الكاتب مؤقت؟
options: Teaching the youngest class
Working at that school
Getting up in the morning
activities.answer: Teaching the youngest class

activities.sourceText: Digital skills course, ten evenings, starting 3 October. The fee is 90 dollars and it includes the book. You do not need a computer at home, because the room has twenty. You must attend at least eight evenings to receive the certificate. Places are held for people who pay by 26 September.
activities.prompt: What is needed in order to get the certificate?
activities.promptAr: ما المطلوب للحصول على الشهادة؟
options: Attending at least eight evenings
Owning a computer at home
Paying an extra fee for the book
activities.answer: Attending at least eight evenings

activities.sourceText: Bus 9 leaves the village at 07:15 and reaches the hospital at 07:55. Bus 12 leaves at 07:40 and arrives at 08:35, because it goes through the market. The clinic asks patients to be at the desk before their appointment time.
activities.prompt: A patient has an appointment at 08:00. Which bus must she take?
activities.promptAr: لدى مريضة موعد في الثامنة؛ أي حافلة يجب أن تستقل؟
options: Bus 9
Bus 12
Either bus is fine
activities.answer: Bus 9

activities.sourceText: Update from the office: we have already moved the chairs and the small tables into the hall. The new lights have just arrived, but we haven't tested them yet. Nobody has found the key to the store room, so please look in the top drawer before you leave tonight.
activities.prompt: Which job has not been done yet?
activities.promptAr: أي مهمة لم تُنجَز بعد؟
options: Testing the new lights
Moving the chairs into the hall
Bringing the small tables in
activities.answer: Testing the new lights

activities.sourceText: You asked me about your first week. Don't try to remember every name on the first day, because nobody does. You should write down the things people tell you, because they explain them only once. Why don't you eat lunch with the team instead of at your desk? That is where the real information is.
activities.prompt: What does the writer suggest about lunch?
activities.promptAr: بماذا يقترح الكاتب فيما يخص الغداء؟
options: Eat it with the team, not at your desk
Eat it quickly and go back to work
Bring it from home on the first day
activities.answer: Eat it with the team, not at your desk

activities.sourceText: Hall booking: pay a deposit of 40 dollars when you book. We return it if you leave the room clean and lock the door. Cancel more than seven days before your date and you lose nothing; cancel later than that and we keep the deposit. Music must stop at eleven.
activities.prompt: In which case does a group lose its deposit?
activities.promptAr: في أي حالة تخسر المجموعة عربونها؟
options: It cancels three days before the date
It cancels a month before the date
It books the hall for a Saturday
activities.answer: It cancels three days before the date

activities.sourceText: Two evenings at the library. Tuesday: a storyteller for children between five and nine years old, free, no booking. Thursday: a book group for adults reading a short novel about a family in the south; five dollars, and you should read the first fifty pages before you come.
activities.prompt: What should an adult do before the Thursday evening?
activities.promptAr: ماذا ينبغي للبالغ أن يفعل قبل أمسية الخميس؟
options: Read the first fifty pages of the novel
Book a free place for the storyteller
Bring a child between five and nine
activities.answer: Read the first fifty pages of the novel

activities.prompt: Write 70–90 words to a friend about something that happened to you last month. Say what you were doing when it happened, what you did next, how you felt about it, and one thing you will do differently.
activities.promptAr: اكتب من 70 إلى 90 كلمة إلى صديق عن شيء حدث لك الشهر الماضي. قل ماذا كنت تفعل حين حدث، وماذا فعلت بعده، وبماذا شعرت، وشيئاً واحداً ستفعله بطريقة مختلفة.

activities.prompt: Write 70–90 words to the person who runs a club you have joined. Explain that you cannot come on Saturday, give your reason, suggest another day, ask one question about what you will miss, and thank them.
activities.promptAr: اكتب من 70 إلى 90 كلمة إلى من يدير نادياً انضممت إليه. اشرح أنك لا تستطيع الحضور يوم السبت، واذكر السبب، واقترح يوماً آخر، واسأل سؤالاً عمّا ستفوته، واشكره.

activities.prompt: Answer the four questions about your life now, about something you did recently and about next weekend, then ask two questions of your own at the end.
activities.promptAr: أجب عن الأسئلة الأربعة عن حياتك الآن، وعن شيء فعلته مؤخراً، وعن عطلة الأسبوع القادمة، ثم اسأل سؤالين من عندك في النهاية.
partnerTurns: Let's start with now. Tell me about an ordinary week for you, and say whether anything is different at the moment.
Thank you. Now think back: tell me about something you did last month that you enjoyed, and say what happened.
And next weekend — what are your plans, and why those?
Before we finish, ask me two questions about my own week.

activities.prompt: You booked a Saturday cookery course, but the office has put you in the Sunday group and taken too much money. Telephone them: explain both problems, ask politely for a change, answer what you are offered, and agree what happens next.
activities.promptAr: حجزت دورة طبخ يوم السبت، لكن المكتب وضعك في مجموعة الأحد وأخذ منك مالاً أكثر مما يجب. اتصل بهم: اشرح المشكلتين، واطلب التغيير بأدب، وردّ على ما يُعرَض عليك، واتفق على الخطوة التالية.
partnerTurns: Bookings office, good morning. What can I do for you?
I see. I'm afraid the Saturday group is full now. What would you like me to do?
I can put you back on Saturday next month and return the difference. Is that all right, and what is the best number for you?

activities.sourceCard: Two evening jobs. The cafe: Monday to Thursday, six until ten, twelve dollars an hour, ten minutes from Yara's flat. The warehouse: Friday and Saturday, eight until two in the morning, eighteen dollars an hour, one bus and one train away. Yara studies full time and has an exam every Friday.
activities.prompt: Compare the two jobs on the card and recommend one of them for Yara. Give at least two reasons, and say one problem with the job you did not choose.
activities.promptAr: قارن بين الوظيفتين في البطاقة وأوصِ بإحداهما ليارا. اذكر سببين على الأقل، واذكر مشكلة واحدة في الوظيفة التي لم تخترها.

activities.sourceCard: Four notes for your story, in this order: a hot Friday afternoon and a long queue at the post office; a telephone call from your sister; a decision you had to take quickly; how the day ended.
activities.prompt: Tell the story on the card from beginning to end. Set the scene, say what was happening, explain what interrupted it, what you decided and how it ended.
activities.promptAr: احكِ القصة التي في البطاقة من بدايتها إلى نهايتها. مهّد للمشهد، وقل ماذا كان يجري، وما الذي قاطعه، وماذا قررت، وكيف انتهت.

activities.sourceCard: Notice to residents: the water will be off on Tuesday 14 June from nine in the morning until four in the afternoon, while the old pipes are replaced. Please fill bottles the night before. The caretaker will leave drinking water in the hall. If the water looks brown after Wednesday, tell the office on the ground floor.
activities.prompt: A neighbour did not understand the building notice. Relay it to her in simple English: when the water will be off, what she should do the night before, what the caretaker will leave, and who to tell if the water looks brown later.
activities.promptAr: جارتُك لم تفهم إعلان المبنى. انقله لها بإنجليزية بسيطة: متى ينقطع الماء، وماذا ينبغي لها أن تفعل في الليلة السابقة، وماذا سيترك الحارس، ومن تُخبِر إذا بدا الماء بنيّاً لاحقاً.

activities.sourceCard: Two swimming courses. Course A: Mondays and Wednesdays at seven in the evening, 60 dollars, in the old pool, no parking. Course B: Saturdays at ten in the morning, 85 dollars, in the new pool, free parking. Kamal works late every weekday and drives everywhere.
activities.prompt: Kamal asked which swimming course suits him. Relay only what he needs: the day and time, the difference in price, and the parking. Then say which course you would tell him to take.
activities.promptAr: سأل كمال أي دورة سباحة تناسبه. انقل له ما يهمّه فقط: اليوم والوقت، وفرق السعر، وموقف السيارات، ثم قل أي دورة تنصحه بها.
